DECLARE
 HDATE DATE;
BEGIN

 IF :System.Cursor_Value IS NOT NULL THEN

 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 if vis = 'TRUE' then
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible, property_false);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 else
 TMPLT.Populate_Functions ;
 end if;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 IF vis = 'FALSE' THEN
 COPY(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM'), 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ADJ_FUNS;
 GO_ITEM('DUMMY');
 END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 Set_Item_Property('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'STD_NORMAL_FUNCTION');
 Execute_Function('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 TMPLT.USING_KEYB := FALSE;
 TMPLT.CURSOR_AT := 0;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-RADIO-CHANGED
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN


 IF :CLR_TYPE.CLR_DCLTN =1 THEN
 -- BY SHERIFT
 :System.Message_Level := '25';
 :SEARCH_CNTNR := NULL;
 CLR_BLOCKS;

 :System.Message_Level :=:GLOBAL.Message_Level ;

 GO_ITEM('DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN');
 ELSE
 :System.Message_Level := '25';
 GO_ITEM('DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN');
 GO_BLOCK('DCLTN_HDR');
 CLEAR_BLOCK(NO_VALIDATE);
 GO_ITEM('SEARCH_BLK.SEARCH_CNTNR');
 END IF;

 SHOW_TAB(:CLR_TYPE.CLR_DCLTN);
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-HELP
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGHP$CALL_HELP_FORM */
/* Call the help system after setting globals with current block and item */
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := '';
 IF (:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE IS NULL) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(23, 'Help file is missing or incorrect'), 'W', 'OFG', 23);
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HPATH || '';
 BEGIN
 CGHP$CALL_MS_HELP(
 0 /* IN : Help Context Id */
 ,:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE); /* IN : Help Resource File */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN

 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN

 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;

IF NOT V_DISP_LOV THEN

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN IS NULL THEN

 SELECT COUNT(DCLTN_NBR) INTO V_COUNT FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR;

 IF V_COUNT > 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 1;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD;
 :global.Exec_QRy_Now := 1;
 DECLTN_LOV;

 ELSIF V_COUNT = 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 1;
 SELECT DCLTN_ISN,DCLTN_DT INTO :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR;

 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN := :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;
 :global.Exec_QRy_Now := 1;

 END IF;
ELSE
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 0;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TYPE_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TIR_HEAD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TIR_HQ_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TERMN_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز المستخدم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جهة الأوضاع الخاصه', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_MNFCT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PORT_CD,MNFCT_NBR' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INSPECTOR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم المعاين - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IMP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمـز الجمـرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_GROUP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمـز الجمـرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_FRIMEX_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'FRGN_IMP_EXP_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_EXIT_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز منفذ الخروج', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_DHLOWN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في مالك بوليصة البريد السريع الدولي - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_CTRY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في دولة الوصول النهائي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BRKRAUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'BRKR_ATHRZTN_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BKM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم الرخصة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AG_AUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'AGNT_ATHRZTN_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AGNT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الشركة الوسيطة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AEO_REAS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات سبب اختيار المشغل الأقتصادى - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

BEGIN

 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_PORT_CD :=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD;

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE port_cd = :DCLTN_HDR.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_HDR.dcltn_isn

 ----------nihad khalil fagem 21/04/2009 for special department
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD = 7 THEN
IF :DCLTN_HDR.SPCL_DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
:SPCL_DEPT_FILLER1 := :DCLTN_HDR.SPCL_DEPT_ID;
ELSE
SELECT filler1 INTO :SPCL_DEPT_FILLER1 FROM TASKS
WHERE TASK_ID =NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0);

DECLARE

 CURSOR DSDR IS
 SELECT DSDR_SPCL_DEPT_ID FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND WORK_FLAG = 0
 ;
 V_SPCL_DEPT_NAME VARCHAR2(700);
 V_DEPT_NAME VARCHAR2(200);


BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND WORK_FLAG = 0
 ;

 IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
 FOR I IN DSDR LOOP
 SELECT DEPT_NAME INTO V_DEPT_NAME FROM DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_REFS
 WHERE SPCL_DEPT_ID = I.DSDR_SPCL_DEPT_ID
 AND REC_STATUS = 1
 ;

 v_spcl_dept_name := v_spcl_dept_name||','|| v_dept_name;

 END LOOP;
 V_SPCL_DEPT_NAME :=SUBSTR(V_SPCL_DEPT_NAME,2);


 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD = 7 THEN
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC :=' معروض على '||V_SPCL_DEPT_NAME;

 AND REC_STATUS = 1;

 V_SPCL_DEPT_NAME :=' ';

 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD = 7 THEN
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC :='معروض على قسم '||V_SPCL_DEPT_NAME;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('DCLTN_HDR');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$DCLN2295_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$DCLN2295_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$DCLN2295_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((nvl(to_char(DCLTN_STA_CD), ''CG$NULL''), DCLTN_TYPE_CD) IN '||'(SELECT nvl(to_char(DCLTN_STA_CD), ''CG$NULL''), DCLTN_TYPE_CD '||'FROM DCLTN_STATUS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'FC_PORT_GATE_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم البوابة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'FC_GATE_SHIFTS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم الوردية - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DGT_VHTR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات حركة السيارات - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DGT_SEA_ITEM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات إذن التسليم البحري - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DGT_SEA_DLVY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'تاريخ إذن التسليم,رقم إذن التسليم,وكيل الشحن' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DGT_SDP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الميناء' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DGT_DCLTN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات البيان الجمركي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DGT_AIR_DLVY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات إذن التسليم الجوي - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'الفسح من البوا','البيـــــــــــــان الجمركي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'الفسح من البو','البيـــــــــــــان الجمركي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 IF :parameter.p_curr_port_cd = 53
 AND :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn IS NULL
 AND :dcltn_gate_trans.dgt_seq IS NULL
 AND ( :dcltn_gate_trans.vhcl_trans_nbr IS NOT NULL
 OR :dcltn_gate_trans.vhcl_trans_date IS NOT NULL
 OR :dcltn_gate_trans.plate_no IS NOT NULL
 )
 THEN
 :dcltn_gate_trans.vhcl_trans_nbr := NULL;
 :dcltn_gate_trans.vhcl_trans_date := NULL;
 :dcltn_gate_trans.plate_no := NULL;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
END;

/*
BEGIN
SELECT
 AIR_DLVY.BILL_NBR ADLVY_BILL_NBR
 ,AIR_DLVY.MFST_NBR ADLVY_MFST_NBR
 ,L_BLD.ARVD_QTY ADLVY_ARVD_QTY
 ,AIR_DLVY.CARR_PREFIX ADLVY_CARR_PREFIX
 ,AIR_DLVY.BILL_DT ADLVY_BILL_DT
 ,AIR_DLVY.MFST_YEAR ADLVY_MFST_YEAR
 ,AIR_DLVY.MFST_TYPE ADLVY_MFST_TYPE
 ,L_BLD.ARVD_WT ADLVY_ARVD_WT
 ,L_BILL.OWNER_NAME ADLVY_OWNER_NAME
 ,L_BILL.IMPR_NAME ADLVY_IMPR_NAME


INTO :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_BILL_NBR,
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_MFST_NBR,
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_ARVD_QTY,
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_CARR_PREFIX,
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_BILL_DT,
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_MFST_YEAR,
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_MFST_TYPE,
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_ARVD_WT,
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_OWNER_NAME,
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_IMPR_NAME


FROM AIR_DLVY_ORDERS AIR_DLVY
 ,BILL_DTLS L_BLD
 ,BILLS L_BILL

WHERE L_BLD.SHPMT_TYPE = AIR_DLVY.SHPMT_TYPE

AND (L_BLD.MFST_NBR = AIR_DLVY.MFST_NBR OR
 (L_BLD.MFST_NBR IS NULL AND AIR_DLVY.MFST_NBR IS NULL ))

AND (L_BLD.MFST_YEAR = AIR_DLVY.MFST_YEAR OR (L_BLD.MFST_YEAR IS NULL AND
 AIR_DLVY.MFST_YEAR IS NULL ))

AND (L_BLD.MFST_TYPE = AIR_DLVY.MFST_TYPE OR (L_BLD.MFST_TYPE IS NULL AND
 AIR_DLVY.MFST_TYPE IS NULL ))

AND (L_BLD.BILL_NBR = AIR_DLVY.BILL_NBR OR (L_BLD.BILL_NBR IS NULL AND
 AIR_DLVY.BILL_NBR IS NULL ))

AND L_BLD.PORT_CD = AIR_DLVY.PORT_CD

AND (L_BLD.BILL_DT = AIR_DLVY.BILL_DT OR (L_BLD.BILL_DT IS NULL AND
 AIR_DLVY.BILL_DT IS NULL ))

AND (L_BLD.CARR_PREFIX = AIR_DLVY.CARR_PREFIX OR (L_BLD.CARR_PREFIX IS NULL AND
 AIR_DLVY.CARR_PREFIX IS NULL ))

AND L_BILL.PORT_CD = L_BLD.PORT_CD
AND L_BILL.BILL_DT = L_BLD.BILL_DT
AND L_BILL.CARR_PREFIX = L_BLD.CARR_PREFIX
AND L_BILL.BILL_NBR = L_BLD.BILL_NBR
AND AIR_DLVY.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD
AND AIR_DLVY.DLVY_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_NBR
AND TO_CHAR(AIR_DLVY.DLVY_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY') = TO_CHAR(:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY');

EXCEPTION
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
END;
*/
BEGIN
 IF :GLOBAL.air_partial_clear = 1
 AND :parameter.p_port_type = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_AIR')
 AND :dcltn_gate_trans.dgt_type IN (3, 5, 6)
 THEN
 :dcltn_gate_trans.aclrd_qty := :dcltn_gate_trans.clrd_qty;
 :dcltn_gate_trans.aclrd_wt := :dcltn_gate_trans.clrd_wt;
 END IF;
END;

BEGIN
 IF (CG$DCLN2295_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_GATE_TRANS_WHERE <> 'first_time') THEN
 set_block_property('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS', DEFAULT_WHERE, CG$DCLN2295_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_GATE_TRANS_WHERE);
 CG$DCLN2295_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_GATE_TRANS_WHERE := 'first_time';
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.TriggerText:

/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$DCLN2295_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_GATE_TRANS_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$DCLN2295_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_GATE_TRANS_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$DCLN2295_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_GATE_TRANS_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.GATE_NAME');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(GATE_NAME '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(GATE_NAME '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(GATE_NAME LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(GATE_NAME ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((nvl(to_char(GATE_NBR), ''CG$NULL''), PORT_CD) IN '||'(SELECT nvl(to_char(GATE_NBR), ''CG$NULL''), PORT_CD '||'FROM PORT_GATES WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SHIFT_NAME');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SHIFT_NAME '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SHIFT_NAME '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SHIFT_NAME LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SHIFT_NAME ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((nvl(to_char(SHIFT_ID), ''CG$NULL''), PORT_CD) IN '||'(SELECT nvl(to_char(SHIFT_ID), ''CG$NULL''), PORT_CD '||'FROM GATE_SHIFTS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(PLATE_NO '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(PLATE_NO '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(PLATE_NO LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(PLATE_NO ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((nvl(to_char(VHCL_TRANS_DATE), ''CG$NULL''), nvl(to_char(VHCL_TRANS_NBR), ''CG$NULL''), PORT_CD) IN '||'(SELECT nvl(to_char(TRANS_DATE_H), ''CG$NULL''), nvl(to_char(TRAN_SEQ), ''CG$NULL''),
 PORT_CD '||'FROM VHCL_TRANSACTIONS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

 --&&& END

 --M.ALI 08-01-2015---


 DECLARE
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_hq_impr_nbr NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 SELECT hq_impr_nbr
 INTO V_hq_impr_nbr
 FROM importers
 WHERE impr_nbr = :DCLTN_HDR.impr_nbr
 AND port_cd = :DCLTN_HDR.port_cd;

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM declarations d1, dcltn_items d2, dcltn_item_letrs d3
 WHERE d1.port_cd = d2.port_cd
 AND d1.dcltn_isn = d2.dcltn_isn
 AND d2.port_cd = d3.port_cd
 AND d2.item_isn = d3.item_isn
 AND d1.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 AND d1.dcltn_sta_cd IN (9)
 AND d2.ins_rsn_cd IS NOT NULL
 AND D1.dcltn_dt > TO_DATE ('01-11-1435', 'mi-mm-yyyy')
 AND D1.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND D1.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD
 AND dil_seq =
 (SELECT MAX (dil_seq)
 FROM dcltn_item_letrs
 WHERE port_cd = d3.port_cd
 AND item_isn = d3.item_isn);

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 INSERT INTO ITM_TMP_ALL I (I.PORT_CD,
 I.ITEM_TEMP_ISN,
 I.DCLTN_NBR,
 I.DCLTN_DT,
 I.DCLTN_TYPE_CD,
 I.ITEM_SEQ,
 I.GROSS_WT,
 I.NET_WT,
 I.INV_QTY,
 I.GOODS_DESC,
 I.TEMP_EXPRY_DT,
 I.MSR_UNIT,
 I.HRMNZD_CODE,
 I.ITEM_ISN,
 I.HQ_IMPR_NBR,
 I.ORG_CTRY,
 I.CARNET_PORT_CD,
 I.IST_CARNET_ISN,
 I.CARNET_PAGE_NO,
 I.ITEM_VALUE,
 I.DUTY_AMOUNT)
 SELECT d1.port_cd,
 --ITEM_TEMP_ISN.NEXTVAL,
 GNRL.GET_SEQUENCE_VALUE (d1.PORT_CD, 'ITEM_TEMP_ISN'), -- central
 d1.dcltn_nbr,
 d1.dcltn_dt,
 d1.dcltn_type_cd,
 d2.item_seq,
 d2.GROSS_WT,
 d2.NET_WT,
 d2.INV_QTY,
 d2.ITEM_DESC,
 d3.expiary_dt,
 D2.INV_MSR_UNIT,
 d2.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,
 d2.ITEM_ISN,
 V_hq_impr_nbr,
 d2.CTRY_CD,
 CARNET_PORT_CD,
 IST_CARNET_ISN,
 CARNET_PAGE_NO,
 d2.CIF_COST,
 d2.ORGNL_DUTY
 FROM declarations d1, dcltn_items d2, dcltn_item_letrs d3
 WHERE d1.port_cd = d2.port_cd
 AND d1.dcltn_isn = d2.dcltn_isn
 AND d2.port_cd = d3.port_cd
 AND d2.item_isn = d3.item_isn
 AND d1.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 AND d1.dcltn_sta_cd IN (9)
 AND d2.ins_rsn_cd IS NOT NULL
 AND D1.dcltn_dt > TO_DATE ('01-11-1435', 'mi-mm-yyyy')
 AND D1.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND D1.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD
 AND dil_seq =
 (SELECT MAX (dil_seq)
 FROM dcltn_item_letrs
 WHERE port_cd = d3.port_cd
 AND item_isn = d3.item_isn);

 DECLARE
 V_CARNET_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 V_IST_CARNET_ISN NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 SELECT DISTINCT CARNET_PORT_CD, IST_CARNET_ISN
 INTO V_CARNET_PORT_CD, V_IST_CARNET_ISN
 FROM declarations d1, dcltn_items d2, dcltn_item_letrs d3
 WHERE d1.port_cd = d2.port_cd
 AND d1.dcltn_isn = d2.dcltn_isn
 AND d2.port_cd = d3.port_cd
 AND d2.item_isn = d3.item_isn
 AND d1.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 AND d1.dcltn_sta_cd IN (9)
 AND d2.ins_rsn_cd IS NOT NULL
 AND D1.dcltn_dt > TO_DATE ('01-11-1435', 'mi-mm-yyyy')
 AND D1.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND D1.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD
 AND EMPL_APPROVAL = 1
 AND ROWNUM = 1
 AND CARNET_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL
 AND dil_seq =
 (SELECT MAX (dil_seq)
 FROM dcltn_item_letrs
 WHERE port_cd = d3.port_cd
 AND item_isn = d3.item_isn);

 IF v_CARNET_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 UPDATE COLL_ORDERS
 SET CARNET_PORT_CD = V_CARNET_PORT_CD,
 IST_CARNET_ISN = V_IST_CARNET_ISN
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND COLL_ORDR_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR
 AND COLL_ORDR_DT = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 STANDARD.COMMIT;
 END IF;
 END;

 dcltn.chk_ret_reps (:dcltn_gate_trans.port_cd,
 :dcltn_gate_trans.dcltn_isn
 );

 IF v_ret_reps = 1
 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSIF v_ret_reps = 0
 THEN
 str.dispalert
 ('لا يمكن استكمال الإجراءات لأن محجوزات البيان غير مستلمة بالمستودعات',
 'ERROR'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE
 str.dispalert ('خطأ فني بالنظام لا يمكن استكمال الإجراءات',
 'ERROR'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 IF v_ret_reps = 1
 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSIF v_ret_reps IN (0, -1)
 THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE
 str.dispalert ('خطأ فني بالنظام لا يمكن استكمال الإجراءات',
 'ERROR'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;

--------------------------------------------------------

 THEN

 END IF;

---------------------------------

 THEN
 str.dispalert ('حالة البيان لا تسمح بفسحه', 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

 IF exist_strg_fees
 THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

 IF :dcltn_gate_trans.dgt_type = 2
 THEN
 IF :parameter.p_port_type = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_AIR')
 THEN
 IF can_clr_adlvy = FALSE
 THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :parameter.p_port_type IN
 (consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_SEA'),
 consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_DRY')
 )
 THEN
 IF can_clr_sdlvy = FALSE
 THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :dcltn_gate_trans.dgt_type IN (3, 5, 6)
 THEN
 IF :parameter.p_port_type = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_AIR')
 THEN
 IF can_clr_adlvy = FALSE
 THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

 get_aitem_remains (v_wt, v_pkg);
 ELSE

 THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

 get_sitem_remains (v_wt, v_pkg);
 END IF;

 IF :dcltn_gate_trans.clrd_wt > v_wt
 THEN

 RAISE form_trigger_failure;

 THEN
 str.dispalert ('الكمية أكبر من المسموح بفسحها', 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSIF ( :dcltn_gate_trans.clrd_wt = v_wt
 AND :dcltn_gate_trans.clrd_qty < v_pkg
 )
 THEN
 str.dispalert ('تم فسح الوزن بالكامل - ولم تفسح الكمية بالكامل',
 'ERROR'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSIF ( :dcltn_gate_trans.clrd_wt < v_wt
 AND :dcltn_gate_trans.clrd_qty = v_pkg
 )
 THEN
 str.dispalert ('تم فسح الكمية بالكامل - ولم يفسح الوزن بالكامل',
 'ERROR'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSIF (:dcltn_gate_trans.clrd_qty = 0)
 THEN

 RAISE form_trigger_failure;

 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :parameter.p_port_type = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_SEA')

 THEN

 get_shift_id (:dcltn_hdr.port_cd,
 :dcltn_gate_trans.shift_name);

 IF :dcltn_gate_trans.shift_id IS NULL

 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE

 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

---------------------------------------------------------
 v_cnt_mrk := NULL;

 IF :dcltn_gate_trans.dgt_type = 1
 THEN
 v_cnt_mrk :=
 xray_sea.xray_chk_dcln (:dcltn_gate_trans.port_cd,
 :dcltn_gate_trans.dcltn_isn
 );
 ELSIF :dcltn_gate_trans.dgt_type = 2
 THEN
 IF :parameter.p_port_type = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_AIR')
 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSIF :parameter.p_port_type IN
 (consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_SEA'),
 consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_DRY')
 )
 THEN
 v_cnt_mrk :=
 xray_sea.xray_chk_sdo (:dcltn_gate_trans.port_cd,
 :dcltn_gate_trans.sea_shpg_agnt_nbr,
 :dcltn_gate_trans.sea_dlvy_nbr,
 :dcltn_gate_trans.sea_dlvy_dt,
 :dcltn_gate_trans.dcltn_isn
 );
 END IF;
 ELSIF :dcltn_gate_trans.dgt_type = 3
 THEN
 v_cnt_mrk :=
 xray_sea.xray_chk_sdi (:dcltn_gate_trans.port_cd,
 :dcltn_gate_trans.sea_shpg_agnt_nbr,
 :dcltn_gate_trans.sea_dlvy_nbr,
 :dcltn_gate_trans.sea_dlvy_dt,
 :dcltn_gate_trans.sea_item_seq,
 :dcltn_gate_trans.dcltn_isn
 );
 END IF;

 IF v_cnt_mrk IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 v_cnt_mrk := CHR (1000) || v_cnt_mrk;
 v_ret :=
 intrface.flash_alert
 (v_cnt_mrk,
 'INFORMATION',
 1,
 'قائمة الحاويات التي لا تزال في الفحص بالإشعة',
 7.5,
 0.5,
 1,
 0.5,
 1300,
 'r255g0b0',
 12
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END;
END;

END IF;
END ;

DECLARE
 V_CUR_REC NUMBER;
 msg_lvl VARCHAR2 (5);

BEGIN
IF :parameter.p_curr_port_cd = 53 THEN

 BEGIN
 msg_lvl := :SYSTEM.message_level;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := '25';

 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO', enabled) = 'FALSE'
 THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO', enabled, property_true);
 END IF;

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO', navigable, property_true);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO', insert_allowed, property_true);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO', update_allowed, property_true);
 :SYSTEM.message_level := msg_lvl;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
 END;

END IF;

 V_CUR_REC := GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS', CURRENT_RECORD);
 IF GET_RECORD_PROPERTY(V_CUR_REC, 'DCLTN_GATE_TRANS', STATUS) IN ('NEW', 'INSERT') THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = DCLTN.PT_AIR THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_AIR') THEN
--&&& END
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.CLRNC_NOTE := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.CLRNC_NOTE;
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (DCLTN.PT_SEA, DCLTN.PT_DRY) THEN
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY')) THEN
--&&& END
 NULL;
 ELSE
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.CLRNC_NOTE := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.CLRNC_NOTE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 --by sherif --
 :DCLTN_CLRNC_NBR := :DCLTN_HDR.CLRNC_NBR;
 :DCLTN_CLRNC_DT := :DCLTN_HDR.CLRNC_DT;
 :DCLTN_CLRNC_NOTE := :DCLTN_HDR.CLRNC_NOTE;

-- POPULATE_DGT_TYPE; Yhelmy 14-06-2022--
--yasser hassan 14042022
 --VALIDATE_DGT_TYPE;

 ADJ_FUNS;

IF :parameter.p_curr_port_cd = 53
 AND NVL (:dcltn_hdr.final_ctry_cd, 100) <> 100
 AND :dcltn_hdr.DCLTN_ISN IS NULL THEN
 :dcltn_gate_trans.vhcl_trans_nbr := NULL;
 :dcltn_gate_trans.vhcl_trans_date := NULL;
 :dcltn_gate_trans.plate_no := NULL;
END IF;

IF :dcltn_sta_cd = 5 AND :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD = 53 THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = 1 AND :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD = 53 AND :DCLTN_HDR.FINAL_CTRY_CD <> 100 THEN
 IF ((is_fart_dcltn = 0 AND v_fart_setting = 1) OR v_fart_setting = 0) THEN -- FART_CR-9721
 IF get_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO',ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 go_item('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE');
 set_item_property('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO', NAVIGABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE );
 set_item_property('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE );
 set_item_property('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE );
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -- SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_NBR',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 -- SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_DATE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 ELSE
 IF get_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO',ENABLED) = 'FALSE'
 THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 END IF;
 -- SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_NBR',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 -- SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_DATE',PROPERTY_TRUE);
 END IF;
END IF;


END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-LISTVAL
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 V_DISP_LOV BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
IF :SYSTEM.MODE <> 'ENTER-QUERY' THEN
 IF Get_Record_Property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD,:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK,STATUS) IN ('NEW', 'INSERT') THEN
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, QUERY_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, QUERYABLE) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
IF NOT V_DISP_LOV THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 V_CHARS VARCHAR2(50) := 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ';
 V_NUMBERS VARCHAR2(50) := '0123456789';
 V_STR_TXT VARCHAR2(50);
 V_CURR_CHECK_STR VARCHAR2(50);
 V_BTRUE NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :System.TRIGGER_ITEM = :System.CURSOR_ITEM THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Value IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_STR_TXT := :System.Cursor_Value;
 V_BTRUE := 0;
 -- CHECK FIRST 4 CHARACTERS
 FOR I IN 1..4 LOOP
 IF INSTR(V_CHARS,SUBSTR(V_STR_TXT,I,1))= 0 THEN
 V_BTRUE := 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 -- CHECK THE FIFTH CHARACTER IS SPACE
 IF SUBSTR(V_STR_TXT,5,1)<> ' ' THEN
 V_BTRUE := 1;
 END IF;
 -- CHECK THE REMAIN CHARACTER LENGTH MORE THAN 4 AND IS NUMBER
 V_CURR_CHECK_STR := SUBSTR(V_STR_TXT,6);
 IF LENGTH(V_CURR_CHECK_STR) >= 4 THEN
 FOR I IN 6..LENGTH(V_STR_TXT) LOOP
 IF INSTR(V_NUMBERS,SUBSTR(V_STR_TXT,I,1))= 0 THEN
 V_BTRUE := 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 ELSE
 V_BTRUE := 1;
 END IF;
 IF V_BTRUE = 1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('رقم الحاوية غير صحيح','CFG_ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'أصناف اذن التسليم','أصناف بوليصة شحن' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'أصناف اذن التسليم','أصناف بوليصة شحن' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: KEY_CONTROL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE BODY KEY_CONTROL IS
PROCEDURE FOUND_KEY IS
BEGIN

:GLOBAL.V_INSERT :=1;
:GLOBAL.V_UPDATE :=1;
:GLOBAL.V_DELETE :=1;

DECLARE
 FLAG1 NUMBER := 0;
 V_UPDATE NUMBER := 0;
 V_DELETE NUMBER := 0;
 V_INSERT NUMBER := 0;

 CURSOR C_FK(VROLE VARCHAR2) IS

 SELECT RL_SYS_UPDATE,RL_SYS_INSERT,RL_SYS_DELETE
 FROM SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID
 AND ROLE_ID = VROLE
 AND SYS_TYPE IN (5,6);

 CURSOR C_ROLES IS
 SELECT DISTINCT ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_USER_ROLES SCUR
 WHERE USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND UR_ACTIVE = 1
 AND EXISTS(SELECT '1' FROM SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID =:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID
 AND ROLE_ID =SCUR.ROLE_ID)
 UNION
 SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SC_GROUP_ROLES SCGR,SC_USER_GROUPS SCUG
 WHERE SCUG.GROUP_ID = SCGR.GROUP_ID
 AND SCUG.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND SCUG.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND GR_ACTIVE = 1
 AND EXISTS(SELECT '1' FROM SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID =:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID
 AND ROLE_ID =SCGR.ROLE_ID)
 MINUS
 SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SC_USER_EXCLUDED_ROLES UER
 WHERE UER.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND UER.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND UER.UER_ACTIVE =1;
 vc varchar2(2000) ;
 vrol_password varchar2(200) ;
 V_ROLE VARCHAR2(2000);

BEGIN
 FOR J in c_roles LOOP
 FOR I IN C_FK(J.ROLE_ID)LOOP
 FLAG1 :=1;
 IF I.RL_SYS_INSERT =1 THEN V_INSERT := 1 ; END IF;
 IF I.RL_SYS_DELETE =1 THEN V_DELETE := 1 ; END IF;
 IF I.RL_SYS_UPDATE =1 THEN V_UPDATE := 1 ; END IF;

 END LOOP;
 END LOOP;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF FLAG1 =1 THEN
 IF V_INSERT = 0 THEN
 :GLOBAL.V_INSERT :=0;
 END IF;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_UPDATE = 0 THEN
 :GLOBAL.V_UPDATE :=0;
 END IF;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF V_DELETE =0 THEN
 :GLOBAL.V_DELETE :=0;
 END IF;

 END IF;
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
END;
 FK_DISPLAY;
END;



 PROCEDURE FK_DISPLAY IS
 BEGIN
 IF :GLOBAL.V_INSERT = 0 AND :GLOBAL.V_UPDATE = 0 THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('TOOLBAR.SAVE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 IF :GLOBAL.V_DELETE = 0 THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('TOOLBAR.REMOVE',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE KEY_CONTROL IS
 PROCEDURE FOUND_KEY ;
 PROCEDURE FK_DISPLAY ;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_REPORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE PRINT_REPORT(FN In VARCHAR2, PL_ID PARAMLIST, V_REP_FRM_FLG NUMBER, V_REP_PRNT_FLG NUMBER) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;


 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(500);
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);

 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;

 BEGIN
 IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD LIKE FN THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE = 6
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);

 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);

 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_REP_FRM_FLG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF V_REP_PRNT_FLG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('مسار ملف التقرير غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('ملف التقرير غير معرف داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END PRINT_REPORT;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXECUTE_FUNCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE Execute_Function(FN In VARCHAR2) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;
 CD_TITLE VARCHAR2(200);
 RET NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000);

 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 pl_id ParamList;
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);

 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;


 BEGIN
 IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 CD_TITLE := NAME_IN(FN);

 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).TITLE LIKE CD_TITLE AND TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).ACT = 1 THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE IN (5,6)
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list TMPLT_MOD_CALL IN TEMPLATE ', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);

 IF :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD <> 98 THEN
 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;
 END IF ;
 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_SYS_TYPE = 5 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSE
 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ ||'-'||V_SEQ_NO);
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).FORM_FLAG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PRNT_FLAG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');

 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;

 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||'TMPLT_MOD_CALL'||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('خطأ داخلي في أكواد الوظائف - إتصل بالمساندة الفنية' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END Execute_Function;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_EDI_ROLE_ID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHECK_EDI_ROLE_ID(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_USER_ID VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
V_ROLE_ID VARCHAR2(30);
BEGIN
BEGIN
 SELECT UR.ROLE_ID INTO V_ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_USER_ROLES UR
 WHERE UR.USER_ID = V_USER_ID
 AND UR.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND UR.UR_ACTIVE = 1
 AND UR.ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL'
 UNION
 SELECT GR.ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_GROUP_ROLES GR, SC_USER_GROUPS UG
 WHERE UG.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND UG.USER_ID = V_USER_ID
 AND GR.ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL'
 AND GR.GROUP_ID = UG.GROUP_ID
 AND GR.GR_ACTIVE = 1
 MINUS
 SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SC_USER_EXCLUDED_ROLES UER
 WHERE UER.USER_ID = V_USER_ID
 AND UER.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND UER.ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL'
 AND UER.UER_ACTIVE =1
 ;

 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN RETURN(FALSE);
END;
 IF V_ROLE_ID = 'EDIMSG_ALL' THEN
 RETURN(TRUE);
 ELSE
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EDI_MSG_LOV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE EDI_MSG_LOV IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'EDI_MSG_PARAM';
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'EDI MESSAGES');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'ROW_COUNT' , TEXT_PARAMETER,12);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_USER_NAME' , TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_JOB_ID' , TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD' , TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_USER_TYPE' , TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_USER_ID' , TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);

 CALL_FORM('EDIMSG1220.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

ProgramUnit.Name: FOR_EDI_MSG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE for_edi_msg(msg_count OUT NUMBER) IS
BEGIN
 /* ----OLD STATEMENT------
 select count(*) into msg_count
 from MSG_HDRS mh
 where msg_for_user.is_msg_for_usr(mh.MSG_ID,:parameter.p_user_id,:parameter.p_class_cd,:parameter.p_user_type) = 1
 AND MSG_DIRECTION = 1
 ;
 */
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 into msg_count
 FROM (
 SELECT /*+ FIRST_ROWS(10) INDEX_SS (mh MSG_HDRS_IDX_005) */ *
 FROM MSG_HDRS mh
 WHERE port_cd = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 and (MSG_DIRECTION = 1 AND MH.MSG_STAT =1) OR (MSG_DIRECTION = 1 AND MH.MSG_STAT =2)
 ) MSG_DATA
 WHERE lib_usr.msg_for_user.is_msg_for_usr(MSG_DATA.MSG_ID,:parameter.p_user_id,:parameter.p_class_cd,:parameter.p_user_type) = 1;




END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETURN_MSG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RETURN_MSG IS
 tim timer;

begin
 if Id_Null(Find_Timer('RETURN')) then

--Stop the Turn timer
 if not Id_Null(Find_Timer('TURN')) then
 Delete_Timer('TURN');
 end if;

 Tim := Create_Timer('RETURN', 10, REPEAT);
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: TURN_MSG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE TURN_MSG IS
 tim timer;

begin
 if Id_Null(Find_Timer('TURN')) then

--Stop the Return timer
 if not Id_Null(Find_Timer('RETURN')) then
 Delete_Timer('RETURN');
 end if;
 Synchronize;
 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 tim := Create_Timer('TURN', 10, REPEAT);
 end if;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: WHEN_TIMER_EXPIRED_MSG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE WHEN_TIMER_EXPIRED_MSG IS

 Timer_Expired varchar2(30);
 Tim timer;
 dummy varchar2(32);

begin
 Timer_Expired := Get_Application_Property(TIMER_NAME);
 if Timer_Expired = 'TURN' then
 dummy := To_Number(Get_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS));
 if dummy <= 5.5 then
 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS, 5.5);
 Delete_Timer('TURN');
 else
 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS,
 To_Number(Get_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS))-0.006);
 end if;

 :global.timer := 1;
 elsif Timer_Expired = 'RETURN' then
 if To_Number(Get_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS)) >= 8.5 then
--Stop this timer
 Delete_Timer('RETURN');
 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS, 8.5);
 else
 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS,
 To_Number(Get_View_Property('EDI_MSG', DISPLAY_X_POS))+0.006);
 end if;
 :global.timer := 2;
 END IF;
END;

/* CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS */

END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS */
PROCEDURE CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS IS
/* Read each lists values from its record group and populate the list */
 temp NUMBER; /* Return value of populate_group call */
 rg_id RECORDGROUP; /* Return value of populate_group call */
BEGIN
 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''DCLTN_PMT_METHOD'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_HDR.PMT_METHOD', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''DLVY_TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DLVY_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''MANIFEST TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_MFST_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''SHPMT TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.ADLVY_SHPMT_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''MFST_TYPES'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_MFST_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''MFST_TYPES'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('VC.MFST_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''DUTY_TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

END;

/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTNT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الجمرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_BUSID_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DGT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'A_DLVY_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هل السجل مدخل مسبقاً - أعد إدخال سجل جديد', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'A_DLVY_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(' لا يمكن إصدار إذن تسليم جديد - يوجد إذن تسليم لهذا الجزء من البوليصة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_DTL_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هل السجل مدخل مسبقاً - أعد إدخال سجل جديد', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هل السجل مدخل مسبقاً - أعد إدخال سجل جديد', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'PG_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز المنفذ,Gate Nbr' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VHTR_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'Trans Date H,Tran Seq,رمز الجمرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'GS_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'Shift Id,رمز المنفذ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDI_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'مسلسل الصنف على اذن التسليم,جمرك التسجيل' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VBI_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'المسلسل بالبوليصة,مسلسل البوليصة,رمز الم' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SVC_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'جمرك التسجيل,نوع المانفيست,رقم المانفيست' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SVCNTNR_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('عفوا..سبق تسجيل نفس العلامة المميزة للحاوية على نفس المانفيست', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VB_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'مسلسل البوليصة,رمز المنفذ,رقم المانفيست,' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VB_BL_NBR_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('لا يمكن تكرار الرقم الأصلي للبوليصة على نفس المانفيست', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDO_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'تاريخ اصدار الأذن,رقم وكيل الشحن,رقم اذن' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SVM_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز المنفذ,رقم المانفيست,تاريخ المانفيست' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VM_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('سبق تسجيل مانفيست لنفس الباخرة في نفس اليوم..تأكد من البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VM_ARVL_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('سبق تسجيل مانفيست لنفس الباخرة في نفس اليوم..تأكد من البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز المنفذ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BO_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رقم المالك,جمرك التسجيل,رقم المانفيست,نو' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SHAG_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رقم وكيل الشحن' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SHAG_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', '' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'VALID_DATE_NUMBER') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في عملية ترقيم البيان الجمركي - يجب وجود رقم وتاريخ في نفس الوقت', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES */
PROCEDURE CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES(
 P_CANVAS_LIST IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* List of displayed canvases */
 ,P_CURRENT_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2 /* Current canvas */
 ,P_BASE_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Base canvas */
/* Display the current canvas plus any others in the canvas list */
 canvas_list VARCHAR2(255); /* List of displayed canvases */
 canvas_to_raise VARCHAR2(255); /* Canvas to raise to the top */
BEGIN
 IF ( P_CURRENT_CANVAS = P_BASE_CANVAS) THEN
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 ELSE
 P_CANVAS_LIST := replace(P_CANVAS_LIST, P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',');
 IF ( get_view_property(P_BASE_CANVAS, VISIBLE) = 'FALSE') THEN
 canvas_list := P_CANVAS_LIST;
 WHILE (canvas_list IS NOT NULL) LOOP
 canvas_to_raise := substr(canvas_list, 1, instr(canvas_list, ','));
 canvas_list := replace(canvas_list, canvas_to_raise);
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(rtrim(canvas_to_raise, ','));
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CANVAS_LIST || P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 END IF;
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(P_CURRENT_CANVAS);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES */
PROCEDURE CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES(
 P_CURRENT_CANVAS IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Current canvas */
 ,P_BASE_CANVAS IN OUT VARCHAR2) IS /* Base canvas */
/* Find the canvases associated with the current canvas and record which */
/* base canvas is displayed in each window */
BEGIN
 IF ( P_CURRENT_CANVAS = 'CG$TAB_1') THEN
 P_CURRENT_CANVAS := 'CG$PAGE_1';
 END IF;
 IF ( P_current_canvas = 'CG$M_TAB_1') THEN
 P_base_canvas := 'CG$PAGE_1';
 ELSE
 P_BASE_CANVAS := P_CURRENT_CANVAS;
 END IF;
 IF (get_view_property(P_CURRENT_CANVAS, WINDOW_NAME) = 'CGSO$WINDOW_1') THEN
 :CG$CTRL.CG$WINDOWCGSO$WINDOW_1_PAGE := P_BASE_CANVAS;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS */
PROCEDURE CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(
 P_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Current canvas */
/* Raise the current canvas, plus any dependant canvases to the top */
BEGIN
 set_view_property(P_CANVAS, VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 IF ( P_CANVAS = 'CG$POPUP_1') THEN
 set_view_property('CG$TAB_1', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 END IF;
 IF ( P_canvas = 'CG$PAGE_1') THEN
 set_view_property('CG$M_TAB_1', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT */
PROCEDURE CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT IS
/* Top level canvas management procedure */
 current_canvas VARCHAR2(61) := get_item_property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ITEM_CANVAS);
 base_canvas VARCHAR2(61);
 canvas_list VARCHAR2(255);
BEGIN
 IF ( (:CG$CTRL.CG$LAST_CANVAS IS NULL) OR (:CG$CTRL.CG$LAST_CANVAS != current_canvas) ) THEN
 :CG$CTRL.CG$LAST_CANVAS := current_canvas;
 set_window_property( get_view_property( current_canvas, WINDOW_NAME ), VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES(current_canvas, base_canvas);
 IF ( base_canvas = 'CG$PAGE_1') THEN
 canvas_list := :CG$CTRL.CG$PAGE_1_LIST;
 END IF;
 CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES(canvas_list, current_canvas, base_canvas);
 IF ( base_canvas = 'CG$PAGE_1') THEN
 :CG$CTRL.CG$PAGE_1_LIST := canvas_list;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGBS$TOGGLE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGBS$TOGGLE */
PROCEDURE CGBS$TOGGLE(
 P_QUERY_MODE IN OUT VARCHAR2) IS /* Query Mode */
/* Toggle query mode between BSMON and BSMOFF, set all query mode items, */
/* display query mode message, set the relations and ensure that the */
/* canvas is coordinated. */
BEGIN
 /* Toggle the mode */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE != 'A') THEN
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 ELSE
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 END IF;
 /* Set all the items */
 CGBS$SET_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Display query mode messages */
 CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Set the relations */
 CGBS$.SET_RELATIONS( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* If the query mode is AutoQuery, coordinate outstanding blocks */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE = 'A') THEN
 CGBS$.COORD_VISIBLE_BLKS( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK );
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGBS$SET_QUERY_MODE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGBS$SET_QUERY_MODE */
PROCEDURE CGBS$SET_QUERY_MODE(
 P_QUERY_MODE IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Query Mode */
/* Set all query items to the current query mode */
BEGIN
 NULL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE */
PROCEDURE CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE(
 P_QUERY_MODE IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Query Mode */
/* Send a message to the status line indicating the current query mode */
BEGIN
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE = 'A') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('Auto-query mode on', 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('Auto-query mode off', 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: XRAY_CHK_SDO2
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
----------------------------------------------------------------
--XRAY_CHK_SDO
--DESCRIPTION : XRAY_CHK_SDO FOR SEA_DELVY_ORDERS
--PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARAF
--VERSION : 1.0
--DATE : 13/05/2005
----------------------------------------------------------------
FUNCTION XRAY_CHK_SDO2(V_PORT_CD NUMBER, V_SHPG_AGNT_NBR NUMBER, V_DO_NBR NUMBER, V_DO_ISS_DT DATE,V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 CURSOR DCLTN_CNTR_INSP IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, MFST_TYPE, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, CNTNR_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_CD, INSPCT_RESULT_CD, INSPCT_RMRKS, XRAY_IMAGE_FILE_NAME, XRAY_SCAN_ID, INSPCT_STA_CD, INSPCT_ACTN_DATE, INSPCT_ACTN_TIME, USER_ID, ENTRY_DATE_TIME FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VSCNIN
 WHERE (VSCNIN.INSPCT_STA_CD <> 2) AND
 (VSCNIN.PORT_CD, VSCNIN.MFST_TYPE, VSCNIN.MFST_NBR, VSCNIN.MFST_DT, VSCNIN.CNTNR_SEQ,VSCNIN.INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ) IN
 (
 SELECT VCI.PORT_CD, VCI.MFST_TYPE, VCI.MFST_NBR, VCI.MFST_DT, VCI.CNTNR_SEQ , VCI.INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS AD ,
 SEA_DLVY_ITEMS SDI ,
 VSSL_BL_ITEMS VBI ,
 VSSL_CNTNRS VSS_CNT ,
 VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VCI
 WHERE ( (AD.PORT_CD = SDI.PORT_CD )
 AND (AD.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR )
 AND (AD.DO_NBR = SDI.DO_NBR )
 AND (AD.DO_ISS_DT = SDI.DO_ISS_DT )
 --
 AND (SDI.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD )
 AND (SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = V_SHPG_AGNT_NBR )
 AND (SDI.DO_NBR = V_DO_NBR )
 AND (SDI.DO_ISS_DT = V_DO_ISS_DT )
 --
 AND (VBI.PORT_CD = SDI.MFST_PORT_CD )
 AND (VBI.MFST_TYPE = SDI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VBI.MFST_NBR = SDI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VBI.MFST_DT = SDI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VBI.BL_SEQ = SDI.BL_SEQ )
 AND (VBI.ITEM_SEQ = SDI.ITEM_SEQ )
 AND (VSS_CNT.PORT_CD = VBI.PORT_CD )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE = VBI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR = VBI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_DT = VBI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ = VBI.CNTNR_SEQ )
 AND (VSS_CNT.PORT_CD = VCI.PORT_CD )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE = VCI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR = VCI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_DT = VCI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ = VCI.CNTNR_SEQ )
 AND (AD.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD )
 AND (AD.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN )
 AND (VCI.INSPCT_ACTN_CD= 2 )
 AND (VCI.DCLTN_ISN =V_DCLTN_ISN OR VCI.DCLTN_ISN IS NULL) -- معاينة يدوية--
 )
 --GROUP BY VCI.CNTNR_SEQ, VCI.MFST_DT, VCI.MFST_NBR, VCI.MFST_TYPE, VCI.PORT_CD
 );
 V_CNTNR_MARK VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_RET BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
 V_RET :=TRUE;
 V_CNTNR_MARK :=NULL;
 IF :GLOBAL.MNUL_CNFRM_USR_EXIST ='Y' THEN
 FOR REC IN DCLTN_CNTR_INSP LOOP
 -- BY SHERIFT @KAS
 IF REC.CNTNR_SEQ IS NOT NULL AND DCLTN_CNTR_INSP%FOUND THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VSCNIN
 WHERE (VSCNIN.INSPCT_STA_CD <> 2)
 AND VSCNIN.PORT_CD = REC.PORT_CD
 AND VSCNIN.MFST_TYPE = REC.MFST_TYPE
 AND VSCNIN.MFST_NBR = REC.MFST_NBR
 AND VSCNIN.MFST_DT = REC.MFST_DT
 AND VSCNIN.CNTNR_SEQ = REC.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND VSCNIN.INSPCT_ACTN_CD =4
 --AND VSCNIN.INSPCT_RESULT_CD IN (1,3)
 ;
 IF V_COUNT=0 THEN
 V_RET :=FALSE;
 IF V_CNTNR_MARK IS NULL THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK := GET_CNTNR_MARK(REC.PORT_CD ,REC.MFST_TYPE , REC.MFST_NBR , REC.MFST_DT , REC.CNTNR_SEQ );
 ELSE
 V_CNTNR_MARK := V_CNTNR_MARK || CHR(10)|| GET_CNTNR_MARK(REC.PORT_CD ,REC.MFST_TYPE , REC.MFST_NBR , REC.MFST_DT , REC.CNTNR_SEQ );
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
END IF;
 IF NOT V_RET THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK := 'حاويات تتطلب تأكيد نتيجة فحصها يدويا' || CHR(10)|| V_CNTNR_MARK;
 END IF;
 RETURN V_CNTNR_MARK;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN NULL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: XRAY_CHK_SDO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
----------------------------------------------------------------
--XRAY_CHK_SDO
--DESCRIPTION : XRAY_CHK_SDO FOR SEA_DELVY_ORDERS
--PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARAF
--VERSION : 1.0
--DATE : 13/05/2005
----------------------------------------------------------------
FUNCTION XRAY_CHK_SDO(V_PORT_CD NUMBER, V_SHPG_AGNT_NBR NUMBER, V_DO_NBR NUMBER, V_DO_ISS_DT DATE,V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 CURSOR DCLTN_CNTR_INSP IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, MFST_TYPE, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, CNTNR_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_CD, INSPCT_RESULT_CD, INSPCT_RMRKS, XRAY_IMAGE_FILE_NAME, XRAY_SCAN_ID, INSPCT_STA_CD, INSPCT_ACTN_DATE, INSPCT_ACTN_TIME, USER_ID, ENTRY_DATE_TIME FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VSCNIN
 WHERE (VSCNIN.INSPCT_STA_CD <> 2) AND
 (VSCNIN.PORT_CD, VSCNIN.MFST_TYPE, VSCNIN.MFST_NBR, VSCNIN.MFST_DT, VSCNIN.CNTNR_SEQ,VSCNIN.INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ) IN
 (
 SELECT VCI.PORT_CD, VCI.MFST_TYPE, VCI.MFST_NBR, VCI.MFST_DT, VCI.CNTNR_SEQ , MAX (VCI.INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ)
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS AD ,
 SEA_DLVY_ITEMS SDI ,
 VSSL_BL_ITEMS VBI ,
 VSSL_CNTNRS VSS_CNT ,
 VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VCI
 WHERE ( (AD.PORT_CD = SDI.PORT_CD )
 AND (AD.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR )
 AND (AD.DO_NBR = SDI.DO_NBR )
 AND (AD.DO_ISS_DT = SDI.DO_ISS_DT )
 --
 AND (SDI.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD )
 AND (SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = V_SHPG_AGNT_NBR )
 AND (SDI.DO_NBR = V_DO_NBR )
 AND (SDI.DO_ISS_DT = V_DO_ISS_DT )
 --
 AND (VBI.PORT_CD = SDI.MFST_PORT_CD )
 AND (VBI.MFST_TYPE = SDI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VBI.MFST_NBR = SDI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VBI.MFST_DT = SDI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VBI.BL_SEQ = SDI.BL_SEQ )
 AND (VBI.ITEM_SEQ = SDI.ITEM_SEQ )
 AND (VSS_CNT.PORT_CD = VBI.PORT_CD )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE = VBI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR = VBI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_DT = VBI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ = VBI.CNTNR_SEQ )
 AND (VSS_CNT.PORT_CD = VCI.PORT_CD )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE = VCI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR = VCI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_DT = VCI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ = VCI.CNTNR_SEQ )
 AND (AD.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD )
 AND (AD.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN )
 AND (VCI.DCLTN_ISN =V_DCLTN_ISN OR VCI.DCLTN_ISN IS NULL)
 )
 GROUP BY VCI.CNTNR_SEQ, VCI.MFST_DT, VCI.MFST_NBR, VCI.MFST_TYPE, VCI.PORT_CD
 );

 V_CNTNR_MARK VARCHAR2(4000);
 V_CNTNR_MARK2 VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_CNTNR_MARK3 VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_CNT_MRK VARCHAR2(20);


 V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP BOOLEAN;
 V_TST_REC BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
 V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP := TRUE;
 V_CNTNR_MARK := NULL;

 FOR REC IN DCLTN_CNTR_INSP LOOP
 V_TST_REC := TRUE;
 -- BY SHERIFT UPON A.HASAN --
 IF REC.INSPCT_ACTN_CD IN (1,2,3,4) THEN
 IF NOT (REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 1 OR REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 3) THEN -- حالة أن نتيجة الفحص سليمة يمكن فسحها أو سليمة سحب عينات --
 V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP := FALSE ;
 V_TST_REC := FALSE;
 IF REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 0 OR REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 4 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 IF REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 2 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE -- REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 5 --
 NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE -- حالة دخول الحاوية فقط و لم تفحص بعد--
 V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP := FALSE ;
 V_TST_REC := FALSE;
 END IF;
 IF NOT V_TST_REC THEN
 IF V_CNTNR_MARK IS NULL THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK := GET_CNTNR_MARK(REC.PORT_CD ,REC.MFST_TYPE , REC.MFST_NBR , REC.MFST_DT , REC.CNTNR_SEQ );
 ELSE
 V_CNTNR_MARK := V_CNTNR_MARK || CHR(10)|| GET_CNTNR_MARK(REC.PORT_CD ,REC.MFST_TYPE , REC.MFST_NBR , REC.MFST_DT , REC.CNTNR_SEQ );
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -- TO CHK CONFIRM OR NOT BY SHERIFT 09/10/2005 --

 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_DT = VCI.MFST_DT )
