 V_CNTNR_MARK := V_CNTNR_MARK || CHR(10) || V_CNTNR_MARK3;
 END IF;
 IF V_CNTNR_MARK2 IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_CNTNR_MARK := V_CNTNR_MARK || CHR(10) || V_CNTNR_MARK2;
 END IF;
 RETURN V_CNTNR_MARK;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN NULL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: XRAY_CHK_CNTNR_CNFRM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION XRAY_CHK_CNTNR_CNFRM(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_MFST_TYPE NUMBER,V_MFST_NBR NUMBER,V_MFST_DT DATE,V_CNTNR_SEQ NUMBER)
 RETURN INTEGER IS
 V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD1 NUMBER;
 V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD2 NUMBER;
 I NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER:=0;
 V_XRAY_CNFRM_USR_EXIST VARCHAR2(50);

 CURSOR vci_crsr1 IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, MFST_TYPE, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, CNTNR_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_CD, INSPCT_RESULT_CD, INSPCT_RMRKS, XRAY_IMAGE_FILE_NAME, XRAY_SCAN_ID, INSPCT_STA_CD, INSPCT_ACTN_DATE, INSPCT_ACTN_TIME, USER_PORT_CD, USER_ID, ENTRY_DATE_TIME
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = V_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = V_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = V_MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ = V_CNTNR_SEQ
 AND INSPCT_ACTN_CD=1;

 CURSOR vci_crsr2 IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, MFST_TYPE, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, CNTNR_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_CD, INSPCT_RESULT_CD, INSPCT_RMRKS, XRAY_IMAGE_FILE_NAME, XRAY_SCAN_ID, INSPCT_STA_CD, INSPCT_ACTN_DATE, INSPCT_ACTN_TIME, USER_PORT_CD, USER_ID, ENTRY_DATE_TIME
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = V_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = V_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = V_MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ = V_CNTNR_SEQ
 AND INSPCT_ACTN_CD=3
 ORDER BY INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ;
BEGIN

 IF :GLOBAL.XRAY_CNFRM_USR_EXIST ='Y' THEN
 FOR REC IN vci_crsr1 LOOP
 V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD1 := REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD;
 END LOOP;
 I :=0;
 FOR REC2 IN vci_crsr2 LOOP
 I := I+1;
 V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD2 := REC2.INSPCT_RESULT_CD;
 IF V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD1 = V_INSPCT_RESULT_CD2 AND I=1 THEN
 RET :=1;
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF RET = 0 AND I>1 THEN
 RET :=1;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET :=1;
 END IF;
 RETURN RET;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: XRAY_CHK_CNTNR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
----------------------------------------------------------------
--XRAY_CHK_CNTNR
--DESCRIPTION : XRAY_CHK_CNTNR FOR CNTNR
--PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARAF
--VERSION : 1.0
--DATE : 13/05/2005
----------------------------------------------------------------
FUNCTION XRAY_CHK_CNTNR(V_PORT_CD NUMBER, V_MFST_TYPE NUMBER, V_MFST_NBR NUMBER, V_MFST_DT DATE, V_CNTNR_SEQ NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
 CURSOR DCLTN_CNTR_INSP IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, MFST_TYPE, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, CNTNR_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_CD, INSPCT_RESULT_CD, INSPCT_RMRKS, XRAY_IMAGE_FILE_NAME, XRAY_SCAN_ID, INSPCT_STA_CD, INSPCT_ACTN_DATE, INSPCT_ACTN_TIME, USER_ID, ENTRY_DATE_TIME FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VSCNIN
 WHERE (VSCNIN.INSPCT_STA_CD <> 2) AND
 (VSCNIN.PORT_CD, VSCNIN.MFST_TYPE, VSCNIN.MFST_NBR, VSCNIN.MFST_DT, VSCNIN.CNTNR_SEQ,VSCNIN.INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ) IN
 (
 SELECT VCI.PORT_CD, VCI.MFST_TYPE, VCI.MFST_NBR, VCI.MFST_DT, VCI.CNTNR_SEQ , MAX (VCI.INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ)
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS AD ,
 SEA_DLVY_ITEMS SDI ,
 VSSL_BL_ITEMS VBI ,
 VSSL_CNTNRS VSS_CNT ,
 VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VCI
 WHERE ( (AD.PORT_CD = SDI.PORT_CD )
 AND (AD.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR )
 AND (AD.DO_NBR = SDI.DO_NBR )
 AND (AD.DO_ISS_DT = SDI.DO_ISS_DT )
 --
 AND (VSS_CNT.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE = V_MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR = V_MFST_NBR )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_DT = V_MFST_DT )
 AND (VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ = V_CNTNR_SEQ )
 --
 AND (VBI.PORT_CD = SDI.MFST_PORT_CD )
 AND (VBI.MFST_TYPE = SDI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VBI.MFST_NBR = SDI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VBI.MFST_DT = SDI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VBI.BL_SEQ = SDI.BL_SEQ )
 AND (VBI.ITEM_SEQ = SDI.ITEM_SEQ )
 AND (VSS_CNT.PORT_CD = VBI.PORT_CD )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE = VBI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR = VBI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_DT = VBI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ = VBI.CNTNR_SEQ )
 AND (VSS_CNT.PORT_CD = VCI.PORT_CD )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE = VCI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR = VCI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_DT = VCI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ = VCI.CNTNR_SEQ )
 AND (AD.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD )
 --AND (AD.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN )
 )
 GROUP BY VCI.CNTNR_SEQ, VCI.MFST_DT, VCI.MFST_NBR, VCI.MFST_TYPE, VCI.PORT_CD
 );


 CURSOR DCLTN_CNTR_INSP2 IS
 SELECT PORT_CD, MFST_TYPE, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, CNTNR_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ, INSPCT_ACTN_CD, INSPCT_RESULT_CD, INSPCT_RMRKS, XRAY_IMAGE_FILE_NAME, XRAY_SCAN_ID, INSPCT_STA_CD, INSPCT_ACTN_DATE, INSPCT_ACTN_TIME, USER_ID, ENTRY_DATE_TIME FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VSCNIN
 WHERE (VSCNIN.INSPCT_STA_CD <> 2) AND
 (VSCNIN.PORT_CD, VSCNIN.MFST_TYPE, VSCNIN.MFST_NBR, VSCNIN.MFST_DT, VSCNIN.CNTNR_SEQ,VSCNIN.INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ) IN
 (
 SELECT VCI.PORT_CD, VCI.MFST_TYPE, VCI.MFST_NBR, VCI.MFST_DT, VCI.CNTNR_SEQ , VCI.INSPCT_ACTN_SEQ
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS AD ,
 SEA_DLVY_ITEMS SDI ,
 VSSL_BL_ITEMS VBI ,
 VSSL_CNTNRS VSS_CNT ,
 VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VCI
 WHERE ( (AD.PORT_CD = SDI.PORT_CD )
 AND (AD.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR )
 AND (AD.DO_NBR = SDI.DO_NBR )
 AND (AD.DO_ISS_DT = SDI.DO_ISS_DT )
 --
 AND (VSS_CNT.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE = V_MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR = V_MFST_NBR )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_DT = V_MFST_DT )
 AND (VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ = V_CNTNR_SEQ )
 --
 AND (VBI.PORT_CD = SDI.MFST_PORT_CD )
 AND (VBI.MFST_TYPE = SDI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VBI.MFST_NBR = SDI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VBI.MFST_DT = SDI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VBI.BL_SEQ = SDI.BL_SEQ )
 AND (VBI.ITEM_SEQ = SDI.ITEM_SEQ )
 AND (VSS_CNT.PORT_CD = VBI.PORT_CD )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE = VBI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR = VBI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_DT = VBI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ = VBI.CNTNR_SEQ )
 AND (VSS_CNT.PORT_CD = VCI.PORT_CD )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE = VCI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR = VCI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_DT = VCI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ = VCI.CNTNR_SEQ )
 AND (AD.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD )
 --AND (AD.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN )
 AND (VCI.INSPCT_ACTN_CD= 2 ) -- معاينة يدوية--
 )
 --GROUP BY VCI.CNTNR_SEQ, VCI.MFST_DT, VCI.MFST_NBR, VCI.MFST_TYPE, VCI.PORT_CD
 );



 V_CNTNR_MARK VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_CNTNR_MARK2 VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP BOOLEAN;
 V_TST_REC BOOLEAN;
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
 V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP := TRUE;
 V_RET := 1;
 V_CNTNR_MARK := NULL;

 FOR REC IN DCLTN_CNTR_INSP LOOP
 V_TST_REC := TRUE;
 -- BY SHERIFT UPON A.HASAN --
 IF REC.INSPCT_ACTN_CD IN (1,2,3,4) THEN
 IF NOT (REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 1 OR REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD = 3) THEN -- حالة أن نتيجة الفحص سليمة يمكن فسحها أو سليمة سحب عينات --
 V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP := FALSE ;
 V_TST_REC := FALSE;
 END IF;
 ELSE -- حالة دخول الحاوية فقط و لم تفحص بعد--
 V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP := FALSE ;
 V_TST_REC := FALSE;
 V_RET := 0;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF NOT V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP THEN
 RETURN V_RET;
 ELSE
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOR REC IN DCLTN_CNTR_INSP2 LOOP
 IF REC.CNTNR_SEQ IS NOT NULL AND DCLTN_CNTR_INSP%FOUND THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VSCNIN
 WHERE (VSCNIN.INSPCT_STA_CD <> 2)
 AND VSCNIN.PORT_CD = REC.PORT_CD
 AND VSCNIN.MFST_TYPE = REC.MFST_TYPE
 AND VSCNIN.MFST_NBR = REC.MFST_NBR
 AND VSCNIN.MFST_DT = REC.MFST_DT
 AND VSCNIN.CNTNR_SEQ = REC.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND VSCNIN.INSPCT_ACTN_CD =4
 --AND VSCNIN.INSPCT_RESULT_CD IN (1,3)
 ;
 IF V_COUNT=0 THEN
 V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP :=FALSE;
 V_RET := 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF NOT V_TST_DCLTN_CNTR_INSP THEN
 --V_CNTNR_MARK := 'حاويات تتطلب تأكيد نتيجة فحصها يدويا' || CHR(10)|| V_CNTNR_MARK;--
 RETURN V_RET;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN V_RET;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN 1;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_VSSL_CNTNRS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE UPDATE_VSSL_CNTNRS(V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) IS
 CURSOR CR IS SELECT PORT_CD, MFST_TYPE, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, CNTNR_SEQ
 FROM VSSL_CNTNRS VSCN
 WHERE (VSCN.PORT_CD, VSCN.MFST_TYPE, VSCN.MFST_NBR, VSCN.MFST_DT, VSCN.CNTNR_SEQ) IN
 (
 SELECT VSS_CNT.PORT_CD, VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE, VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR, VSS_CNT.MFST_DT, VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS AD ,
 SEA_DLVY_ITEMS SDI ,
 VSSL_BL_ITEMS VSS ,
 VSSL_CNTNRS VSS_CNT
 WHERE ( (AD.PORT_CD = SDI.PORT_CD )
 AND (AD.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR )
 AND (AD.DO_NBR = SDI.DO_NBR )
 AND (AD.DO_ISS_DT = SDI.DO_ISS_DT )
 AND (VSS.PORT_CD = SDI.MFST_PORT_CD )
 AND (VSS.MFST_TYPE = SDI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VSS.MFST_NBR = SDI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VSS.MFST_DT = SDI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VSS.BL_SEQ = SDI.BL_SEQ )
 AND (VSS.ITEM_SEQ = SDI.ITEM_SEQ )
 AND (VSS_CNT.PORT_CD = VSS.PORT_CD )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE = VSS.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR = VSS.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_DT = VSS.MFST_DT )
 AND (VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ = VSS.CNTNR_SEQ )
 AND (AD.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD )
 AND (AD.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN )
 AND (NVL(VSS_CNT.CNTNR_STA_CD,0)<>1 )
 )
 );

BEGIN
 FOR I IN CR LOOP
 IF (AGT.CNTNR_HAS_REMAIN(I.PORT_CD,I.MFST_TYPE,I.MFST_NBR,I.MFST_DT,I.CNTNR_SEQ)=0) THEN
 UPDATE VSSL_CNTNRS
 SET CNTNR_STA_CD = 1
 WHERE PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = I.MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = I.MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = I.MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ = I.CNTNR_SEQ
 ;
 -- DM-364B Mohamed Shehata 15-12-2018
 -- call the cntnr_movment procedure to insert a record in cntnrs_movments table
 IF NVL(gnrl.get_customs_setting(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'CNTNR_MOVMENT_DM364',18),0) = 1 THEN /* Central By Nasser 13-03-2025 */
 DECLARE
 p_message_code NUMBER;
 p_message_desc VARCHAR2(200);
 v_cntnr_mrk VARCHAR2(25);
 v_cntnr_type_cd NUMBER(2);
 BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT cntnr_mrk,cntnr_type_cd
 INTO v_cntnr_mrk,v_cntnr_type_cd
 FROM vssl_cntnrs
 WHERE PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = I.MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = I.MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = I.MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_SEQ = I.CNTNR_SEQ
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 --
 IF v_cntnr_mrk IS NOT NULL THEN
 sea_shpmt.cntnr_movment(i.port_cd,v_cntnr_mrk,v_cntnr_type_cd,3,10,p_message_code,p_message_desc);
 END IF;
 --forms_ddl('commit');
 end;
 end if;
 ------- end DM-364B -----------
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_BARCODE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE UPDATE_BARCODE IS

V_COUNT NUMBER ;
v_DC_ITMS_BARCD_ISN NUMBER ;
v_new_SEQ number ;
CURSOR DCLN_ITM IS SELECT PORT_CD, ITEM_ISN, ITEM_SEQ, DCLTN_ISN, ITEM_BAR_CODE ,FINAL_TARIFF_CD,CTRY_CD, ITEM_DESC FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DCLNM WHERE DCLNM.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN AND DCLNM.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD AND ITEM_BAR_CODE IS NOT NULL ;
v_BRKR_PORT_CD NUMBER ;
BEGIN

SELECT BRKR_PORT_CD INTO v_BRKR_PORT_CD FROM DECLARATIONS DCLR WHERE DCLR.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD AND DCLR.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN ;

FOR i IN DCLN_ITM LOOP

BEGIN
SELECT DC_ITMS_BARCD_ISN INTO v_DC_ITMS_BARCD_ISN FROM DCLTN_ITEMS_BARCODE_HQ WHERE BAR_CODE = I.ITEM_BAR_CODE ;

SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT FROM DCLTN_ITEMS_BARCODE_HQ WHERE BAR_CODE = I.ITEM_BAR_CODE ;

IF V_COUNT >= 1 THEN

UPDATE DCLTN_ITEMS_BARCODE_HQ SET BRKR_PORT_CD = v_BRKR_PORT_CD , LIC_TYPE = :DCLTN_HDR.LIC_TYPE , LIC_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.LIC_NBR , IMPR_NBR = nvl(:DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR,:DCLTN_HDR.AGENT_NBR),
 TARIFF_CD = I.FINAL_TARIFF_CD , DCLTN_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD , DCLTN_ITEM_ISN = I.ITEM_ISN ,ORGN_CTRY_CD = I.CTRY_CD , ITEM_DESC = I.ITEM_DESC , UPD_DATE =SYSDATE
 WHERE BAR_CODE = I.ITEM_BAR_CODE ;

ELSIF V_COUNT = 0 THEN

select DC_ITMS_BARCD_SEQ.NEXTVAL@HQPRD.HQ.CUSTOMS.GOV INTO v_new_SEQ from DUAL ;

INSERT INTO DCLTN_ITEMS_BARCODE_HQ (DC_ITMS_BARCD_ISN, BAR_CODE, BRKR_PORT_CD, LIC_TYPE, LIC_NBR, IMPR_NBR, TARIFF_CD, DCLTN_PORT_CD, DCLTN_ITEM_ISN, ORGN_CTRY_CD, ITEM_DESC, CRT_DATE)
VALUES (v_new_SEQ , I.ITEM_BAR_CODE ,v_BRKR_PORT_CD , :DCLTN_HDR.LIC_TYPE, :DCLTN_HDR.LIC_NBR,nvl(:DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR,:DCLTN_HDR.AGENT_NBR),I.FINAL_TARIFF_CD,:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD ,I.ITEM_ISN,I.CTRY_CD , I.ITEM_DESC, SYSDATE );

END IF ;


EXCEPTION

WHEN OTHERS THEN

NULL;
END ;

END LOOP;


END ;

PROCEDURE update_air_dcltn
IS
 v_dsi_rlsd NUMBER;
 v_dgt_wt NUMBER;
 v_dgt_qty NUMBER;
 v_today DATE;
 v_count NUMBER := 0;
 v_count1 NUMBER := 0;

 CURSOR cr_air
 IS
 SELECT air_dlvy.dlvy_nbr dlvy_nbr, air_dlvy.dlvy_dt dlvy_dt,
 SUM (NVL (l_bld.arvd_qty, 0)) air_qty,
 SUM (NVL (l_bld.arvd_wt, 0)) air_wt
 FROM air_dlvy_orders air_dlvy, bill_dtls l_bld, bills l_bill
 WHERE air_dlvy.port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND air_dlvy.stmt_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn
 AND l_bld.mfst_year(+) = air_dlvy.mfst_year
 AND l_bld.mfst_type(+) = air_dlvy.mfst_type
 AND l_bld.shpmt_type(+) = air_dlvy.shpmt_type
 AND l_bld.bill_nbr(+) = air_dlvy.bill_nbr
 AND l_bld.port_cd(+) = air_dlvy.port_cd
 AND l_bld.carr_prefix(+) = air_dlvy.carr_prefix
 AND l_bld.mfst_nbr(+) = air_dlvy.mfst_nbr
 AND l_bld.bill_dt(+) = air_dlvy.bill_dt
 AND l_bill.carr_prefix(+) = l_bld.carr_prefix
 AND l_bill.bill_nbr(+) = l_bld.bill_nbr
 AND l_bill.bill_dt(+) = l_bld.bill_dt
 AND l_bill.port_cd(+) = l_bld.port_cd
 GROUP BY air_dlvy.dlvy_nbr, air_dlvy.dlvy_dt;
BEGIN
 v_today := hijdate.cur_hij_date;

 IF :dcltn_hdr.port_cd IS NOT NULL AND :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 FOR x IN cr_air
 LOOP
 v_count := 0;

 IF x.dlvy_nbr IS NOT NULL AND x.dlvy_dt IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM (clrd_wt), SUM (clrd_qty)
 INTO v_dgt_wt, v_dgt_qty
 FROM dcltn_gate_trans
 WHERE port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND air_dlvy_nbr = x.dlvy_nbr
 AND air_dlvy_dt = x.dlvy_dt
 AND dgt_type IN (3, 5, 6);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 v_count := 1;
 END;

 v_dgt_wt := NVL (v_dgt_wt, 0);
 v_dgt_qty := NVL (v_dgt_qty, 0);

 IF v_count = 0
 AND (x.air_wt <> v_dgt_wt OR x.air_qty <> v_dgt_qty)
 THEN
 v_count1 := 1;
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF v_count1 = 0
 THEN
 CHK_4WVRS1;
 BEGIN
 v_dsi_rlsd := consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DSI_RLSD');
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY ('DCLTN_HDR', update_allowed, property_true);

 BEGIN
 SELECT dcltn_sta_desc
 INTO :dcltn_st_dcltn_sta_desc
 FROM dcltn_status
 WHERE dcltn_type_cd = :dcltn_type_cd
 AND dcltn_sta_cd = :dcltn_sta_cd
 AND rec_status = 1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 BEGIN
 :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_sta_cd := v_dsi_rlsd;

 UPDATE declarations
 SET dcltn_sta_cd = v_dsi_rlsd,
 gate_dt = v_today
 WHERE dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn
 AND port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd;

 -- FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT'); stop commit in post insert Yhelmy CRQ11372
 SYNCHRONIZE;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY ('DCLTN_HDR', update_allowed, property_false);
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: TIME_TO_NUMBER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION TIME_TO_NUMBER(V_DT DATE) RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_RET NUMBER := NULL;
BEGIN
 IF V_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_RET := (TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(V_DT, 'HH24')) * 60) + TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(V_DT, 'MI'));
 END IF;

 RETURN (V_RET);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: START_SUPPORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE START_SUPPORT IS
MESSAGE_LEVEL NUMBER := :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL;
 DCLTN_STATUS NUMBER;
 ACTV_RET BOOLEAN;
 PKEY VARCHAR2(200);
 ALERT_MESSAGE VARCHAR2(1000);
 ALERT_RET NUMBER;
 PL_ID PARAMLIST;

BEGIN
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 25;
 IF NOT ID_NULL(FIND_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY')) THEN
 CLOSE_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 END IF;
 PL_ID := GET_PARAMETER_LIST('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 IF ID_NULL(PL_ID) THEN
 PL_ID := CREATE_PARAMETER_LIST('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 IF ID_NULL(PL_ID) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('Error creating parameter list SUPPORT_ENTRY','SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'WINDOW_X_POS',TEXT_PARAMETER,1.5);
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'WINDOW_Y_POS',TEXT_PARAMETER,2);
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'P_MODE',TEXT_PARAMETER,0);
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 CALL_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY.FMX',NO_HIDE,NO_REPLACE,NO_QUERY_ONLY,PL_ID);
 DESTROY_PARAMETER_LIST(PL_ID);
 IF :GLOBAL.LETTER_NBR IS NULL THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ALERT_MESSAGE := 'لقد أدخلت بيانات المساندة الفنية التالية' || CHR(10) || CHR(13);
 ALERT_MESSAGE := ALERT_MESSAGE || 'جمرك الخطاب: ' || :GLOBAL.PORT_NAME || CHR(10) || CHR(13);
 ALERT_MESSAGE := ALERT_MESSAGE || 'جهة الخطاب: ' || :GLOBAL.SUPP_TITLE_NAME || CHR(10) || CHR(13);
 ALERT_MESSAGE := ALERT_MESSAGE || 'رقم الخطاب: ' || :GLOBAL.LETTER_NBR || CHR(10) || CHR(13);
 ALERT_MESSAGE := ALERT_MESSAGE || 'تاريخ الخطاب: ' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(:GLOBAL.LETTER_DT),'MI-MM-RRRR') || CHR(10) || CHR(13);
 ALERT_MESSAGE := ALERT_MESSAGE || 'هل ترغب في إجراء المساندة الفنية وفق هذه البيانات؟';
 ALERT_RET := STR.DISPALERT(ALERT_MESSAGE,'USR_CONFIRM');
 IF ALERT_RET <> ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('Parameter list '||'SUPPORT_ENTRY'||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 DB_JOURNAL.JOURNALING_ON(:GLOBAL.PORT_CD,:GLOBAL.SUPP_TITLE_CD,:GLOBAL.LETTER_NBR,:GLOBAL.LETTER_DT);
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE SHOW_CLEARED_CNTRS(V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
/*
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM dcltn_gate_trans dgt,
 sea_dlvy_items sdi,
 vssl_bl_items vbi,
 vssl_cntnrs vc -- ,
 WHERE ( (sdi.port_cd = dgt.port_cd)
 AND (sdi.shpg_agnt_nbr = dgt.sea_shpg_agnt_nbr)
 AND (sdi.do_nbr = dgt.sea_dlvy_nbr)
 AND (sdi.do_iss_dt = dgt.sea_dlvy_dt)
 AND (sdi.prcsd_item_seq = dgt.sea_item_seq)
 AND (vbi.port_cd = sdi.mfst_port_cd)
 AND (vbi.mfst_type = sdi.mfst_type)
 AND (vbi.mfst_nbr = sdi.mfst_nbr)
 AND (vbi.mfst_dt = sdi.mfst_dt)
 AND (vbi.bl_seq = sdi.bl_seq)
 AND (vbi.item_seq = sdi.item_seq)
 AND (vc.port_cd = vbi.port_cd)
 AND (vc.mfst_type = vbi.mfst_type)
 AND (vc.mfst_nbr = vbi.mfst_nbr)
 AND (vc.mfst_dt = vbi.mfst_dt)
 AND (vc.cntnr_seq = vbi.cntnr_seq)
 AND (dgt.port_cd = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD)
 AND (dgt.DCLTN_ISN =V_DCLTN_ISN )
 );*/


 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM VSSL_CNTNRS VSCN
 WHERE (VSCN.PORT_CD, VSCN.MFST_TYPE, VSCN.MFST_NBR, VSCN.MFST_DT, VSCN.CNTNR_SEQ) IN
 (
 SELECT VSS_CNT.PORT_CD, VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE, VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR, VSS_CNT.MFST_DT, VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS AD ,
 SEA_DLVY_ITEMS SDI ,
 VSSL_BL_ITEMS VSS ,
 VSSL_CNTNRS VSS_CNT
 WHERE ( (AD.PORT_CD = SDI.PORT_CD )
 AND (AD.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR )
 AND (AD.DO_NBR = SDI.DO_NBR )
 AND (AD.DO_ISS_DT = SDI.DO_ISS_DT )
 AND (VSS.PORT_CD = SDI.MFST_PORT_CD )
 AND (VSS.MFST_TYPE = SDI.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VSS.MFST_NBR = SDI.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VSS.MFST_DT = SDI.MFST_DT )
 AND (VSS.BL_SEQ = SDI.BL_SEQ )
 AND (VSS.ITEM_SEQ = SDI.ITEM_SEQ )
 AND (VSS_CNT.PORT_CD = VSS.PORT_CD )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE = VSS.MFST_TYPE )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR = VSS.MFST_NBR )
 AND (VSS_CNT.MFST_DT = VSS.MFST_DT )
 AND (VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ = VSS.CNTNR_SEQ )
 AND (AD.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD )
 AND (AD.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN )
 AND (AGT.CNTNR_HAS_REMAIN( VSS_CNT.PORT_CD, VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE, VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR, VSS_CNT.MFST_DT, VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ )=0)
 )
 );



 :CLEARED_CNTNRS := V_COUNT ;

 :REMAINING_CNTNRS := :CNTNR_COUNT - :CLEARED_CNTNRS;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: LINK_WITH_VHTR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION LINK_WITH_VHTR RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 V_VAR_VALUE VARCHAR2(2000);
BEGIN
 V_VAR_VALUE := GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'LINK_WITH_VHTR',21); /* Central By Nasser 13-03-2025 */

 IF V_VAR_VALUE = '1' THEN
 RETURN(TRUE);
 END IF;

 -- TO FORCE LINKING WITH A CAR IF THIS IS A CROSSING DECLARATION 10-08-1428
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE <> CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_LND') AND
 :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD <> 53 AND
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1, 2) AND
 NVL(:DCLTN_HDR.FINAL_CTRY_CD, 100) <> 100 THEN
 RETURN(TRUE);
 END IF;

 RETURN(FALSE);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_VHTR_OK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION IS_VHTR_OK(V_PORT_CD IN NUMBER, V_TRAN_SEQ IN NUMBER, V_TRANS_DATE_H IN DATE,
 V_TRAN_DRCTN IN NUMBER, V_VHCL_TRAN_TYPE IN NUMBER, V_PSNGR_CARG IN NUMBER,
 V_PLATE_CTRY_CD IN NUMBER, V_ERR_MSG OUT VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
 v_fart_setting NUMBER := NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'BULK_DCLTN_CR9721',21),'0');
 v_fart_recs NUMBER;
BEGIN
 V_ERR_MSG := NULL;

 IF V_TRAN_DRCTN = 1 THEN -- خروج
 V_ERR_MSG := 'خطأ - أخر قيد حركة لهذه اللوحة هو قيد خروج. يجب تسجيل حركة دخول';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 IF V_PSNGR_CARG = 1 THEN -- ركاب
 V_ERR_MSG := 'خطأ - أخر قيد حركة لهذه اللوحة هو قيد دخول ركاب. يجب تسجيل حركة دخول شحن';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 IF V_VHCL_TRAN_TYPE = 5 THEN -- ترسيم مملكة
 NULL;
 ELSIF V_VHCL_TRAN_TYPE = 15 THEN -- نقل بضاعة من الجمرك
 /*
 IF V_PLATE_CTRY_CD <> 100 THEN
 V_ERR_MSG := 'خطأ - لوحة غير سعودية لها قيد دخول نوعه نقل بضاعة من الجمرك';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 */
 NULL;
 ELSIF V_VHCL_TRAN_TYPE = 11 AND :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD = 53 and NVL (:dcltn_hdr.final_ctry_cd, 100) <> 100 THEN -- نقل ترسيم
 NULL;
 ELSE
 ----------- cr-9721
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO v_fart_recs
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS SDO,SEA_DLVY_ITEMS DI,VSSL_BL_ITEMS BI--,DECLARATIONS DC
 WHERE SDO.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SDO.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DI.PORT_CD = SDO.PORT_CD
 AND DI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DI.DO_NBR = SDO.DO_NBR
 AND DI.DO_ISS_DT = SDO.DO_ISS_DT
 AND DI.MFST_PORT_CD = BI.PORT_CD
 AND DI.MFST_TYPE = BI.MFST_TYPE
 AND DI.MFST_NBR = BI.MFST_NBR
 AND DI.MFST_DT = BI.MFST_DT
 AND DI.BL_SEQ = BI.BL_SEQ
 AND DI.ITEM_SEQ = BI.ITEM_SEQ
 AND BI.CNTNR_SEQ IS NULL
 ;
 -----------
 --IF ((is_fart_dcltn = 0 AND v_fart_setting = 1) OR v_fart_setting = 0) THEN -- FART_CR-9721
 IF ((v_fart_recs = 0 AND v_fart_setting = 1) OR v_fart_setting = 0) THEN -- FART_CR-9721
 V_ERR_MSG := 'خطأ في نوع الحركة لقيد دخول هذه اللوحة';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;

IF :parameter.p_curr_port_cd = 53
 AND NVL (:dcltn_hdr.final_ctry_cd, 100) <> 100
 AND NVL(:GLOBAL.DEBA_DGT_TYPE_4,0) = 1 THEN
 V_ERR_MSG := '';
 :GLOBAL.DEBA_DGT_TYPE_4 := 0;
 RETURN 1;
 ELSE

 IF V_TRANS_DATE_H <> HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE THEN
 V_ERR_MSG := 'قيد الحركة ليس بتاريخ اليوم';
 END IF;
 END IF;

 DECLARE
 V_DCLTN_NBR NUMBER;
 V_DCLTN_DT DATE;
 V_TYPE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_CLRNC_DT DATE;
 BEGIN
 SELECT D.DCLTN_NBR, D.DCLTN_DT, DT.TYPE_NAME, DGT.CLRNC_DT
 INTO V_DCLTN_NBR, V_DCLTN_DT, V_TYPE_NAME, V_CLRNC_DT
 FROM DECLARATIONS D, DCLTN_TYPES DT, DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT
 WHERE DT.TYPE_ID = D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND D.PORT_CD = DGT.PORT_CD
 AND D.DCLTN_ISN = DGT.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DGT.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR = V_TRAN_SEQ
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE = V_TRANS_DATE_H
 AND ROWNUM = 1
 ORDER BY DGT.CLRNC_DT DESC
 ;
 IF V_ERR_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_ERR_MSG := V_ERR_MSG || CHR(13);
 END IF;
 V_ERR_MSG := V_ERR_MSG || 'قيد الحركة مربوط على فسح بتاريخ ';
 V_ERR_MSG := V_ERR_MSG || TO_CHAR(V_CLRNC_DT, 'MI-MM-YYYY');
 V_ERR_MSG := V_ERR_MSG || ' ل';
 V_ERR_MSG := V_ERR_MSG || V_TYPE_NAME;
 V_ERR_MSG := V_ERR_MSG || ' رقم ';
 V_ERR_MSG := V_ERR_MSG || V_DCLTN_NBR;
 V_ERR_MSG := V_ERR_MSG || ' وتاريخ ';
 V_ERR_MSG := V_ERR_MSG || TO_CHAR(V_DCLTN_DT, 'MI-MM-YYYY');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 RETURN 1;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_FART_DCLTN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION IS_FART_DCLTN RETURN NUMBER IS
 -- FART_TEST
 V_RECS NUMBER;
 V_DCLTN_DT DATE;
 V_SETTING_DT VARCHAR2 (30) := gnrl.get_customs_setting (:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD,'FART_XRAY_START_DT',21);
BEGIN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE <> 1 THEN
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
/*
 -- للتحقق أن استثناء الاشعة للسائب يتم على الحالات الجديدة بعد الاطلاق فقط
 SELECT D.DCLTN_DT
 INTO V_DCLTN_DT
 FROM DECLARATIONS D
 WHERE D.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD AND D.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF V_DCLTN_DT < TO_DATE (V_SETTING_DT, 'YYYY-MM-MI')
 THEN
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
*/
 ---- Enhance 02-08-2026 -- استثناء بيان الفرط ذات بنود مستثناء من الاشعة
 select count(*)
 into v_recs
 from dcltn_items i
 where i.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND i.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 and exists
 (
 select 1
 from DCLTN_XRY_TARIFF_EXCPTN_HQ
 where HRMNZD_CODE = i.final_tariff_cd
 and REC_STATUS = 1
 )
 ;
 IF v_recs > 0 THEN
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 ----- End Enhance -----------
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_RECS
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS SDO,SEA_DLVY_ITEMS DI,VSSL_BL_ITEMS BI--,DECLARATIONS DC
 WHERE SDO.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SDO.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DI.PORT_CD = SDO.PORT_CD
 AND DI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DI.DO_NBR = SDO.DO_NBR
 AND DI.DO_ISS_DT = SDO.DO_ISS_DT

 AND DI.MFST_PORT_CD = BI.PORT_CD
 AND DI.MFST_TYPE = BI.MFST_TYPE
 AND DI.MFST_NBR = BI.MFST_NBR
 AND DI.MFST_DT = BI.MFST_DT
 AND DI.BL_SEQ = BI.BL_SEQ
 AND DI.ITEM_SEQ = BI.ITEM_SEQ
 AND BI.CNTNR_SEQ IS NULL
 ;
 IF V_RECS > 0 THEN
 -- add this part to solve problem in NEOM port on 27-07-2026
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO v_recs
 FROM dcltn_sea_vhcl_trans
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 IF v_recs >= 1 THEN
 RETURN 1;
 ELSE
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ----
 RETURN 0;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: INSUR_SEAL_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE insur_seal_check IS
 -- CR-8767
 v_ret VARCHAR (100);
 v_count_seal NUMBER;
 v_err_msg VARCHAR (2000);
 v_dcltn_type_cd NUMBER;
 v_final_ctry_cd declarations.final_ctry_cd%type;
 v_brkr_port_cd declarations.brkr_port_cd%type;
 v_lic_type declarations.lic_type%type;
 v_lic_nbr declarations.lic_nbr%type;
 v_cl_val declarations.cl_val%type;
 v_port_type NUMBER;
 v_inspect_type_cd NUMBER(2);
 p_trans_type NUMBER := 0;
 --v_msg VARCHAR2 (2000);
BEGIN
 IF gnrl.get_customs_setting(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'KHALEG_ENHANCE_8767',21) = 1 THEN
 -- لمعرفة هل البيان فسح مباشر
 begin
 select inspect_type_cd
 into v_inspect_type_cd
 from dcltn_inspct_trans
 where port_cd = :DCLTN_HDR.port_cd
 and dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 and rownum = 1
 ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 v_inspect_type_cd := 1;
 end;
 --
 IF v_inspect_type_cd = 1 THEN -- فسح مباشر
 SELECT dcltn_type_cd,final_ctry_cd,brkr_port_cd,lic_type,lic_nbr
 INTO v_dcltn_type_cd,v_final_ctry_cd,v_brkr_port_cd,v_lic_type,v_lic_nbr
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :DCLTN_HDR.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 v_port_type := gnrl.get_customs_setting(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'PORT_TYPE',999);
 IF NOT (v_dcltn_type_cd = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.DT_IR') -- 2
 AND (v_brkr_port_cd IS NULL AND v_lic_type IS NULL AND v_lic_nbr IS NULL)
 AND v_final_ctry_cd <> 100
 AND (NVL (v_cl_val, 0) = 0))
 THEN
 IF v_port_type = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_LND') AND v_final_ctry_cd <> 100 THEN
 IF dcltn.get_vhtr_seal (:DCLTN_HDR.port_cd,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,v_count_seal,v_err_msg) = 0 THEN
 IF v_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN
 v_err_msg := 'يجب ادخال أرقام الرصاص';
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 /*
 ELSE
 IF v_count_seal > 0 THEN
 v_count_seal := v_count_seal * 4; -- hatem 1-4-1437
 IF v_count_seal > 24 THEN
 v_count_seal := 24;
 END IF;
 IF trnst.dec_trnst_brkr_seal (v_brkr_port_cd,v_lic_type,v_lic_nbr,v_count_seal,:DCLTN_HDR.port_cd,v_err_msg,p_trans_type) = 0 THEN
 if v_err_msg is not null then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 */
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GOTS_FILL_TBLS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION GOTS_FILL_TBLS(V_PORT_CD NUMBER,V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
 CURSOR CUR_ITEMS IS SELECT ITEM_DESC
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 ;

CURSOR CUR_BOX IS SELECT TRAN_SEQ,TRANS_DATE_H,BOX_NBR,DRIVER_MOBILE,GOTS_CTGRY
 FROM
 (
 SELECT VB.TRAN_SEQ,VB.TRANS_DATE_H,VB.BOX_NBR,VB.DRIVER_MOBILE,VB.GOTS_CTGRY
 FROM DCLTN_LAND_MNFST_TRANS DLMT, DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM,vhcl_boxes VB
 WHERE DLM.DCLTN_ISN = V_dcltn_isn
 AND dlm.port_cd = V_port_cd
 AND DLMT.PORT_CD = DLM.PORT_CD
 AND DLMT.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN = DLM.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN
 AND DLMT.PORT_CD = VB.PORT_CD
 AND DLMT.TRAN_SEQ = VB.TRAN_SEQ
 AND DLMT.TRANS_DATE_H = VB.TRANS_DATE_H
 UNION
 SELECT VB.TRAN_SEQ,VB.TRANS_DATE_H,VB.BOX_NBR,VB.DRIVER_MOBILE,VB.GOTS_CTGRY
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT,vhcl_boxes VB
 WHERE DGT.dcltn_isn = V_dcltn_isn
 AND dgt.port_Cd = V_port_cd
 AND DGT.PORT_CD = VB.PORT_CD
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR = VB.TRAN_SEQ
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE = VB.TRANS_DATE_H
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR IS NOT NULL
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE IS NOT NULL
 )
 ;

 G_DT DATE;
 V_DCLTN_NBR NUMBER;
 V_DCLTN_DT DATE;
 V_EXIT_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 V_ITEM_DESC VARCHAR2(200);
 V_ITEM_DESC_ALL VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_BOX_NBR VARCHAR2(10);
 V_TRANSACTION_GDT DATE;
 V_SEQ_NBR NUMBER;
 V_PLATE_NO VARCHAR2(30);
 V_PLATE_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
 V_PLATE_CITY_CD NUMBER;
 V_VHCL_CTGRY_GRP_CD NUMBER;
 V_PLATE_COLOR_CD NUMBER;
 V_DRIVER_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
 V_PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE DATE ;
 V_PSPRT_NO VARCHAR2(20);
 V_DRIVER_NAME VARCHAR2(60);
 V_LENGTH_ITEM NUMBER :=0 ;
 V_LENGTH_ALL_ITEM NUMBER :=0 ;
 V_LENGTH_DESC NUMBER :=0 ;
 V_CHNG_SEQ_NBR NUMBER;
 V_LOCKS_CNT NUMBER;
 V_EXTS_CNT NUMBER;

 V_MFR_CD NUMBER;
 V_MFR_DATE NUMBER;
 V_MODEL_CD NUMBER;
 V_COLOR_CD NUMBER;
 V_SECOND_CD_COLOR NUMBER;
 V_VHCL_CTGRY_CD NUMBER;
 V_VHCL_CHASSIS_NO VARCHAR2(29);

BEGIN
 G_DT := SYSDATE;
 SELECT DCLTN_NBR,DCLTN_DT,EXIT_PORT_CD
 INTO V_DCLTN_NBR,V_DCLTN_DT,V_EXIT_PORT_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 ;

 FOR CUR1 IN CUR_ITEMS LOOP
 V_ITEM_DESC := CUR1.ITEM_DESC ;
 IF V_ITEM_DESC_ALL IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_ITEM_DESC := '-' || V_ITEM_DESC;
 END IF;
 V_LENGTH_ITEM := LENGTH(V_ITEM_DESC);
 V_LENGTH_ALL_ITEM := V_LENGTH_ALL_ITEM + V_LENGTH_ITEM;

 IF V_LENGTH_ALL_ITEM < 2000 THEN
 V_ITEM_DESC_ALL := V_ITEM_DESC_ALL || V_ITEM_DESC;
 ELSE
 V_LENGTH_DESC := 2000 - LENGTH(V_ITEM_DESC_ALL);
 IF V_LENGTH_DESC >= 3 THEN
 V_ITEM_DESC_ALL := V_ITEM_DESC_ALL || '...';
 ELSE
 V_ITEM_DESC_ALL := V_ITEM_DESC_ALL;
 END IF;
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 FOR CUR2 IN CUR_BOX LOOP
 BEGIN
 SELECT BOX_NBR,TRANSACTION_GDT,CHNG_SEQ_NBR+1,EXTS_CNT
 INTO V_BOX_NBR,V_TRANSACTION_GDT,V_CHNG_SEQ_NBR,V_EXTS_CNT
 FROM GOTS_TRANS_BOXES
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND TRANS_SEQ = CUR2.TRAN_SEQ
 AND TRANS_DATE = CUR2.TRANS_DATE_H
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_BOX_NBR := NULL;
 V_CHNG_SEQ_NBR := 0;
 END;

 IF V_BOX_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT NVL(MAX(EX_SEQ_NBR),0)+1
 INTO V_SEQ_NBR
 FROM GOTS_TRANS_BOXES_EXT
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND BOX_NBR = V_BOX_NBR
 AND TRANSACTION_GDT = V_TRANSACTION_GDT
 ;

 INSERT INTO GOTS_TRANS_BOXES_EXT(PORT_CD,BOX_NBR,TRANSACTION_GDT,EX_SEQ_NBR,TRNST_TYPE,
 TRNST_NBR,TRNST_DT,EXIT_PORT_CD,SHPMNT_DESC,CHNG_SEQ_NBR)
 VALUES(V_PORT_CD,V_BOX_NBR,V_TRANSACTION_GDT,V_SEQ_NBR,1,
 V_DCLTN_NBR,V_DCLTN_DT,V_EXIT_PORT_CD,V_ITEM_DESC_ALL,V_CHNG_SEQ_NBR);
 UPDATE GOTS_TRANS_BOXES_EXT
 SET CHNG_SEQ_NBR = V_CHNG_SEQ_NBR
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND BOX_NBR = V_BOX_NBR
 AND TRANSACTION_GDT = V_TRANSACTION_GDT
 ;

 UPDATE GOTS_TRANS_LOCKS
 SET CHNG_SEQ_NBR = V_CHNG_SEQ_NBR
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND BOX_NBR = V_BOX_NBR
 AND TRANSACTION_GDT = V_TRANSACTION_GDT
 ;

 UPDATE GOTS_TRANS_BOXES
 SET CHNG_SEQ_NBR = V_CHNG_SEQ_NBR,EXTS_CNT = V_EXTS_CNT+1
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND BOX_NBR = V_BOX_NBR
 AND TRANSACTION_GDT = V_TRANSACTION_GDT
 ;

 ELSE
 SELECT VT.PLATE_NO,VT.PLATE_CTRY_CD,VT.PLATE_CITY_CD,VT.VHCL_CTGRY_GRP_CD,VT.COLOR_CD,VT.VHCL_CTGRY_CD,VT.VHCL_CHASSIS_NO,VT.DRIVER_CTRY_CD,VT.PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE,VT.PSPRT_NO,VD.DRIVER_NAME
 INTO V_PLATE_NO,V_PLATE_CTRY_CD,V_PLATE_CITY_CD,V_VHCL_CTGRY_GRP_CD,V_PLATE_COLOR_CD,V_VHCL_CTGRY_CD,V_VHCL_CHASSIS_NO,V_DRIVER_CTRY_CD,V_PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE,V_PSPRT_NO,V_DRIVER_NAME
 FROM VHCL_TRANSACTIONS VT, VHCL_DRIVERS VD
 WHERE VT.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND VT.TRANS_DATE_H = CUR2.TRANS_DATE_H
 AND VT.TRAN_SEQ = CUR2.TRAN_SEQ
 AND VD.CTRY_CD (+) = VT.DRIVER_CTRY_CD
 AND VD.PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE (+) = VT.PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE
 AND VD.PSPRT_NO (+) = VT.PSPRT_NO
 AND VD.DOC_TYPE (+) = VT.DOC_TYPE
 ;
 V_DRIVER_CTRY_CD := NVL(V_DRIVER_CTRY_CD, 0);
 V_PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE := NVL(V_PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE, SYSDATE);
 V_PSPRT_NO := NVL(V_PSPRT_NO, '-');
 V_DRIVER_NAME := NVL(V_DRIVER_NAME, '-');


 SELECT MFR_CD,MFR_DATE,MODEL_CD,COLOR_CD,SECOND_CD_COLOR INTO V_MFR_CD,V_MFR_DATE,V_MODEL_CD,V_COLOR_CD,V_SECOND_CD_COLOR
 FROM VEHICLS
 WHERE VHCL_CHASSIS_NO = V_VHCL_CHASSIS_NO
 ;

 INSERT INTO GOTS_TRANS_BOXES(PORT_CD,BOX_NBR,TRANSACTION_GDT,TRNST_TYPE,TRNST_NBR,TRNST_DT,TRANS_SEQ,
 TRANS_DATE,EXIT_PORT_CD,GOTS_CTGRY,PLATE_NO,PLATE_CTRY_CD,PLATE_CITY_CD,PLATE_COLOR_CD,CTGRY_GRP_CD,PLATE_CTGRY_CD,MFR_CD,MFR_DATE,MODEL_CD,COLOR_CD,SECOND_CD_COLOR,DRIVER_NAME,
 DRIVER_CTRY_CD,PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE,PSPRT_NO,DRIVER_MOBILE,SHPMNT_DESC,
 GOOID,GOTS_DATE_E,GOTS_DATE_X,CLERANCE_DT,CHNG_SEQ_NBR,EXTS_CNT)
 VALUES(V_PORT_CD,CUR2.BOX_NBR,G_DT,1,V_DCLTN_NBR,V_DCLTN_DT,CUR2.TRAN_SEQ,
 CUR2.TRANS_DATE_H,V_EXIT_PORT_CD,CUR2.GOTS_CTGRY,V_PLATE_NO,V_PLATE_CTRY_CD,V_PLATE_CITY_CD,V_PLATE_COLOR_CD,V_VHCL_CTGRY_GRP_CD,V_VHCL_CTGRY_CD,V_MFR_CD,V_MFR_DATE,V_MODEL_CD,V_COLOR_CD,V_SECOND_CD_COLOR,V_DRIVER_NAME,
 V_DRIVER_CTRY_CD,V_PSPRT_ISSUE_DATE,V_PSPRT_NO,CUR2.DRIVER_MOBILE ,V_ITEM_DESC_ALL,
 NULL,NULL,NULL, NULL,V_CHNG_SEQ_NBR,0);

 INSERT INTO GOTS_TRANS_LOCKS(PORT_CD, BOX_NBR, TRANSACTION_GDT, LOCK_NBR, LOCK_LOC_CD, EXIT_PORT_CD,
 GOOID, GOTS_DATE_E, GOTS_DATE_X, CHNG_SEQ_NBR)
 SELECT V_PORT_CD, CUR2.BOX_NBR, G_DT, LOCK_NBR, LOCK_LOC_CD, V_EXIT_PORT_CD,
 NULL, NULL, NULL, V_CHNG_SEQ_NBR
 FROM VHCL_LOCKS
 WHERE TRANS_DATE_H = CUR2.TRANS_DATE_H
 AND TRAN_SEQ = CUR2.TRAN_SEQ
 AND PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 ;

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_LOCKS_CNT
 FROM GOTS_TRANS_LOCKS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND BOX_NBR = CUR2.BOX_NBR
 AND TRANSACTION_GDT = G_DT
 ;

 UPDATE GOTS_TRANS_BOXES
 SET LOCKS_CNT = V_LOCKS_CNT
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND BOX_NBR = CUR2.BOX_NBR
 AND TRANSACTION_GDT = G_DT
 ;

 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN (1);
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN (0);
END GOTS_FILL_TBLS;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_VSSL_BLS_CLRD_WT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
UPDATE GET_VSSL_BLS_CLRD_WT()
DESCRIPTION: take Statistical Declaration into consideration
PROGRAMMER : Hesham
VERSION : 1
DATE : 2-2-2005
*/
FUNCTION GET_VSSL_BLS_CLRD_WT(BLS_REC VSSL_BLS%ROWTYPE) RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_TOT_WT NUMBER := 0;
 V_SDI_WT NUMBER;
 CURSOR CR_SDI IS SELECT SDI.*
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ITEMS SDI, VSSL_BLS B
 WHERE B.PORT_CD = BLS_REC.PORT_CD
 AND B.MFST_TYPE = BLS_REC.MFST_TYPE
 AND B.MFST_DT = BLS_REC.MFST_DT
 AND B.MFST_NBR = BLS_REC.MFST_NBR
 AND B.BL_SEQ = BLS_REC.BL_SEQ
 AND SDI.MFST_PORT_CD = B.PORT_CD
 AND SDI.MFST_TYPE = B.MFST_TYPE
 AND SDI.MFST_DT = B.MFST_DT
 AND SDI.MFST_NBR = B.MFST_NBR
 AND SDI.BL_SEQ = B.BL_SEQ
 ;
 SDI_REC SEA_DLVY_ITEMS%ROWTYPE;
 SDO_REC SEA_DLVY_ORDERS%ROWTYPE;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 V_STA NUMBER;
BEGIN
 OPEN CR_SDI;
 LOOP
 FETCH CR_SDI INTO SDI_REC;
 EXIT WHEN CR_SDI%NOTFOUND;

 SELECT *
 INTO SDO_REC
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = SDI_REC.PORT_CD
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDI_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = SDI_REC.DO_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = SDI_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 ;

 IF SDO_REC.DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = SDO_REC.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = SDO_REC.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DGT_TYPE = 1
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_CNT := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL(V_CNT, 0) <> 0 THEN
 V_TOT_WT := V_TOT_WT + SDI_REC.DLVRD_WT;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = SDO_REC.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = SDO_REC.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = SDO_REC.DO_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = SDO_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 AND DGT_TYPE = 2
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_CNT := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL(V_CNT, 0) <> 0 THEN
 V_TOT_WT := V_TOT_WT + SDI_REC.DLVRD_WT;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(CLRD_WT)
 INTO V_SDI_WT
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = SDO_REC.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = SDO_REC.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = SDO_REC.DO_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = SDO_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 AND SEA_ITEM_SEQ = SDI_REC.PRCSD_ITEM_SEQ
 AND DGT_TYPE IN (3, 5, 6)
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_SDI_WT := 0;
 END;

 V_TOT_WT := V_TOT_WT + NVL(V_SDI_WT, 0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSIF SDO_REC.STATS_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT STATS_STATUS
 INTO V_STA
 FROM STATS_DCLTNS
 WHERE PORT_CD = SDO_REC.PORT_CD
 AND STATS_ISN = SDO_REC.STATS_DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 IF V_STA = 7 THEN
 V_TOT_WT := V_TOT_WT + SDI_REC.DLVRD_WT;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 CLOSE CR_SDI;

 RETURN(V_TOT_WT);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_VHTR_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GET_VHTR_DATA IS
 CURSOR C(P_PLATE VARCHAR2, P_CTRY NUMBER, P_CITY NUMBER) IS SELECT PORT_CD, TRAN_SEQ, TRANS_DATE_H, TRAN_DRCTN,
 VHCL_TRAN_TYPE, PSNGR_CARG, PLATE_CTRY_CD
 FROM VHCL_TRANSACTIONS VHTR
 WHERE VHTR.PLATE_NO = P_PLATE
 AND (VHTR.PLATE_CTRY_CD = P_CTRY OR P_CTRY IS NULL)
 AND (VHTR.PLATE_CITY_CD = P_CITY OR P_CITY IS NULL)
 AND VHTR.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 ORDER BY VHTR.TRANS_DATE_H DESC, VHTR.TRAN_SEQ DESC
 ;
 C_REC C%ROWTYPE;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000) := NULL;
 V_RET VARCHAR(100);
 V_CHK NUMBER;
BEGIN
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_NBR := NULL;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_DATE := NULL;

 OPEN C(:DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO, NULL, NULL);
 FETCH C INTO C_REC;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ - لا يوجد قيد حركة لهذه اللوحة. يجب تسجيل حركة دخول', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;

 V_CHK := IS_VHTR_OK(C_REC.PORT_CD, C_REC.TRAN_SEQ, C_REC.TRANS_DATE_H, C_REC.TRAN_DRCTN,
 C_REC.VHCL_TRAN_TYPE, C_REC.PSNGR_CARG, C_REC.PLATE_CTRY_CD, V_MSG);
 IF V_CHK = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 IF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_MSG := V_MSG || CHR(13) || 'هل تريد الاستمرار؟';
 V_RET := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_MSG, 'WARNING', 1);
 IF V_RET <> ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_NBR := C_REC.TRAN_SEQ;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_DATE := C_REC.TRANS_DATE_H;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_US_FORCES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION GET_US_FORCES RETURN NUMBER
IS

 V_EX_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 V_EX_IMPR_NBR NUMBER;
 V_EX_FINAL_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
 V_EX_DCLTN_DT DATE;
 V_EX_DCLTN_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_RET_US_EXCEPTION NUMBER;
 v_wt NUMBER;
 v_pkg NUMBER;
BEGIN
 ---------------------AHMED MOMEN 20-08-2021 -------------DM-259--------------
 IF NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting (:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ,'US_FORCES_DISPATCH', 21), 0) = 1 /* Central By Nasser 13-03-2025 */
 THEN

 SELECT PORT_CD,
 IMPR_NBR,
 FINAL_CTRY_CD,
 DCLTN_DT,
 DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_EX_PORT_CD,
 V_EX_IMPR_NBR,
 V_EX_FINAL_CTRY_CD,
 V_EX_DCLTN_DT,
 V_EX_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :dcltn_gate_trans.port_cd
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :dcltn_gate_trans.DCLTN_ISN;


 V_RET_US_EXCEPTION :=
 DCLTN.CHECK_US_FORCES_IMPR (1,
 V_EX_PORT_CD,

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_SITEM_REMAINS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GET_SITEM_REMAINS(V_WT OUT NUMBER, V_PKG OUT NUMBER) IS
 V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 V_DGT_WT NUMBER;
 V_SDI_WT NUMBER;
 V_DGT_PKG NUMBER;
 V_SDI_PKG NUMBER;
BEGIN
 V_WT := NULL;
 V_PKG := NULL;

 IF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR IS NOT NULL AND
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR IS NOT NULL AND
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT IS NOT NULL AND
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT DLVRD_WT, DLVRD_QTY
 INTO V_SDI_WT, V_SDI_PKG
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT
 AND PRCSD_ITEM_SEQ = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN;
 END;

 V_SDI_WT := NVL(V_SDI_WT , 0);
 V_SDI_PKG := NVL(V_SDI_PKG, 0);

 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_ISN
 INTO V_DCLTN_ISN
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_WT := V_SDI_WT;
 V_PKG := V_SDI_PKG;
 RETURN;
 END;

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND DGT_TYPE = 1
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_CNT := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL(V_CNT, 0) <> 0 THEN
 V_WT := 0;
 V_PKG := 0;
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT
 AND DGT_TYPE = 2
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_CNT := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL(V_CNT, 0) <> 0 THEN
 V_WT := 0;
 V_PKG := 0;
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(CLRD_WT), SUM(CLRD_QTY)
 INTO V_DGT_WT, V_DGT_PKG
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT
 AND SEA_ITEM_SEQ = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ
 AND DGT_TYPE IN (3, 5, 6)
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_DGT_WT := 0;
 V_DGT_PKG := 0;
 END;
 V_DGT_WT := NVL(V_DGT_WT , 0);
 V_DGT_PKG := NVL(V_DGT_PKG, 0);

 V_WT := V_SDI_WT - V_DGT_WT;
 V_PKG := V_SDI_PKG - V_DGT_PKG;

 IF V_WT < 0 THEN
 V_WT := 0;
 END IF;

 IF V_PKG < 0 THEN
 V_PKG := 0;
 END IF;

 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_SHIFT_ID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION GET_SHIFT_ID(V_PORT_CD NUMBER, V_SHIFT_NAME OUT VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
 CURSOR CR_SHIFT(V_DATE DATE) IS SELECT *
 FROM GATE_SHIFTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND TO_CHAR(SHIFT_SDATE, 'YYYY-MM-MI') <= TO_CHAR(V_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-MI')
 ORDER BY SHIFT_STIME DESC
 ;
 V_TODAY DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 SHIFT_REC GATE_SHIFTS%ROWTYPE;
 V_NOW NUMBER;
 V_START NUMBER;
 V_END NUMBER;
 V_FOUND BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
 V_NOW := TIME_TO_NUMBER(SYSDATE);
 OPEN CR_SHIFT(V_TODAY);
 LOOP
 FETCH CR_SHIFT INTO SHIFT_REC;
 EXIT WHEN CR_SHIFT%NOTFOUND;

 V_START := TIME_TO_NUMBER(SHIFT_REC.SHIFT_STIME);
 V_END := TIME_TO_NUMBER(SHIFT_REC.SHIFT_ETIME);

 IF V_START < V_END THEN
 IF V_NOW >= V_START AND V_NOW <= V_END THEN
 V_FOUND := TRUE;
 END IF;
 ELSIF V_START > V_END THEN
 IF NOT(V_NOW > V_END AND V_NOW < V_START) THEN
 V_FOUND := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF V_FOUND = TRUE THEN
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 CLOSE CR_SHIFT;

 IF V_FOUND = FALSE THEN
 V_SHIFT_NAME := NULL;
 RETURN(NULL);
 END IF;

 V_SHIFT_NAME := SHIFT_REC.SHIFT_NAME;
 RETURN(SHIFT_REC.SHIFT_ID);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_LIST_INDEX
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION GET_LIST_INDEX(list_id VARCHAR2,list_element_to_add VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
 total_list_count NUMBER(2);
 loop_index_var NUMBER(2) := 1;
 list_element VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN
 total_list_count := Get_List_Element_Count(list_id);
 LOOP
 list_element := Get_List_Element_Value(list_id, loop_index_var);

 IF list_element_to_add = list_element THEN
 RETURN loop_index_var;
 END IF;
 EXIT WHEN list_element = list_element_to_add OR loop_index_var = total_list_count;
 loop_index_var := loop_index_var + 1;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN 0;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_GATE_NBR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION GET_GATE_NBR RETURN NUMBER IS
 HFILE TEXT_IO.FILE_TYPE;
 V_FILENAME VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_LINE VARCHAR2(2000);
 V_GATE_NBR NUMBER;
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT VAR_VALUE
 INTO V_FILENAME
 FROM SC_PORT_SETTING
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = 999
 AND VAR_NAME = 'GATE_FILENAME'
 AND PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD /* Central By Nasser 13-03-2025 */;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN(NULL);
 END;

 BEGIN
 HFILE := TEXT_IO.FOPEN(V_FILENAME, 'R');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN(NULL);
 END;

 BEGIN
 TEXT_IO.GET_LINE(HFILE, V_LINE);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 TEXT_IO.FCLOSE(HFILE);
 RETURN(NULL);
 END;

 TEXT_IO.FCLOSE(HFILE);
 V_GATE_NBR := TO_NUMBER(V_LINE);
 RETURN(V_GATE_NBR);

EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN(NULL);
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 2014/11/02 08:12 (Formatter Plus v4.8.8) */
PROCEDURE get_aitem_remains (v_wt OUT NUMBER, v_pkg OUT NUMBER)
IS
 v_dcltn_isn NUMBER;
 v_cnt NUMBER;
 v_dgt_wt NUMBER;
 v_air_wt NUMBER;
 v_dgt_qty NUMBER;
 v_air_qty NUMBER;
BEGIN
 v_wt := NULL;
 v_pkg := NULL;

 IF :dcltn_gate_trans.adlvy_nbr IS NOT NULL
 AND :dcltn_gate_trans.adlvy_dt IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT air_dlvy.stmt_isn, l_bld.arvd_qty, l_bld.arvd_wt
 INTO v_dcltn_isn, v_air_qty, v_air_wt
 FROM air_dlvy_orders air_dlvy, bill_dtls l_bld, bills l_bill
 WHERE air_dlvy.port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND air_dlvy.dlvy_nbr = :dcltn_gate_trans.adlvy_nbr
 AND air_dlvy.dlvy_dt = :dcltn_gate_trans.adlvy_dt
 AND l_bld.mfst_year(+) = air_dlvy.mfst_year
 AND l_bld.mfst_type(+) = air_dlvy.mfst_type
 AND l_bld.shpmt_type(+) = air_dlvy.shpmt_type
 AND l_bld.bill_nbr(+) = air_dlvy.bill_nbr
 AND l_bld.port_cd(+) = air_dlvy.port_cd
 AND l_bld.carr_prefix(+) = air_dlvy.carr_prefix
 AND l_bld.mfst_nbr(+) = air_dlvy.mfst_nbr
 AND l_bld.bill_dt(+) = air_dlvy.bill_dt
 AND l_bill.carr_prefix(+) = l_bld.carr_prefix
 AND l_bill.bill_nbr(+) = l_bld.bill_nbr
 AND l_bill.bill_dt(+) = l_bld.bill_dt
 AND l_bill.port_cd(+) = l_bld.port_cd;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 RETURN;
 END;

 v_air_wt := NVL (v_air_wt, 0);
 v_air_qty := NVL (v_air_qty, 0);

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_cnt
 FROM dcltn_gate_trans
 WHERE port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 AND dgt_type = 1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 v_cnt := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL (v_cnt, 0) <> 0
 THEN
 v_wt := 0;
 v_pkg := 0;
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_cnt
 FROM dcltn_gate_trans
 WHERE port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND air_dlvy_nbr = :dcltn_gate_trans.adlvy_nbr
 AND air_dlvy_dt = :dcltn_gate_trans.adlvy_dt
 AND dgt_type = 2;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 v_cnt := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL (v_cnt, 0) <> 0
 THEN
 v_wt := 0;
 v_pkg := 0;
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM (clrd_wt), SUM (clrd_qty)
 INTO v_dgt_wt, v_dgt_qty
 FROM dcltn_gate_trans
 WHERE port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND air_dlvy_nbr = :dcltn_gate_trans.adlvy_nbr
 AND air_dlvy_dt = :dcltn_gate_trans.adlvy_dt
 AND dgt_type IN (3, 5, 6);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 v_dgt_wt := 0;
 v_dgt_qty := 0;
 END;

 v_dgt_wt := NVL (v_dgt_wt, 0);
 v_dgt_qty := NVL (v_dgt_qty, 0);
 v_wt := v_air_wt - v_dgt_wt;
 v_pkg := v_air_qty - v_dgt_qty;

 IF v_wt < 0
 THEN
 v_wt := 0;
 END IF;

 IF v_pkg < 0
 THEN
 v_pkg := 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXTRACT_SEQ
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION EXTRACT_SEQ(V_REMAIN_SEL IN OUT VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_SEQ NUMBER := NULL;
 V_COMMA NUMBER;
 V_SEQ_TXT VARCHAR2(100);
BEGIN
 IF V_REMAIN_SEL IS NULL THEN
 RETURN(NULL);
 END IF;


 V_COMMA := INSTR(V_REMAIN_SEL, ',');
 IF V_COMMA > 0 THEN
 V_SEQ := TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(V_REMAIN_SEL, 1, V_COMMA - 1));
 V_REMAIN_SEL := SUBSTR(V_REMAIN_SEL, V_COMMA + 1);
 ELSE
 V_SEQ := TO_NUMBER(V_REMAIN_SEL);
 V_REMAIN_SEL := NULL;
 END IF;
 RETURN(V_SEQ);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXIT_IF_ANY_FART_INVALID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE exit_if_any_fart_invalid(p_tran_seq OUT NUMBER,p_msg_txt OUT VARCHAR2) IS
--CR-9721
 CURSOR c IS
 SELECT port_cd,TRAN_SEQ,TRANS_DATE_H
 FROM DCLTN_SEA_VHCL_TRANS
 WHERE dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND port_cd = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DGT_SEQ IS NULL
 ORDER BY 2
 ;
 O_MSG VARCHAR2(2000);
BEGIN
 IF NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'BULK_DCLTN_CR9721',21),'0') = 1 THEN
 IF is_fart_dcltn = 1 THEN
 FOR i IN c LOOP
 O_MSG := NULL;
 LIB_APX_USR.DCLTN_NONE_CNTNR_PKG.DCLTN_RELEASE_VALIDATION
 (
 i.PORT_CD,
 i.TRAN_SEQ,--:VHCL_TRANS_NBR,
 i.TRANS_DATE_H,--:VHCL_TRANS_DATE,
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,
 O_MSG -- OUT
 )
 ;
 IF O_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 p_tran_seq := i.TRAN_SEQ;
 p_msg_txt := O_MSG;
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXIST_STRG_FEES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION EXIST_STRG_FEES RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 RET_TOT_STRG_FEES NUMBER := 0;
 RET_ADD_STRG_FEES NUMBER := 0;
 RET_ADD_ORG_STRG_FEES NUMBER := 0;
 RET_TOT_HAND_FEES NUMBER := 0;
 RET_ADD_HAND_FEES NUMBER := 0;
 V_STRG_RET NUMBER := 0;
 V_MSG_LEVEL NUMBER;
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
 IS_MWANI_PORT BOOLEAN ; -- CR-7777
BEGIN
 IS_MWANI_PORT := lib_usr.MWANI.IS_MWANI_PORT( :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD ,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN);
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
/*V_STRG_RET := STRG.GET_DCLTN_STRG_FEES(:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE, :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN, FALSE,
 RET_TOT_STRG_FEES, RET_ADD_STRG_FEES, RET_TOT_HAND_FEES, RET_ADD_HAND_FEES, RET_ADD_ORG_STRG_FEES);*/
 V_MSG_LEVEL := TO_NUMBER(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL'));
 COPY(25, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
 V_STRG_RET := STRG.GET_DCLTN_STRG_FEES(:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE, :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN, 0,
 RET_TOT_STRG_FEES, RET_ADD_STRG_FEES, RET_TOT_HAND_FEES, RET_ADD_HAND_FEES, RET_ADD_ORG_STRG_FEES,
 V_MSG_TXT, :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID, :PARAMETER.P_WS_ID, HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE);
 COPY(V_MSG_LEVEL, 'SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL');
--&&& END
 IF V_STRG_RET = -1 AND NOT IS_MWANI_PORT THEN -- CR-7777 THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT, 'ERROR');
--&&& END
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن فسح المعاملة الجمركية - لا يمكن حساب أرضيات المعاملة - راجع قسم الحاسب الآلي','ERROR');
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;

 IF (RET_ADD_STRG_FEES + RET_ADD_ORG_STRG_FEES) <> 0 AND NOT IS_MWANI_PORT THEN -- CR-7777 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن فسح المعاملة الجمركية - توجد أرضيات مستحقة الدفع - راجع وحدة فسح الجمرك','ERROR');
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;

 RETURN FALSE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DCLTN_CLRD_SEA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION DCLTN_CLRD_SEA RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 CURSOR CR_SDO IS SELECT *
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 SDO_REC SEA_DLVY_ORDERS%ROWTYPE;
 V_RET BOOLEAN := TRUE;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 V_DGT_SUM NUMBER;
 V_SDO_SUM NUMBER;
BEGIN
 OPEN CR_SDO;
 LOOP
 FETCH CR_SDO INTO SDO_REC;
 EXIT WHEN CR_SDO%NOTFOUND;
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = SDO_REC.DO_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = SDO_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 AND SEA_ITEM_SEQ IS NULL
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_CNT := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL(V_CNT, 0) = 0 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(CLRD_WT)
 INTO V_DGT_SUM
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = SDO_REC.DO_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = SDO_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 AND SEA_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_DGT_SUM := 0;
 END;
 V_DGT_SUM := NVL(V_DGT_SUM, 0);

 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(DLVRD_WT)
 INTO V_SDO_SUM
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = SDO_REC.DO_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = SDO_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_SDO_SUM := 0;
 END;
 V_SDO_SUM := NVL(V_SDO_SUM, 0);

 IF V_DGT_SUM <> V_SDO_SUM THEN
 V_RET := FALSE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF V_RET = FALSE THEN
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 CLOSE CR_SDO;

 RETURN(V_RET);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CREATE_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CREATE_ITEMS(V_SEL VARCHAR2) IS
 V_PLATE_NO VARCHAR2(50) := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO;
 V_VTRAN_NBR NUMBER := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_NBR;
 V_VTRAN_DT DATE := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_DATE;
 V_NOTE VARCHAR2(2000) := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.CLRNC_NOTE;
 V_SDLVY_NBR NUMBER := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR;
 V_SDLVY_DT DATE := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT;
 V_AGENT_NBR NUMBER := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR;
 V_DGT_TYPE NUMBER := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE;
 V_FIRST_REC BOOLEAN := TRUE;
 V_REMAIN_SEL VARCHAR2(2000) := V_SEL;
 V_SEQ NUMBER;
 v_fart_tran_seq NUMBER := :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.fart_tran_seq;--CR-9721
BEGIN
 LOOP
 V_SEQ := EXTRACT_SEQ(V_REMAIN_SEL);
 IF V_SEQ IS NULL THEN
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 IF V_FIRST_REC = TRUE THEN
 V_FIRST_REC := FALSE;
 ELSE
 CREATE_RECORD;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PLATE_NO := V_PLATE_NO;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_NBR := V_VTRAN_NBR;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.VHCL_TRANS_DATE := V_VTRAN_DT;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE := V_DGT_TYPE;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.fart_tran_seq := v_fart_tran_seq;--CR-9721
 GO_ITEM('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE');
 NEXT_ITEM;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.CLRNC_NOTE := V_NOTE;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR := V_SDLVY_NBR;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT := V_SDLVY_DT;
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR := V_AGENT_NBR;
 GO_ITEM('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR');
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ := V_SEQ;

 GO_ITEM('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ');
 NEXT_ITEM;

 END LOOP;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 11/05/24 08:15:38 ? (QP5 v5.294) */
FUNCTION COLL_ORDER_PAYED (V_PORT_CD NUMBER, V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER)
 RETURN BOOLEAN
IS
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_COUNT_9 NUMBER;
 V_COUNT_1 NUMBER;
 v_sum NUMBER;
 P_DCLTN_NBR NUMBER;
 P_DCLTN_DT DATE;
 P_dcltn_type_cd NUMBER;
 V_IMPR_NBR NUMBER;
 v_curr_tot_amt NUMBER;
 v_used_amt NUMBER;
 v_port_cd99 NUMBER := 99;
 v_curr_tot_amt2 NUMBER;
 v_used_amt2 NUMBER;
 v_sysdate DATE;
 v_hijr_date DATE;
 v_text_msg VARCHAR2 (100);

 v_cr_port_cd NUMBER;
 v_cr_letr_nbr NUMBER;
 v_cr_letr_dt DATE;
 v_cr_letr_type NUMBER;

 CURSOR COOL_ORDERS_9 (V$PORT_CD NUMBER, V$DCLTN_ISN NUMBER)
 IS
 SELECT port_cd,
 coll_ordr_nbr,
 coll_ordr_dt,
 coll_ordr_ctgry,
 coll_ordr_sta
 FROM COLL_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V$PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V$DCLTN_ISN
 AND COLL_ORDR_STA = 1
 AND ( ( :DCLTN_HDR.PMT_METHOD IN (1, 2)
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY IN (1,
 2,
 3,
 4,
 5,
 6))
 OR (COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = 9));

 V_KARAR_TAHSEL_CAN_CLEAR NUMBER := 1; -- wakeel cr-6295
 V_KARAR_TAHSEL NUMBER
 := NVL (GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING (:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'KARAR_TAHSEL', 21), 0); -- wakeel cr-6295 /* Central By Nasser 13-03-2025 */
BEGIN
 IF NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting (:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'ALLOW_RLSE_CRDT_LTTR', 24), 0) = 1 /* Central By Nasser 13-03-2025 */
 THEN
 SELECT hijdate_db.to_hijri (SYSDATE) INTO v_sysdate FROM DUAL;

 SELECT DCLTN_NBR,
 DCLTN_DT,
 dcltn_type_cd,
 IMPR_NBR
 INTO P_DCLTN_NBR,
 P_DCLTN_DT,
 P_dcltn_type_cd,
 V_IMPR_NBR
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN;

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_COUNT_9
 FROM COLL_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND COLL_ORDR_STA = 9
 AND ( ( :DCLTN_HDR.PMT_METHOD IN (1, 2, 3)
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY IN (1,
 2,
 3,
 4,
 5,
 6))
 OR (COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = 9));

 IF V_COUNT_9 > 0
 THEN
 SELECT DISTINCT cr_port_cd,
 cr_letr_nbr,
 cr_letr_dt,
 cr_letr_type
 INTO v_cr_port_cd,
 v_cr_letr_nbr,
 v_cr_letr_dt,
 v_cr_letr_type
 FROM COLL_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND COLL_ORDR_STA = 9
 AND ( ( :DCLTN_HDR.PMT_METHOD IN (1, 2, 3)
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY IN (1,
 2,
 3,
 4,
 5,
 6))
 OR (COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = 9));

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_COUNT_1
 FROM COLL_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND COLL_ORDR_STA = 1
 AND ( ( :DCLTN_HDR.PMT_METHOD IN (1, 2)
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY IN (1,
 2,
 3,
 4,
 5,
 6))
 OR (COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = 9));

 IF V_COUNT_1 > 0
 THEN
 FOR I IN COOL_ORDERS_9 (V_PORT_CD, V_DCLTN_ISN)
 LOOP
 SELECT cc.curr_tot_amt, used_amt
 INTO v_curr_tot_amt, v_used_amt
 FROM credit_letters_hq cc
 WHERE cc.port_cd = v_cr_port_cd
 AND cc.CR_LETR_NBR = v_CR_LETR_NBR
 AND cc.CR_LETR_TYPE = v_CR_LETR_TYPE
 AND cc.cr_letr_dt = v_cr_letr_dt
 AND cc.CR_LETR_STA = 1
 AND cc.LETR_EXPRY_DT >= v_sysdate;

 SELECT NVL (SUM (cod.amt + cod.srce_port_amt), 0)
 INTO v_sum
 FROM coll_order_dtls cod
 WHERE cod.port_cd = i.port_cd
 AND cod.coll_ordr_nbr = i.coll_ordr_nbr
 AND cod.coll_ordr_dt = i.coll_ordr_dt
 AND cod.coll_ordr_ctgry = i.coll_ordr_ctgry;

 IF v_curr_tot_amt < NVL (v_sum, 0)
 THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 ELSE
 v_curr_tot_amt2 := v_curr_tot_amt - NVL (v_sum, 0);
 v_used_amt2 := v_used_amt + NVL (v_sum, 0);

 UPDATE credit_letters_hq cls
 SET cls.curr_tot_amt = v_curr_tot_amt2,
 cls.used_amt = v_used_amt2
 WHERE cls.port_cd = v_cr_port_cd
 AND cls.CR_LETR_NBR = v_CR_LETR_NBR
 AND cls.CR_LETR_TYPE = v_CR_LETR_TYPE
 AND cls.cr_letr_dt = v_cr_letr_dt
 AND cls.CR_LETR_STA = 1
 AND cls.LETR_EXPRY_DT >= v_sysdate;

 UPDATE coll_orders col
 SET col.coll_ordr_sta = 9,
 col.rcpt_type = 4,
 col.coll_dt = v_hijr_date,
 col.credit_clctn_dt = v_hijr_date,
 col.CR_PORT_CD = v_CR_PORT_CD,
 col.CR_LETR_NBR = v_CR_LETR_NBR,
 col.CR_LETR_DT = v_CR_LETR_DT,
 col.CR_LETR_TYPE = v_CR_LETR_TYPE
 WHERE port_cd = V_PORT_CD
 AND dcltn_isn = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND coll_ordr_sta = i.coll_ordr_sta
 AND col.coll_ordr_nbr = i.coll_ordr_nbr
 AND col.coll_ordr_dt = i.coll_ordr_dt
 AND col.coll_ordr_ctgry = i.coll_ordr_ctgry;

 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;

 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 IF V_KARAR_TAHSEL = 1
 THEN
 ------ TO CHECK ALL COLL ORDERS
 V_KARAR_TAHSEL_CAN_CLEAR :=
 dcltn.KARAR_TAHSEL_CLRNC_STANDARED (v_port_cd, v_dcltn_isn); --WAKEEL CR_6295 1 CAN CLAR 0 STOP

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM coll_orders
 WHERE port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 AND ( ( :DCLTN_HDR.PMT_METHOD IN (1, 2)
 AND coll_ordr_ctgry IN (1,
 2,
 3,
 4,
 5,
 6)
 AND coll_ordr_sta = 1)
 OR ( coll_ordr_ctgry = 9
 AND ( NVL (DCLTN_INV_TYPE, 0) <> 2
 AND coll_ordr_sta = 1))
 OR ( coll_ordr_ctgry = 9
 AND NVL (DCLTN_INV_TYPE, 0) = 2
 AND V_KARAR_TAHSEL_CAN_CLEAR = 0
 AND coll_ordr_sta = 1)); --WAKEEL CR_6295
 ELSE
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM COLL_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND COLL_ORDR_STA = 1
 AND ( ( :DCLTN_HDR.PMT_METHOD IN (1, 2)
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY IN (1,
 2,
 3,
 4,
 5,
 6))
 OR (COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = 9));
 END IF;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 ELSE
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF V_KARAR_TAHSEL = 1
 THEN
 ------ TO CHECK ALL COLL ORDERS
 V_KARAR_TAHSEL_CAN_CLEAR :=
 dcltn.KARAR_TAHSEL_CLRNC_STANDARED (v_port_cd, v_dcltn_isn); --WAKEEL CR_6295 1 CAN CLAR 0 STOP

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM coll_orders
 WHERE port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 AND ( ( :DCLTN_HDR.PMT_METHOD IN (1, 2)
 AND coll_ordr_ctgry IN (1,
 2,
 3,
 4,
 5,
 6)
 AND coll_ordr_sta = 1)
 OR ( coll_ordr_ctgry = 9
 AND ( NVL (DCLTN_INV_TYPE, 0) <> 2
 AND coll_ordr_sta = 1))
 OR ( coll_ordr_ctgry = 9
 AND NVL (DCLTN_INV_TYPE, 0) = 2
 AND V_KARAR_TAHSEL_CAN_CLEAR = 0
 AND coll_ordr_sta = 1)); --WAKEEL CR_6295
 ELSE
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM COLL_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 AND COLL_ORDR_STA = 1
 AND ( ( :DCLTN_HDR.PMT_METHOD IN (1, 2)
 AND COLL_ORDR_CTGRY IN (1,
 2,
 3,
 4,
 5,
 6))
 OR (COLL_ORDR_CTGRY = 9));
 END IF;

 IF V_COUNT > 0
 THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 ELSE
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLR_DCLTN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CLR_DCLTN
IS
 V_TODAY DATE;
 V_DSI_RLSD NUMBER;
 V_CNT NUMBER := NULL;
 V_EXIT_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 V_FINAL_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
 V_PORT_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_ADJ_VHCL_GOODS_FOR_DCLTN NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2 (200);
 v_track_seq NUMBER;
 ret NUMBER;
 v_msg_txt VARCHAR2 (500);
 v_count NUMBER;
 V_UN_CONFIRMED NUMBER := 0;
 v_err_msg VARCHAR2 (400);
BEGIN
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD = 34
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM sea_dlvy_orders
 WHERE port_cd = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_HDR.dcltn_isn
 AND vyg_mfst_nbr IS NULL
 AND (mfst_type != 7 OR do_iss_loc_cd != 2) -- Hotfix 07-04-2026
 ;

 IF v_count > 0
 THEN
 v_err_msg :=
 'لا يوجد رحلة قطار مرتبطة بأذن التسليم';
 STR.DISPALERT (v_err_msg, 'ERROR');
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK (NULL);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_UN_CONFIRMED
 FROM DCLTN_TRAIN_EXPTNS
 WHERE port_cd = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_HDR.dcltn_isn
 AND STRG_STATUS = 1;

 IF V_UN_CONFIRMED > 0
 THEN
 v_err_msg :=
 'لم يتم تأكيد احتساب الارضيات للمعاملة التي تم تحصيلها بدون ربط رحلة القطار';
 STR.DISPALERT (v_err_msg, 'ERROR');
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK (NULL);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 CHK_4WVRS1;
 V_TODAY := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 V_DSI_RLSD := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL ('DCLTN.DSI_RLSD');
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY ('DCLTN_HDR', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 --CR-9721 start
 declare
 v_tran_seq NUMBER;
 v_msg_txt VARCHAR2(2000);
 v_txt varchar2(2000);
 begin
 exit_if_any_fart_invalid(v_tran_seq,v_msg_txt);
 if v_tran_seq is not null and v_msg_txt is not null then
 v_txt := 'لا يمكن فسح البيان حيث';
 v_txt := v_txt||' '||v_msg_txt;
 v_txt := v_txt||' '||'رقم الشاحنة:';
 v_txt := v_txt||' '||v_tran_seq;
 str.dispalert(v_txt,'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END;
 --CR-9721 end

 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD := V_DSI_RLSD;

 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC
 INTO :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC
 FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY ('DCLTN_HDR', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);

 SELECT EXIT_PORT_CD, FINAL_CTRY_CD
 INTO V_EXIT_PORT_CD, V_FINAL_CTRY_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF V_FINAL_CTRY_CD <> 100 AND V_EXIT_PORT_CD IS NULL
 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT (
 'يجب إختيار جمرك خروج إذا كانت دولة المقصد غير السعودية',
 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 IF V_EXIT_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM (SELECT DLMT.PORT_CD, DLMT.TRANS_DATE_H, DLMT.TRAN_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_LAND_MNFST_TRANS DLMT, DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM
 WHERE DLMT.PORT_CD = DLM.PORT_CD
 AND DLMT.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN = DLM.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN
 AND DLM.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DLM.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 UNION
 SELECT DGT.PORT_CD, DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE, DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT
 WHERE DGT.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DGT.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR IS NOT NULL
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE IS NOT NULL);

 V_CNT := NVL (V_CNT, 0);

 IF V_CNT > 0
 THEN
 INSERT INTO DCLTN_TRANS_VHCLS (PORT_CD,
 DCLTN_ISN,
 TRANS_DATE_H,
 TRAN_SEQ,
 EXIT_PORT_CD)
 SELECT DLMT.PORT_CD,
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,
 DLMT.TRANS_DATE_H,
 DLMT.TRAN_SEQ,
 V_EXIT_PORT_CD
 FROM DCLTN_LAND_MNFST_TRANS DLMT, DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM
 WHERE DLMT.PORT_CD = DLM.PORT_CD
 AND DLMT.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN = DLM.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN
 AND DLM.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DLM.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 UNION
 SELECT DGT.PORT_CD,
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,
 DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE,
 DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR,
 V_EXIT_PORT_CD
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT
 WHERE DGT.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DGT.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR IS NOT NULL
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE IS NOT NULL;

 --------- ALAA FAWZY ----------------------
 /* IF DCLTN.TRANSFER_VHCL_TRANS_DATA(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,1,V_EXIT_PORT_CD) = -1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن تخزين وصف السيارات العابرة','ERROR');
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK(NULL);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 */

 /* -- a DB Trigger on DECLARATIONS will do the trick
 -- #@#@# FOR CLOSING
 UPDATE VHCL_TRANSACTIONS
 SET PORT_CD_EXIT = V_EXIT_PORT_CD
 WHERE (PORT_CD, TRANS_DATE_H, TRAN_SEQ) IN
 (SELECT DLMT.PORT_CD, DLMT.TRANS_DATE_H, DLMT.TRAN_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_LAND_MNFST_TRANS DLMT, DCLTN_LAND_MNFSTS DLM
 WHERE DLMT.PORT_CD = DLM.PORT_CD
 AND DLMT.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN = DLM.DCLTN_MNFST_ISN
 AND DLM.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DLM.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 UNION
 SELECT DGT.PORT_CD, DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE, DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS DGT
 WHERE DGT.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DGT.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_NBR IS NOT NULL
 AND DGT.VHCL_TRANS_DATE IS NOT NULL
 )
 ;

 */

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_TRANS_VHCLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT PORT_TYPE
 INTO V_PORT_TYPE
 FROM SD_PORTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_EXIT_PORT_CD;

 IF V_PORT_TYPE = 3
 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT (
 'لا توجد حركة مربوطة بالبيان',
 'ERROR');
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK (NULL);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT ('خطأ بنوع المنفذ', 'ERROR');
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK (NULL);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END;
 END IF;

 V_ADJ_VHCL_GOODS_FOR_DCLTN :=
 AGT.ADJ_VHCL_GOODS_FOR_DCLTN ( :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD,
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN);

 IF V_ADJ_VHCL_GOODS_FOR_DCLTN <> 1
 THEN
 /* NIHAD KHALIL FAGEM FOR SOLVE PROBLEM LENGTH OF FIELD DATE/10.06.2008*/
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY ('DCLTN_HDR', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD :=
 GET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD', DATABASE_VALUE);

 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC
 INTO :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC
 FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY ('DCLTN_HDR', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);

 IF V_ADJ_VHCL_GOODS_FOR_DCLTN = -1
 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT (
 'يوجد اصناف متعددة للبيان الجمركي تمنع من فسحه لذى يرجى فصله لأكثر من بيان',
 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT ('هناك خطأ في عملية الفسح',
 'ERROR');
 END IF;

 -------------------------------------------------------------------------

 ISSUE_ROLLBACK (NULL);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 IF DCLTN.GOTS_FILL_TBLS ( :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD,
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DCLTN_ISN) <> 1
 THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY ('DCLTN_HDR', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 STR.DispALERT (
 'لا يمكن تعبئة سجلات التتبع - لا يمكن إتمام عملية الفسح',
 'ERROR');
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK (NULL);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;


 --------NIHAD KHALIL FAGEM RETENTION LEFT

 IF DCLTN.STOP_CLR_RETENTION(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,V_MSG )=0 THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_HDR',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD',DATABASE_VALUE);
 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC
 INTO :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC
 FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD

 EXCEPTION

ProgramUnit.Name: CLR_ALL_SDLVY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CLR_ALL_SDLVY IS
 CURSOR CR_SDO IS SELECT *
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 SDO_REC SEA_DLVY_ORDERS%ROWTYPE;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 V_DGT_SUM NUMBER;
 V_SDO_SUM NUMBER;
 V_TODAY DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
BEGIN
 OPEN CR_SDO;
 LOOP
 FETCH CR_SDO INTO SDO_REC;
 EXIT WHEN CR_SDO%NOTFOUND;
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = SDO_REC.DO_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = SDO_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 AND SEA_ITEM_SEQ IS NULL
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_CNT := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL(V_CNT, 0) = 0 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(CLRD_WT)
 INTO V_DGT_SUM
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = SDO_REC.DO_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = SDO_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 AND SEA_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_DGT_SUM := 0;
 END;
 V_DGT_SUM := NVL(V_DGT_SUM, 0);

 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(DLVRD_WT)
 INTO V_SDO_SUM
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = SDO_REC.DO_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = SDO_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_SDO_SUM := 0;
 END;
 V_SDO_SUM := NVL(V_SDO_SUM, 0);

 IF V_DGT_SUM <> V_SDO_SUM THEN
 UPDATE SEA_DLVY_ORDERS
 SET CLRNC_DT = V_TODAY
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO_REC.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = SDO_REC.DO_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = SDO_REC.DO_ISS_DT
 ;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 CLOSE CR_SDO;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_VSSL_BLS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHK_VSSL_BLS IS
 CURSOR CR_BLS IS SELECT DISTINCT --B.*
 b.PORT_CD,b.MFST_TYPE,b.MFST_NBR,b.MFST_DT,b.BL_SEQ,b.
 DLVRY_PORT_CD,b.BL_STG_CD,b.OWNER_NBR,b.CTRY_CD,b.FRGN_PORT_CD,b.
 FRGN_PORT_TYPE_CD,b.SHPG_AGNT_NBR,b.DCLTN_ISN,b.BUYER_NBR,b.BL_NBR,b.
 BL_STA_CD,b.VB_TYPE,b.BL_SHPMT_GNRL_DESC,b.BL_TOT_ITEMS,b.BL_TOT_KG_WGT,b.
 SHPMT_TYPE_CD,b.BL_RMRKS,b.BL_SHPR_NAME,b.STRG_LOC_CD,b.BL_UNLD_DT,b.
 BL_CNTNRS_QTY,b.PNLTY_STA,b.CONS_ARBC_NAME,b.CONS_ENG_NAME,b.TONS_QTY,b.
 BARRELS_QTY,b.CNCNTRTN_LVL,b.OIL_UNLD_PORT_STA,b.DEST_PORT_CD,b.SRCE_SITE,b.
 STATS_DCLTN_ISN,b.EDI_STA_CD,b.EDI_ORG_STA_CD,b.ENDORSEMENT,b.ENDORSEMENT_DATE
 ,b.FRIEST_OWNER_NAME,b.BL_UNLD_TIME,b.PORT_CNTRCTR_CD
 ,TO_DATE(NULL) OPERATION_YARD_IN,TO_DATE(NULL) OPERATION_YARD_OUT
 ,TO_NUMBER(NULL) FRIGHT_FORWARDER_NBR,TO_NUMBER(NULL) PARENT_BL_SEQ -- as this 2 columns in designer and battest not in genport -- handeled by mohamed shehata cr-5040
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS SDO, SEA_DLVY_ITEMS SDI, VSSL_BLS B
 WHERE SDO.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SDO.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND SDI.PORT_CD = SDO.PORT_CD
 AND SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDO.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SDI.DO_NBR = SDO.DO_NBR
 AND SDI.DO_ISS_DT = SDO.DO_ISS_DT
 AND B.PORT_CD = SDI.MFST_PORT_CD
 AND B.MFST_TYPE = SDI.MFST_TYPE
 AND B.MFST_DT = SDI.MFST_DT
 AND B.MFST_NBR = SDI.MFST_NBR
 AND B.BL_SEQ = SDI.BL_SEQ
 ;
 BLS_REC VSSL_BLS%ROWTYPE;
 V_CLRD_WT NUMBER;
 V_BL_STA_CD NUMBER;
BEGIN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = DCLTN.PT_DRY THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY') THEN
 V_BL_STA_CD := 25;
--ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = DCLTN.PT_SEA THEN
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA') THEN
--&&& END
 V_BL_STA_CD := 5;
 END IF;


 OPEN CR_BLS;
 LOOP
 FETCH CR_BLS INTO BLS_REC;
 EXIT WHEN CR_BLS%NOTFOUND;

 V_CLRD_WT := GET_VSSL_BLS_CLRD_WT(BLS_REC);

 IF V_CLRD_WT >= BLS_REC.BL_TOT_KG_WGT THEN
 UPDATE VSSL_BLS
 SET BL_STA_CD = V_BL_STA_CD
 WHERE PORT_CD = BLS_REC.PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = BLS_REC.MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_DT = BLS_REC.MFST_DT
 AND MFST_NBR = BLS_REC.MFST_NBR
 AND BL_SEQ = BLS_REC.BL_SEQ
 ;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 CLOSE CR_BLS;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_US_FORCE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 22/08/2021 03:17:19 م (QP5 v5.294) */
PROCEDURE CHK_US_FORCE (p_mode NUMBER )
IS
 V_EX_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 V_EX_IMPR_NBR NUMBER;
 V_EX_FINAL_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
 V_EX_DCLTN_DT DATE;
 V_EX_DCLTN_TYPE_CD NUMBER;
 V_RET_US_EXCEPTION NUMBER;
 v_wt NUMBER;
 v_pkg NUMBER;
BEGIN
 ---------------------AHMED MOMEN 20-08-2021 -------------DM-259--------------
IF NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting (:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'US_FORCES_DISPATCH', 21), 0) = 1 /* Central By Nasser 13-03-2025 */
 THEN

 SELECT PORT_CD,
 IMPR_NBR,
 FINAL_CTRY_CD,
 DCLTN_DT,
 DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 INTO V_EX_PORT_CD,
 V_EX_IMPR_NBR,
 V_EX_FINAL_CTRY_CD,
 V_EX_DCLTN_DT,
 V_EX_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :dcltn_gate_trans.port_cd
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :dcltn_gate_trans.DCLTN_ISN;



 V_RET_US_EXCEPTION :=
 LIB_USR.DCLTN.CHECK_US_FORCES_IMPR (1,
 V_EX_PORT_CD,
 V_EX_IMPR_NBR,
 V_EX_FINAL_CTRY_CD,
 V_EX_DCLTN_DT,
 V_EX_DCLTN_TYPE_CD);

 IF V_RET_US_EXCEPTION =1 AND p_mode =1
 THEN
 ---------------------1----------********--------

 BEGIN
 IF :GLOBAL.air_partial_clear = 1
 AND :parameter.p_port_type =
 consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_AIR')
 AND :dcltn_gate_trans.dgt_type IN (3, 5, 6)
 THEN
 :dcltn_gate_trans.clrd_qty := :dcltn_gate_trans.aclrd_qty;
 :dcltn_gate_trans.clrd_wt := :dcltn_gate_trans.aclrd_wt;
 END IF;
 END;


 ----------------------2-------------
 IF :parameter.p_port_type = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_SEA')
 THEN
 IF :dcltn_gate_trans.shift_id IS NULL
 THEN
 :dcltn_gate_trans.shift_id :=
 get_shift_id (:dcltn_hdr.port_cd,
 :dcltn_gate_trans.shift_name);
 END IF;

 IF :dcltn_gate_trans.shift_id IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 SYNCHRONIZE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 ---------------------3--------------------------
 IF :dcltn_gate_trans.dgt_type IN (3, 5, 6)
 THEN
 IF :parameter.p_port_type = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_AIR')
 THEN
 get_aitem_remains (v_wt, v_pkg);
 ELSE
 get_sitem_remains (v_wt, v_pkg);
 END IF;

 --------------------4--------------------------------
 IF :dcltn_gate_trans.clrd_wt > v_wt
 THEN
 str.dispalert (
 'الوزن أكبر من المسموح بفسحه',
 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSIF :dcltn_gate_trans.clrd_qty > v_pkg
 THEN
 str.dispalert (
 'الكمية أكبر من المسموح بفسحها',
 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSIF ( :dcltn_gate_trans.clrd_wt = v_wt
 AND :dcltn_gate_trans.clrd_qty < v_pkg)
 THEN
 str.dispalert (
 'تم فسح الوزن بالكامل - ولم تفسح الكمية بالكامل',
 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSIF ( :dcltn_gate_trans.clrd_wt < v_wt
 AND :dcltn_gate_trans.clrd_qty = v_pkg)
 THEN
 str.dispalert (
 'تم فسح الكمية بالكامل - ولم يفسح الوزن بالكامل',
 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSIF (:dcltn_gate_trans.clrd_qty = 0)
 THEN
 str.dispalert (
 'الكمية المفسوحة تساوى صفر ',
 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSIF (:dcltn_gate_trans.clrd_wt = 0)
 THEN
 str.dispalert ('الوزن المفسوح يساوى صفر ',
 'ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 ---------------------5---------------------
 BEGIN
 IF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE = 1
 THEN
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DLVY_TYPE := NULL;
 ELSIF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE = 2
 THEN
 --&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
 -- IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = DCLTN.PT_AIR THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE =
 CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL ('DCLTN.PT_AIR')
 THEN
 --&&& END
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DLVY_TYPE := 1;
 --&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
 -- ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (DCLTN.PT_SEA, DCLTN.PT_DRY) THEN
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN
 (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL ('DCLTN.PT_SEA'),
 CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL ('DCLTN.PT_DRY'))
 THEN
 --&&& END
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DLVY_TYPE := 2;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DGT_TYPE IN (3, 5, 6)
 THEN
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DLVY_TYPE := 2;
 END IF;
 END;

 --------------------6------------------------------

 BEGIN
 SELECT MAX (DGT_SEQ) + 1
 INTO :DGT_SEQ
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF :DGT_SEQ IS NULL
 THEN
 :DGT_SEQ := 1;
 END IF;
 END;
 ------------------------------******---------------------------
 END IF;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT (
 'يوجد خطأ فى عملية الفسح لارسالية القوات الامريكية '
 || SQLERRM,
 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END;

---------------------********------------------------------------------------

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_TRANS_DCLTNS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE chk_trans_dcltns (v_port_cd NUMBER,v_dcltn_isn NUMBER ) IS
 v_dtran_seq NUMBER;
 v_d_cnt NUMBER;
 v_s_cnt NUMBER;
 v_dcltns VARCHAR2 (3000) := '';
 v_stats VARCHAR2 (3000) := '';
 v_msgs VARCHAR2 (3000) := '';
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT dlmt.tran_seq
 INTO v_dtran_seq
 FROM dcltn_land_mnfst_trans dlmt,
 dcltn_land_mnfsts dlm,
 declarations d
 WHERE d.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = v_dcltn_isn
 AND d.port_cd = dlm.port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = dlm.dcltn_isn
 AND dlm.port_cd = dlmt.port_cd
 AND dlm.dcltn_mnfst_isn = dlmt.dcltn_mnfst_isn
 AND ROWNUM = 1;

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_d_cnt
 FROM dcltn_land_mnfst_trans dlmt,
 dcltn_land_mnfsts dlm,
 declarations d
 WHERE dlmt.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND dlmt.tran_seq = v_dtran_seq
 AND d.port_cd = dlm.port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = dlm.dcltn_isn
 AND dlm.port_cd = dlmt.port_cd
 AND dlm.dcltn_mnfst_isn = dlmt.dcltn_mnfst_isn
 AND d.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 AND d.dcltn_sta_cd NOT IN (5, 9);

 IF v_d_cnt > 1
 THEN
 FOR drecord IN (SELECT d.port_cd port_cd,
 sd_ports.port_name port_name,
 d.dcltn_isn dcltn_isn ,D.DCLTN_NBR DCLTN_NBR ,D.DCLTN_DT DCLTN_DT
 FROM dcltn_land_mnfst_trans dlmt,
 dcltn_land_mnfsts dlm,
 declarations d,
 sd_ports
 WHERE dlmt.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND dlmt.tran_seq = v_dtran_seq
 AND sd_ports.port_cd = dlmt.port_cd
 AND d.port_cd = dlm.port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = dlm.dcltn_isn
 AND dlm.port_cd = dlmt.port_cd
 AND dlm.dcltn_mnfst_isn = dlmt.dcltn_mnfst_isn
 AND d.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 AND d.dcltn_sta_cd NOT IN (5, 9)
 )
 LOOP
 v_dcltns :=
 v_dcltns
 || ' اسم الجمرك : '
 || drecord.port_name
 || ' :رقم البيان '
 || drecord.dcltn_NBR
 || ' تاريخ البيان: '
 || drecord.dcltn_dt
 || CHR (10)
 || CHR (13);
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_s_cnt
 FROM stats_dcltns sd, stats_vhcls sv
 WHERE sv.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND sv.tran_seq = v_dtran_seq
 AND sd.port_cd = sv.port_cd
 AND sd.stats_isn = sv.stats_isn
 AND ROWNUM = 1;

 IF v_s_cnt >= 1
 THEN
 FOR srecord IN (SELECT sd.port_cd, sd_ports.port_name port_name,
 sd.stats_isn,sd.stats_NBR stats_NBR ,sd.stats_DT stats_DT
 FROM stats_dcltns sd, stats_vhcls sv, sd_ports
 WHERE sv.port_cd = v_port_cd
 AND sv.tran_seq = v_dtran_seq
 AND sd_ports.port_cd = sv.port_cd
 AND sd.port_cd = sv.port_cd
 AND sd.stats_isn = sv.stats_isn
 AND ROWNUM = 1)
 LOOP
 v_stats :=
 v_stats
 || ' اسم الجمرك : '
 || srecord.port_name
 || ' :رقم البيان '
 || srecord.stats_NBR
 || ' تاريخ البيان: '
 || srecord.stats_dt
 || CHR (10)
 || CHR (13);
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;

 IF v_d_cnt > 1 OR v_s_cnt >= 1
 THEN
 v_msgs :=
 ' هناك بيانات أخرى مربوطه على نفس الحركة '
 || CHR (10)
 || CHR (13)
 || ' بيـان جمركـي : '
 || CHR (10)
 || CHR (13)
 || v_dcltns
 || ' بيان إحصائي : '
 || CHR (10)
 || CHR (13)
 || v_stats;
 --str.dispalert (v_msgs, 'information');
 END IF;
END;
