ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_PRCDR_SFDA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHK_PRCDR_SFDA(V_PORT_CD NUMBER, V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER) RETURN INTEGER IS
V_COUNT NUMBER;
V_CHK NUMBER := 0;

BEGIN
SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT FROM SMPL_REQUESTS SR , SMPL_ITEMS SI
 WHERE SR.RQST_PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND SR.DCLTN_ISN = V_DCLTN_ISN
 --AND SR.REGISTER_TYPE IN (1,4)
 AND SR.LAB_CD IN (5,15)
 AND SI.RQST_PORT_CD = SR.RQST_PORT_CD
 AND SI.RQST_NMR = SR.RQST_NMR
 AND SI.RQST_DT = SR.RQST_DT
 AND NVL(sr.RQST_STATUS_CD,0) <> 9
 AND NVL(si.smpl_status,0) <> 9
 AND (SI.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN) NOT IN (SELECT ITEM_ISN FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DT , GROUP_ITEMS GIT WHERE SI.RQST_PORT_CD = DT.PORT_CD AND SI.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN = DT.ITEM_ISN AND DT.FINAL_TARIFF_CD = GIT.HRMNZD_CODE AND GIT.GRP_CODE = 76)
 AND (SI.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN) NOT IN (SELECT ITEM_ISN FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DT WHERE SI.RQST_PORT_CD = DT.PORT_CD AND SI.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN = DT.ITEM_ISN AND DT.DUTY_TYPE IN(7, 8,26))
 AND NVL(SI.RESULT_CD,0) IN (0, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9,10,11,13)
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WVR_ITEMS WI
 WHERE WVR_PORT_CD = SI.RQST_PORT_CD
 AND RQST_NMR = SI.RQST_NMR
 AND RQST_DT = SI.RQST_DT
 AND SMPL_NBR = SI.SMPL_NBR
 AND ITEM_TYPE_CD = 9
 AND NVL (wi.wvr_list_reason, 0) = 1)

 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 RETURN(0);
 ELSE
 RETURN(1);
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN(0);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_PIND_RSLT_CNTNR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE chk_pind_rslt_cntnr (p_port_cd NUMBER,
 p_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER,
 p_CNTNR_MRK VARCHAR2,
 p_clr_dcltn NUMBER,
 p_err_msg OUT VARCHAR2)
 IS -- mahmoud ali issa CR-6544
 v_port_cd NUMBER;
 v_mfst_type NUMBER;
 v_mfst_nbr NUMBER;
 v_mfst_dt DATE;
 v_cntnr_seq NUMBER;
 v_err_msg VARCHAR (2000);
 v_dummy NUMBER (1);
 v_pending_stage_cd NUMBER;
 v_isd_result NUMBER;
 v_ir_result NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 IF NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting (:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'ISD_XRY_RESULT_1', 18), 0) = 1 /* Central By Nasser 13-03-2025 */
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 1
 INTO v_dummy
 FROM DECLARATIONS a, dcltn_items b
 WHERE a.PORT_CD = b.PORT_CD
 AND a.DCLTN_ISN = b.DCLTN_ISN
 AND a.PORT_CD = p_port_cd
 AND a.DCLTN_ISN = p_DCLTN_ISN
 AND b.ISD_CHK IS NOT NULL
 AND ROWNUM = 1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 v_dummy := 0;
 END;
 IF v_dummy = 0
 THEN
 IF p_clr_dcltn = 2
 THEN
 agt.get_cntnr_from_mark (p_cntnr_mrk,
 v_port_cd,
 v_mfst_type,
 v_mfst_nbr,
 v_mfst_dt,
 v_cntnr_seq,
 v_err_msg);
 END IF;

 FOR i
 IN (SELECT UNIQUE vc.cntnr_seq,
 vc.mfst_dt,
 vc.mfst_nbr,
 vc.mfst_type,
 vc.CNTNR_MRK
 FROM declarations dc,
 sea_dlvy_orders sdo,
 sea_dlvy_items sdi,
 vssl_bl_items vbi,
 vssl_cntnrs vc
 WHERE dc.port_cd = sdo.port_cd
 AND dc.dcltn_isn = sdo.dcltn_isn
 AND sdi.PORT_CD = sdo.PORT_CD
 AND sdi.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = sdo.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND sdi.DO_NBR = sdo.DO_NBR
 AND sdi.DO_ISS_DT = sdo.DO_ISS_DT
 AND vbi.port_cd = sdi.mfst_port_cd
 AND vbi.MFST_TYPE = sdi.MFST_TYPE
 AND vbi.MFST_NBR = sdi.MFST_NBR
 AND vbi.MFST_DT = sdi.MFST_DT
 AND vbi.bl_SEQ = sdi.bl_SEQ
 AND vbi.item_SEQ = sdi.item_SEQ
 AND vc.port_cd = vbi.port_cd
 AND vc.MFST_TYPE = vbi.MFST_TYPE
 AND vc.MFST_NBR = vbi.MFST_NBR
 AND vc.MFST_DT = vbi.MFST_DT
 AND vc.cntnr_SEQ = vbi.cntnr_SEQ
 AND dc.port_cd = p_port_cd
 AND dc.DCLTN_ISN = p_DCLTN_ISN
 AND p_clr_dcltn = 1
 UNION
 SELECT v_cntnr_seq cntnr_seq,
 v_mfst_dt mfst_dt,
 v_mfst_nbr mfst_nbr,
 v_mfst_type mfst_type,
 p_cntnr_mrk CNTNR_MRK
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE p_clr_dcltn = 2)
 LOOP
 BEGIN

 SELECT PENDING_STAGE_CD,
 NVL (ISD_result, 0),
 NVL (IR_RESULT, 0)
 INTO v_pending_stage_cd, v_isd_result, v_ir_result
 FROM XRAY_PENDING_RESULTS a
 WHERE a.port_cd = p_port_cd
 AND a.cntnr_seq = i.cntnr_seq
 AND a.mfst_dt = i.mfst_dt
 AND a.mfst_nbr = i.mfst_nbr
 AND a.mfst_type = i.mfst_type
 AND request_type IN (5, 6)
 AND PENDING_STAGE_CD IN (5, 6) -- and ((PENDING_STAGE_CD = 5 and nvl(ISD_result,0) <> 2) or --- وسائل
 -- (PENDING_STAGE_CD = 6 and nvl(IR_RESULT ,0) <> 1)) --- تفتيش معاكس
 ;


 IF v_pending_stage_cd = 5
 THEN
 IF v_isd_result = 0
 THEN
 p_err_msg :=
 'توجد حاوية رقم '
 || i.CNTNR_MRK
 || ' محالة لقسم الوسائل الحية بنظام منافذ لم يتم تسجيل نتيجة لها ';
 ELSIF v_isd_result = 2
 THEN
 p_err_msg :=
 'لا يمكن الفسح .. نتيجة تفتيش الوسائل غير سليمة';
 END IF;
 ELSIF v_pending_stage_cd = 6
 THEN
 IF v_ir_result = 0
 THEN
 p_err_msg :=
 'توجد حاوية رقم '
 || i.CNTNR_MRK
 || ' محالة الى التفتيش المعاكس بنظام منافذ لم يتم تسجيل نتيجة لها';
 ELSIF v_ir_result = 2
 THEN
 p_err_msg :=
 'لا يمكن الفسح .. نتيجة التفتيش المعاكس غير سليمة';
 END IF;
 END IF;

 RETURN;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 RETURN;
 END;
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 p_err_msg := '1';

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_MANUAL_RSLTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHK_MANUAL_RSLTS (P_MSG OUT VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS -- AHMED WAKEEL dm_580
V_INSPECT_TYPE_CD NUMBER ;
V_FINAL_INSPCT_RESULT_CD NUMBER ;
V_INSP_ISN NUMBER ;
V_COUNTER NUMBER := 0;
V_PORT_TYPE NUMBER ;


CURSOR CUR_DTLS(P_PORT NUMBER ,P_INSP_ISN NUMBER )
IS SELECT INSPCT_RESULT_CD,TRAN_SEQ
FROM DCLTN_INSPCT_TRANS_DTLS
WHERE
PORT_CD = P_PORT AND INSP_ISN=P_INSP_ISN ;

V_DRCT_CLR_STG_DCLTN NUMBER := NVL(TO_NUMBER (gnrl.get_customs_setting (:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'DRCT_CLR_STG_DCLTN', 21)), 0); -- WAKEEL DIRECT CLEARANCE /* Central BY Nasser 13-03-2025 */

BEGIN
 SELECT PORT_TYPE INTO V_PORT_TYPE FROM SD_PORTS WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD;

 IF V_PORT_TYPE IN (3,4) AND V_DRCT_CLR_STG_DCLTN > 0 THEN

 SELECT INSPECT_TYPE_CD,FINAL_INSPCT_RESULT_CD,INSP_ISN
 INTO V_INSPECT_TYPE_CD,V_FINAL_INSPCT_RESULT_CD,V_INSP_ISN
 FROM DCLTN_INSPCT_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN= :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN ;

 IF V_INSPECT_TYPE_CD <> 1 THEN
 IF V_FINAL_INSPCT_RESULT_CD IS NULL THEN
 P_MSG :='لم يتم تسجيل نتيجة المعاينة اليدوية لهذا البيان';
 RETURN 0;
 ELSIF V_FINAL_INSPCT_RESULT_CD <> 1 THEN
 P_MSG :='نتيجة المعاينة اليدوية غير سليمة ';
 RETURN 0;
 ELSE
 FOR REC IN CUR_DTLS(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD,V_INSP_ISN)
 LOOP
 IF REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD IS NULL THEN
 P_MSG :='لابد من اختيار نتيجة معاينة للحركة رقم '||' '||REC.TRAN_SEQ;
 RETURN 0;
 ELSE
 IF V_FINAL_INSPCT_RESULT_CD = REC.INSPCT_RESULT_CD THEN
 V_COUNTER :=V_COUNTER+1 ;
 END IF ;
 END IF ;
 END LOOP ;
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = 3 THEN
 IF V_COUNTER =0 THEN
 P_MSG :='يوجد اختلاف بين نتيجة المعاينة للبيان ونتيجة المعاينة لحركة السيارات علي هذا البيان ...يرجي اختيار نتيجة واحدة علي الاقل لحركة السيارات مماثلة لنتيجة معاينة البيان';
 RETURN 0;
 END IF ;
 END IF ;
 RETURN 1 ;
 END IF ;
 ELSE
 RETURN 1 ;
 END IF ;
ELSE
RETURN 1 ;
END IF ;

EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN -1;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_INSTRUCTIONS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHK_INSTRUCTIONS RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 HAVE_INSTS BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 V_TODAY DATE;
 V_RET NUMBER;
 P_CODE NUMBER; -- CR-7284
 V_MSG VARCHAR2 (2000); -- CR-7284
 V_SETTING NUMBER ; --CR-7284
 V_RET_IKRAR NUMBER; -- CR-8257
BEGIN
 V_TODAY := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 -- CR-8257
 -- according to problem displayed and discussed between apex team and business
 -- there is a new function created identical to DCLTN.CHK_INSTRUCTIONS
 -- but not update on dcltn_suspns table
 IF NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting (:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'CR_8257', 21), 0) = 1 THEN --CR-8257 --Central by Nabil Orma
 --V_RET := DCLTN.CHK_INSTRUCTIONS_new(:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE,:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD, V_TODAY);----CR-8257
 V_RET_IKRAR :=
 DCLTN.DCLTN_INSTS_EMP_ACNLGMNT (:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE,
 :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD,
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD,
 V_TODAY);
 ELSE
 V_RET := DCLTN.CHK_INSTRUCTIONS(:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE, :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD, V_TODAY);
 END IF; --CR-8257
 ---- CR-8257 START
 IF V_RET_IKRAR = 1 THEN
 --HAVE_INSTS := TRUE;
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;
 ---- CR-8257 END

 IF V_RET = 1 THEN

 HAVE_INSTS := TRUE;



 V_SETTING := TO_NUMBER(NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING (:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'HAWKMA_INSTS', 21), 0)) ; /*central by Nasser 24-08-2025*/
 IF V_SETTING = 1 THEN
-- CR-7284 STRAT
 BEGIN

 LIB_USR.HAWKMA.CHK_INSTRUCTIONS_HAWKMA (
 P_PORT_CD => :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD,
 P_DCLTN_STATS_ISN => :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,
 STAG_SD => 5,
 P_DCLTN_STATS_TYPE => 1,
 P_CODE => P_CODE,
 P_MESSAGE => V_MSG);


IF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'INFORMATION');
END IF ;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;

 END ;
END IF ;
-- CR-7284 END
 UPDATE DECLARATIONS
 SET DCLTN_STA_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_INST')
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 ;
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 END IF;

 RETURN HAVE_INSTS;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_DCLTN_B4_DISPLAY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHK_DCLTN_B4_DISPLAY RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(500);
 V_GULF_DUTY NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER;
 V_CALC_DT DATE;
 V_GET_SETTING NUMBER;
 V_INSPECT_TYPE_CD NUMBER :=0; -- WAKEEL DM_580
 V_SND_RCV_STA NUMBER ; -- WAKEEL DM_580
 v_dcltn_type_cd NUMBER ; -- WAKEEL DM_580
 v_dcltn_nbr NUMBER ; -- WAKEEL DM_580
 v_dcltn_dt DATE ; -- WAKEEL DM_580
 v_lic_type NUMBER ; -- WAKEEL DM_580
 v_impr_nbr NUMBER ; -- WAKEEL DM_580
 v_agent_nbr NUMBER ; -- WAKEEL DM_580
 v_lic_nbr NUMBER ; -- WAKEEL DM_580
 v_brkr_port_cd NUMBER ; -- WAKEEL DM_580
 v_cl_val NUMBER ; -- WAKEEL DM_580
 v_final_ctry_cd NUMBER ; -- WAKEEL DM_580
 v_dcltn_land_mnfsts NUMBER ; -- WAKEEL DM_580
 V_DRCT_CLR_STG_DCLTN NUMBER := TO_NUMBER(NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting (:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'DRCT_CLR_STG_DCLTN', 21), 0)); -- WAKEEL DM_580 /* Central By Nasser 13-03-2025 */

BEGIN
 SELECT dcltn_type_cd,
 dcltn_nbr,
 dcltn_dt,
 lic_type,
 lic_nbr,
 brkr_port_cd,
 cl_val,
 final_ctry_cd

 INTO v_dcltn_type_cd,
 v_dcltn_nbr,
 v_dcltn_dt,
 v_lic_type,
 v_lic_nbr,
 v_brkr_port_cd,
 v_cl_val,
 v_final_ctry_cd
 FROM declarations
 WHERE port_cd = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD AND dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (1,2) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب ان يكون نوع البيان استيراد او تصفية','ERROR');
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD <> 5 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب ان تكون حالة البيان في مرحلة انتظار الفسح','ERROR');
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

--
 V_GET_SETTING := NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ,'PRE_CLRNC_ISSUE_CHK',21),0); /* Central By Nasser 13-03-2025 */
 IF V_GET_SETTING <> 1 THEN

 IF :DCLTN_HDR.CLRNC_NBR IS NULL OR :DCLTN_HDR.CLRNC_DT IS NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لم يتم إصدار اشعار الفسح لهذا البيان','ERROR');
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;
--
 IF DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 THEN
 CHECK_IMPORT_CARGO(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN);
 END IF;
 -- hot fix discussed related to stop message related to need print 16-03-2025
 IF NVL(gnrl.get_customs_setting(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'ALLOW_NEED_PRINT',21),0) = 0 THEN -- hotfix
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.NEED_PRINT = 1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن فسح المعاملة - يجب إعادة طباعة البيان الجمركي','ERROR');
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY')) THEN
 IF DO_SEA.CHECK_SEA_DLVY_ORDER_ALL(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,V_MSG_TXT)<>0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT,'ERROR');
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;


 IF CHK_INSTRUCTIONS THEN
 IF NVL(gnrl.get_customs_setting(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'CR_8257',21),0) = 1 then--CR-8257
 --STR.DISPALERT ('لا يمكن فسح الإرسالية لوجود إجراء أمني غير منتهي', 'ERROR');
 call_inst_karar(1);
 else
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن فسح المعاملة','ERROR');
 end if;
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;


 CHECK_VHTR_XRAY_INSPECT(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN);
 CHECK_VHTR_COLL_ORDS(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN); -- BY HATEM 2007 TO CHECK IF VHTR HAS UNPAID COLL ORDS

 IF COLL_ORDER_PAYED(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.FINAL_CTRY_CD <> 100 AND :DCLTN_HDR.GULF_DUTY_PRNTD <> 1 THEN
 V_GULF_DUTY := 0;
 BEGIN
 SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(ORGNL_DUTY, 0) - NVL(EXMTD_DUTY, 0)), 0)
 INTO V_GULF_DUTY
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND DUTY_TYPE IN (1,3,9,25)
 ;

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN V_GULF_DUTY := 0;
 END;
 END IF;

 IF V_GULF_DUTY > 0 AND :DCLTN_HDR.FINAL_CTRY_CD <> 100 AND :DCLTN_HDR.GULF_DUTY_PRNTD <> 1 THEN
 STR.DispALERT('يجب طباعة إشعار رسوم المقاصة أولا قبل الفسح','INFORMATION');
 RETURN 0;

 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DispALERT('توجد فواتير للمعاملة غير مسددة - يجب تسديدها أو إلغائها أولا قبل الفسح','ERROR'); --mohamed.nouh 15-11-2022 CR-5749
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
----------------------
 V_GET_SETTING := NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'PRE_CLRNC_ISSUE_CHK',21),0);
 IF V_GET_SETTING = 1 THEN

 V_CALC_DT := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 RET := DCLTN.PRE_CLRNC_ISSUE(:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE, :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN, V_CALC_DT,
 :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID, :PARAMETER.P_WS_ID, 1,1, V_MSG_TXT);
 IF RET <> 1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT, 'ERROR');
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;
 END IF;
----------------------

 IF V_DRCT_CLR_STG_DCLTN > 0 AND :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (3,4) AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN

 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- wakeel dm_580
 BEGIN

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_BRKR_CLERANCE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION chk_brkr_clerance RETURN NUMBER IS --ahmed wakeel dm_580
v_cnt NUMBER;
V_COUNTER NUMBER :=0 ;
CURSOR C1 IS SELECT ADO.EDI_ACCOUNT_ID,ADO.DLVY_NBR,ADO.DLVY_DT,ADO.PORT_CD
 FROM AIR_DLVY_ORDERS ADO, DECLARATIONS D
 WHERE ADO.PORT_CD = D.PORT_CD
 AND ADO.STMT_ISN = D.DCLTN_ISN
 AND D.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND D.DCLTN_ISN =:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND UPPER(ADO.EDI_ACCOUNT_ID)='BRKR' ;
BEGIN

 FOR I IN C1
 LOOP
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_cnt
 FROM DELAY_AIR_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND BRKR_DLVY_NBR = I.DLVY_NBR
 AND BRKR_DLVY_DT = I.DLVY_DT ;
 IF v_cnt = 0 THEN
 V_COUNTER := V_COUNTER+1 ;
 END IF ;
 END LOOP ;
 IF V_COUNTER > 0 THEN
 RETURN 0 ;
 ELSE
 RETURN 1 ;
 END IF ;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_4WVRS2
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHK_4WVRS2 IS
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- يضاف قبل الفسح واجراءات للتاكد من
-- عدم الفسح
-- فى حالة وجود طلبات تحليل على البيان فى والنتيجة غير صالحة ولم يتم اتلاف او اعادة تصدير الصنف
-- SMPL_ITEMS.RESULT_CD=2 او 8
-- DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE= 7 متلف 8 معاد تصديره
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
 v_count NUMBER;
 ret NUMBER;
 V_RQST_NMR NUMBER;
 V_RQST_DT DATE;
 V_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 V_RESULT_CD NUMBER;

 CURSOR c1
 IS
 SELECT sr.rqst_port_cd port_cd, si.dcltn_item_isn item_isn ,SI.SMPL_CORRCT_OUT_PORT,SI.result_cd,SI.clear_until_correct,sr.RQST_STATUS_CD,si.ACTION_CD
 FROM smpl_requests sr, smpl_items si
 WHERE sr.rqst_port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND sr.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn
 AND si.rqst_port_cd = sr.rqst_port_cd
 AND si.rqst_nmr = sr.rqst_nmr
 AND si.rqst_dt = sr.rqst_dt
 AND sr.wvr_seq_nbr IS NULL
 AND NVL(si.result_cd,0) IN (2, 8 ,4,12,15,16,17)
 AND NVL(si.SMPL_STATUS,0) <> 9
 AND NVL(sr.RQST_STATUS_CD,0) <> 9
 --AND NVL (si.clear_until_correct, 0) <> 1
 AND sr.rqst_dt >= TO_DATE ('01-07-1436', 'MI-MM-YYYY');
 -- GROUP BY sr.rqst_port_cd, si.dcltn_item_isn;
 CURSOR C2 IS
 SELECT RQST_PORT_CD,RQST_NMR,RQST_DT
 --- INTO V_PORT_CD,V_RQST_NMR,V_RQST_DT
 FROM SMPL_REQUESTS
 WHERE rqst_port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn ;
BEGIN
 FOR x IN c1
 LOOP
 BEGIN
 v_count := 0;

 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_count
 FROM dcltn_items di
 WHERE di.port_cd = x.port_cd
 AND di.item_isn = x.item_isn
 AND di.duty_type IN (7, 8,26);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 v_count := 0;
 END;
 ----------------------AHMED MOMEN ------14-11-2020-----------------
IF X.result_cd= 12 THEN


 IF X.result_cd= 12 AND X.RQST_STATUS_CD <> 4 THEN
 str.dispalert(' لايمكن الفسح - يوجد طلبات تحليل عينات على البيان نتيجتها غير صالحة ','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

 END IF;



 END IF;



 -----------------------------**********************----------------------
 ---------------------AHMED MOMEN ------------------------------

IF ((X.result_cd = 15 AND X.SMPL_CORRCT_OUT_PORT = 1)OR( X.result_cd = 15 AND X.clear_until_correct = 1))
 THEN
 FOR I1 IN C2 LOOP
 DECLARE
 CURSOR CUR IS
 SELECT RESULT_CD
 --INTO V_RESULT_CD
 FROM smpl_items
 WHERE RQST_PORT_CD = I1.RQST_PORT_CD
 AND RQST_NMR =I1.RQST_NMR
 AND RQST_DT =I1.RQST_DT;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 V_CNT_ALL NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 FOR I IN CUR LOOP

IF I.RESULT_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF I.RESULT_CD = 15 THEN

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM smpl_items
 WHERE RQST_PORT_CD = I1.RQST_PORT_CD
 AND RQST_NMR =I1.RQST_NMR
 AND RQST_DT =I1.RQST_DT
 AND RESULT_CD = 15;
 -- str.dispalert('V_CNT>>='||V_CNT,'ERROR');--
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT_ALL
 FROM smpl_items
 WHERE RQST_PORT_CD = I1.RQST_PORT_CD
 AND RQST_NMR =I1.RQST_NMR
 AND RQST_DT =I1.RQST_DT;

 -- str.dispalert('V_CNT_ALL>>='||V_CNT_ALL,'ERROR');--
 IF V_CNT_ALL =V_CNT THEN


 UPDATE SMPL_REQUESTS
 SET RQST_STATUS_CD = 2
 WHERE rqst_port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn
 AND RQST_PORT_CD = I1.RQST_PORT_CD
 AND RQST_NMR =I1.RQST_NMR
 AND RQST_DT =I1.RQST_DT;
 ELSE
 str.dispalert(' لايمكن الفسح - يوجد طلبات تحليل عينات على البيان نتيجتها غير صالحة ','ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;

 END IF ;
 END IF;

 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 END ;


 -- NULL;
END LOOP;

ELSE

 IF NVL (v_count, 0) = 0
 THEN

 IF X.result_cd= 12 AND X.RQST_STATUS_CD = 4 OR
 (X.result_cd = 2 AND X.ACTION_CD = 7 AND X.RQST_STATUS_CD = 4) ---- حالة العينة غير صالحة والتصرف تسوية صلحية و وضع الطلب مسدد و منتهى M-HASSAN INC652159 CRQ58520 --

 THEN


 NULL ;
 ELSE

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY ('DCLTN_HDR', update_allowed, property_false);
 str.dispalert
 (' لا يمكن الفسح لوجود طلبات تحليل على البيان والنتيجة غير صالحة ولم يتم اتلاف او اعادة تصدير الصنف',
 'ERROR'
 );
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK (NULL);
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

end if;
END IF;
 -------------------***********************----------------

 END LOOP;
-- forms_ddl('COMMIT'); -- stop commit in post insert Yhelmy CRQ11372

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHK_4WVRS1

PROCEDURE CHK_4WVRS1 IS
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- يضاف قبل الفسح واجراءات للتاكد من
-- وجود تعهد عدم تصرف
-- فى حالة وجود طلبات تحليل على البيان فى انتظار نتيجة
-- SMPL_ITEMS.RESULT_CD=0 او 3 و 4 و5 و6
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
 v_count NUMBER;
 ret NUMBER;
 V_RQST_NMR NUMBER;
 V_RQST_DT DATE;
 V_PORT_CD NUMBER;
 V_RESULT_CD NUMBER;
----------------------------AHMED MOMEN---------------------------
CURSOR C2
IS

 SELECT sr.rqst_port_cd port_cd, si.dcltn_item_isn item_isn ,SI.SMPL_CORRCT_OUT_PORT,SI.result_cd,si.clear_until_correct
 FROM smpl_requests sr, smpl_items si
 WHERE sr.rqst_port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND sr.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn
 AND si.rqst_port_cd = sr.rqst_port_cd
 AND si.rqst_nmr = sr.rqst_nmr
 AND si.rqst_dt = sr.rqst_dt
 AND NVL(si.result_cd,0) IN (2, 8 ,4,15,16,17)
 AND NVL(si.SMPL_STATUS,0) <> 9
 AND NVL(sr.RQST_STATUS_CD,0) <> 9
 --- AND NVL (si.clear_until_correct, 0) <> 1
 AND sr.rqst_dt >= TO_DATE ('01-07-1436', 'MI-MM-YYYY');
 -- GROUP BY sr.rqst_port_cd, si.dcltn_item_isn;
 CURSOR C3 IS
 SELECT RQST_PORT_CD,RQST_NMR,RQST_DT
 --- INTO V_PORT_CD,V_RQST_NMR,V_RQST_DT
 FROM SMPL_REQUESTS
 WHERE rqst_port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn ;
---------------------*************---------------------------
 CURSOR c1
 IS
 SELECT sr.rqst_port_cd wvr_port_cd, sr.wvr_seq_nbr wvr_seq_nbr,
 sr.wvr_dt issued_dt
 FROM smpl_requests sr, smpl_items si
 WHERE sr.rqst_port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND sr.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn
 AND (SI.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN) NOT IN (SELECT ITEM_ISN FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DT , GROUP_ITEMS GIT WHERE SI.RQST_PORT_CD = DT.PORT_CD AND SI.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN = DT.ITEM_ISN AND DT.FINAL_TARIFF_CD = GIT.HRMNZD_CODE AND GIT.GRP_CODE = 76)

 AND (SI.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN) NOT IN (SELECT ITEM_ISN FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DT WHERE SI.RQST_PORT_CD = DT.PORT_CD AND SI.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN = DT.ITEM_ISN AND DT.DUTY_TYPE IN(7, 8,26))
 AND si.rqst_port_cd = sr.rqst_port_cd
 AND si.rqst_nmr = sr.rqst_nmr
 AND si.rqst_dt = sr.rqst_dt
 AND sr.wvr_seq_nbr IS NOT NULL
 AND sr.wvr_dt IS NOT NULL
 AND NVL(sr.RQST_STATUS_CD,0) <> 9
 AND NVL(si.smpl_status,0) <> 9
 AND sr.wvr_dt >= TO_DATE ('01-07-1436', 'MI-MM-YYYY')
 AND NVL(si.result_cd,0) IN (0, 3, 4, 5, 6,9);
 -- GROUP BY sr.rqst_port_cd, sr.wvr_seq_nbr, sr.wvr_dt;
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_count
 FROM smpl_requests sr, smpl_items si
 WHERE sr.rqst_port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND sr.dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn
 AND (SI.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN) NOT IN (SELECT ITEM_ISN FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DT , GROUP_ITEMS GIT WHERE SI.RQST_PORT_CD = DT.PORT_CD AND SI.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN = DT.ITEM_ISN AND DT.FINAL_TARIFF_CD = GIT.HRMNZD_CODE AND GIT.GRP_CODE = 76)
 AND (SI.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN) NOT IN (SELECT ITEM_ISN FROM DCLTN_ITEMS DT WHERE SI.RQST_PORT_CD = DT.PORT_CD AND SI.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN = DT.ITEM_ISN AND DT.DUTY_TYPE IN(7, 8,26))
 AND (sr.wvr_seq_nbr IS NULL OR sr.wvr_dt IS NULL)
 AND si.rqst_port_cd = sr.rqst_port_cd
 AND si.rqst_nmr = sr.rqst_nmr
 AND si.rqst_dt = sr.rqst_dt
 AND si.smpl_status <> 9
 AND NVL(sr.RQST_STATUS_CD,0) <> 9

 AND si.rqst_dt >= TO_DATE ('01-07-1436', 'MI-MM-YYYY')
 AND NVL(si.result_cd,0) IN (0, 3, 4, 5, 6,9);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 v_count := 0;
 END;

 ---------------------AHMED MOMEN ------------------------------

 FOR I IN c2
 LOOP
 IF ((I.result_cd = 15 AND I.SMPL_CORRCT_OUT_PORT = 1)OR (I.result_cd = 15 AND I.clear_until_correct = 1))
 THEN
 FOR I1 IN C3 LOOP
 DECLARE
 CURSOR CUR IS
 SELECT RESULT_CD
 --INTO V_RESULT_CD
 FROM smpl_items
 WHERE RQST_PORT_CD = I1.RQST_PORT_CD
 AND RQST_NMR =I1.RQST_NMR
 AND RQST_DT =I1.RQST_DT;

 V_CNT NUMBER;
 V_CNT_ALL NUMBER;

 BEGIN
 FOR I IN CUR LOOP

IF I.RESULT_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF I.RESULT_CD = 15 THEN

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM smpl_items
 WHERE RQST_PORT_CD = I1.RQST_PORT_CD
 AND RQST_NMR =I1.RQST_NMR
 AND RQST_DT =I1.RQST_DT
 AND RESULT_CD = 15;
 -- str.dispalert('V_CNT>>='||V_CNT,'ERROR');--
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT_ALL
 FROM smpl_items
 WHERE RQST_PORT_CD = I1.RQST_PORT_CD
 AND RQST_NMR =I1.RQST_NMR
 AND RQST_DT =I1.RQST_DT;
 -- str.dispalert('V_CNT_ALL>>='||V_CNT_ALL,'ERROR');--

 IF V_CNT_ALL =V_CNT THEN


 UPDATE SMPL_REQUESTS
 SET RQST_STATUS_CD = 2
 WHERE rqst_port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn
 AND RQST_PORT_CD = I1.RQST_PORT_CD
 AND RQST_NMR =I1.RQST_NMR
 AND RQST_DT =I1.RQST_DT;
 ELSE
 str.dispalert(' لايمكن الفسح - يوجد طلبات تحليل عينات على البيان نتيجتها غير صالحة - القيود','ERROR');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF ;
 END IF;

 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 END ;


 -- NULL;
END LOOP;

 ELSE

 IF NVL (v_count, 0) > 0
 THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY ('DCLTN_HDR', update_allowed, property_false);
 str.dispalert
 ('لا يمكن الفسح لوجود طلبات تحليل على البيان فى انتظار نتيجة وعدم وجود تعهد عدم تصرف',
 'ERROR'
 );
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK (NULL);
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;


END IF;
 END LOOP;
 ------------------*******************--------------------------

 FOR x IN c1
 LOOP
 BEGIN
 v_count := 0;

 SELECT COUNT (1)
 INTO v_count
 FROM wvr_items wi
 WHERE wi.wvr_port_cd = x.wvr_port_cd
 AND wi.wvr_seq_nbr = x.wvr_seq_nbr
 AND wi.issued_dt = x.issued_dt
 AND NVL (wi.item_type_cd, 0) = 9
 AND NVL (wi.wvr_list_reason, 0) = 1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 v_count := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL (v_count, 0) = 0
 THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY ('DCLTN_HDR', update_allowed, property_false);
 str.dispalert
 (' لا يمكن الفسح لوجود طلبات تحليل على البيان فى انتظار نتيجة وعدم وجود تعهد عدم تصرف',
 'ERROR'
 );
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK (NULL);
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 chk_4wvrs2;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_XRAY_RESULT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION check_xray_result(V_PORT_CD NUMBER, V_MFST_TYPE NUMBER, V_MFST_NBR NUMBER, V_MFST_DT DATE, V_CNTNR_SEQ NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS

 V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD AND MFST_TYPE = V_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = V_MFST_NBR AND MFST_DT = V_MFST_DT AND CNTNR_SEQ = V_CNTNR_SEQ
 AND INSPCT_ACTN_CD=5 AND INSPCT_RESULT_CD IN (8,9) AND DCLTN_ISN IS NULL
 AND inspct_sta_cd <> 2
 AND NOT EXISTS
 (
 SELECT 1 FROM VSSL_CNTNR_INSPCTS VI2
 WHERE VI2.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD AND VI2.MFST_TYPE = V_MFST_TYPE
 AND VI2.MFST_NBR = V_MFST_NBR AND VI2.MFST_DT = V_MFST_DT AND VI2.CNTNR_SEQ = V_CNTNR_SEQ
 --AND VI2.INSPCT_ACTN_CD=1 AND VI2.inspct_sta_cd <> 4 --STOP BY RAMY
 AND VI2.INSPCT_ACTN_CD=1 AND VI2. INSPCT_RESULT_CD <> 4 --CHANGE BY RAMY TO FIX Result CHECK
 AND VI2.inspct_sta_cd <> 2

) ;

 RETURN(V_COUNT);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_TRANS_POST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_trans_post IS
RET NUMBER;
CURSOR s IS SELECT DISTINCT dcltn_isn,type_id
FROM
(SELECT d.dcltn_isn dcltn_isn,1 type_id
 FROM dcltn_land_mnfst_trans dlmt,
 dcltn_land_mnfsts dlm,
 declarations d
 WHERE (dlmt.tran_seq, dlmt.trans_date_h,dlmt.port_cd) IN (
 SELECT dlmt.tran_seq, dlmt.trans_date_h, dlmt.port_cd
 FROM dcltn_land_mnfst_trans dlmt,
 dcltn_land_mnfsts dlm
 WHERE dlm.port_cd = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.port_cd
 AND dlm.dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.dcltn_isn
 AND dlm.port_cd = dlmt.port_cd
 AND dlm.dcltn_mnfst_isn = dlmt.dcltn_mnfst_isn
 UNION ALL
 SELECT dgt.vhcl_trans_nbr, dgt.vhcl_trans_date,
 dgt.port_cd
 FROM dcltn_gate_trans dgt
 WHERE dgt.port_cd = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.port_cd
 AND dgt.dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.dcltn_isn)
 AND d.port_cd = dlm.port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = dlm.dcltn_isn
 AND dlm.port_cd = dlmt.port_cd
 AND dlm.dcltn_mnfst_isn = dlmt.dcltn_mnfst_isn
 AND d.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 AND d.dcltn_sta_cd IN (5)
 AND d.dcltn_isn != :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.dcltn_isn
UNION ALL
SELECT d.dcltn_isn,1
 FROM dcltn_gate_trans dgt, declarations d
 WHERE d.port_cd = dgt.port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = dgt.dcltn_isn
 AND (dgt.vhcl_trans_nbr, dgt.vhcl_trans_date,dgt.port_cd) IN (
 SELECT dlmt.tran_seq, dlmt.trans_date_h, dlmt.port_cd
 FROM dcltn_land_mnfst_trans dlmt,
 dcltn_land_mnfsts dlm
 WHERE dlm.port_cd = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.port_cd
 AND dlm.dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.dcltn_isn
 AND dlm.port_cd = dlmt.port_cd
 AND dlm.dcltn_mnfst_isn = dlmt.dcltn_mnfst_isn
 UNION ALL
 SELECT dgt.vhcl_trans_nbr, dgt.vhcl_trans_date,
 dgt.port_cd
 FROM dcltn_gate_trans dgt
 WHERE dgt.port_cd = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.port_cd
 AND dgt.dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.dcltn_isn)
 AND d.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 AND d.dcltn_sta_cd IN (5)
 AND d.dcltn_isn != :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.dcltn_isn
UNION ALL
SELECT s.stats_isn,2
 FROM stats_vhcls sv, stats_dcltns s
 WHERE sv.port_cd = s.port_cd
 AND sv.stats_isn = s.stats_isn
 AND (sv.tran_seq, sv.trans_date_h,sv.port_cd) IN (
 SELECT dlmt.tran_seq, dlmt.trans_date_h, dlmt.port_cd
 FROM dcltn_land_mnfst_trans dlmt,
 dcltn_land_mnfsts dlm
 WHERE dlm.port_cd = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.port_cd
 AND dlm.dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.dcltn_isn
 AND dlm.port_cd = dlmt.port_cd
 AND dlm.dcltn_mnfst_isn = dlmt.dcltn_mnfst_isn
 UNION ALL
 SELECT dgt.vhcl_trans_nbr, dgt.vhcl_trans_date,
 dgt.port_cd
 FROM dcltn_gate_trans dgt
 WHERE dgt.port_cd = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.port_cd
 AND dgt.dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.dcltn_isn)
 AND s.stats_type_cd IN (11, 13, 15)
 AND S.STATS_STATUS IN (6));
v_error VARCHAR2(32767);
v_dcltn_nbr NUMBER;
v_dcltn_dt VARCHAR2(20);
v_type VARCHAR2(100);
BEGIN
FOR rec IN s LOOP
IF rec.type_id = 1 THEN
SELECT dcltn_nbr,TO_CHAR(dcltn_dt,'mi-mm-yyyy'),' بيان جمركي رقم '
INTO v_dcltn_nbr,v_dcltn_dt,v_type
FROM declarations
WHERE port_cd = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.port_cd
AND dcltn_isn = rec.dcltn_isn;
ELSE
SELECT stats_nbr,TO_CHAR(stats_dt,'mi-mm-yyyy'),' بيان إحصائي رقم '
INTO v_dcltn_nbr,v_dcltn_dt,v_type
FROM stats_dcltns
WHERE port_cd = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.port_cd
AND stats_isn = rec.dcltn_isn;
END IF;
v_error:=v_error ||v_type||v_dcltn_nbr||' بتاريخ '||v_dcltn_dt||' في إنتظار الفسح على نفس حركات البيان الحالي ';
END LOOP;
IF v_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 ret :=
 intrface.flash_alert (v_error,
 'INFORMATION',
 1,
 'البيانات في إنتظار الفسح',
 7.5,
 0.5,
 1,
 0.5,
 1150,
 'r0g0b75',
 12
 );
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_TOROD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_torod IS
 --CR-5913Enhance
 v_recs NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'ALOW_TRNSFER_EXP_ICC',21),0) = 1 then--setting on
 IF DCLTN.CHK_EXPRT_LAND_DECLARE (:dcltn_hdr.PORT_CD,:dcltn_hdr.DCLTN_ISN) = 0 THEN-- WAKEEL DM_0142
 IF prtl_nebras_services.BL_PARTS_APPLIED(:dcltn_hdr.port_cd,:dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn) = 0 THEN
 -- according to مشاكل تغييرات بعد الاطلاق
 -- we display the folloing message in the following conditions:
 -- 1 SEA or Land
 -- 2 Export DCLTN
 -- 3 Direct CLEARANCE
 -- 4 SETTING ALOW_TRNSFER_EXP_ICC ON
 -- this message already ignored during trans to payment
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO v_recs
 FROM dcltn_grps
 WHERE port_cd = :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 AND grp_id = :dcltn_hdr.GROUP_ID
 AND NVL(grp_type,0) = 2 -- direct clearance
 ;
 IF :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_type_cd > 2 AND :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (1,3) AND v_recs > 0 THEN
 str.dispalert('لم يتم إدخال جميع طرود البوليصة إلى الجمرك','ERROR');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_PASS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_PASS IS
X NUMBER;
Y NUMBER;
BEGIN
SELECT NVL(SUM(INV_COST*REVENUE.GET_CURRENCY_RATE(INV_CURCY_CD,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT)),0) INTO Y FROM DCLTN_INVOICES,DCLTN_ITEMS
WHERE DCLTN_INVOICES.INV_ISN=DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_ISN
AND DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
AND FINAL_TARIFF_CD IN (SELECT HRMNZD_CODE FROM GROUP_ITEMS WHERE GRP_CODE IN (123,150));
IF Y > 60000 THEN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO X FROM PASSENGER_TRIPS
WHERE PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN=:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;
IF X = 0 THEN
STR.DISPALERT('لابد من إدخال نموذج الإفصاح','ERROR');
TERMINATE_FUN;
END IF;
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_LEAD_SEAL_MISMATCH
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_LEAD_SEAL_MISMATCH IS
--CR-7128 Moath alHusaini 25/01/2024
V_ROLE VARCHAR2(30) := 'RLS_DCLN_SEAL_MISMATCH';
V_USER_IS_ALLOWED NUMBER(1) := 0;
V_APPROVE_FOR_RELEASE CNTNR_INSPTN_POSES.APPROVE_FOR_RELEASE%TYPE := 1;

BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 1
 INTO V_USER_IS_ALLOWED
 FROM SC_USER_ROLES UR
 WHERE UR.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND UR.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND UR.UR_ACTIVE = 1
 AND UR.ROLE_ID = V_ROLE
 UNION
 SELECT 1
 FROM SC_GROUP_ROLES GR, SC_USER_GROUPS UG
 WHERE UG.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND UG.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND GR.ROLE_ID = V_ROLE
 AND GR.GROUP_ID = UG.GROUP_ID
 AND GR.GR_ACTIVE = 1
 MINUS
 SELECT 1
 FROM SC_USER_EXCLUDED_ROLES UER
 WHERE UER.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND UER.USER_ID = :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID
 AND UER.ROLE_ID = V_ROLE
 AND UER.UER_ACTIVE =1;

 --#
 -- V_USER_IS_ALLOWED=1 THEN USER IS ALLOWED TO FASAH
 RETURN ;
 --#
 EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_USER_IS_ALLOWED := 0;
 END;
 IF V_USER_IS_ALLOWED = 0 THEN
 BEGIN
 FOR R_ALL_CNTNRS IN (SELECT VSS_CNT.PORT_CD,
 VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE,
 VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR,
 VSS_CNT.MFST_DT,
 VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS AD,
 SEA_DLVY_ITEMS SDI,
 VSSL_BL_ITEMS VBI,
 VSSL_CNTNRS VSS_CNT
 WHERE AD.PORT_CD = SDI.PORT_CD
 AND AD.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SDI.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND AD.DO_NBR = SDI.DO_NBR
 AND AD.DO_ISS_DT = SDI.DO_ISS_DT
 AND VBI.PORT_CD = SDI.MFST_PORT_CD
 AND VBI.MFST_TYPE = SDI.MFST_TYPE
 AND VBI.MFST_NBR = SDI.MFST_NBR
 AND VBI.MFST_DT = SDI.MFST_DT
 AND VBI.BL_SEQ = SDI.BL_SEQ
 AND VBI.ITEM_SEQ = SDI.ITEM_SEQ
 AND VSS_CNT.PORT_CD = VBI.PORT_CD
 AND VSS_CNT.MFST_TYPE = VBI.MFST_TYPE
 AND VSS_CNT.MFST_NBR = VBI.MFST_NBR
 AND VSS_CNT.MFST_DT = VBI.MFST_DT
 AND VSS_CNT.CNTNR_SEQ = VBI.CNTNR_SEQ
 AND AD.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND AD.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN) LOOP
 BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT NVL(APPROVE_FOR_RELEASE , 0 ) -- 1:Allowed, 2:Not Allowed
 INTO V_APPROVE_FOR_RELEASE
 FROM CNTNR_INSPTN_POSES
 WHERE CNTNR_INSPTN_POSES.PORT_CD = R_ALL_CNTNRS.PORT_CD
 AND CNTNR_INSPTN_POSES.MFST_TYPE = R_ALL_CNTNRS.MFST_TYPE
 AND CNTNR_INSPTN_POSES.MFST_NBR = R_ALL_CNTNRS.MFST_NBR
 AND CNTNR_INSPTN_POSES.MFST_DT = R_ALL_CNTNRS.MFST_DT
 AND CNTNR_INSPTN_POSES.CNTNR_SEQ = R_ALL_CNTNRS.CNTNR_SEQ ;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
 V_APPROVE_FOR_RELEASE := 1 ;
 END ;
 IF V_APPROVE_FOR_RELEASE = 1 THEN
 RETURN;
 ELSIF V_APPROVE_FOR_RELEASE = 2 THEN
 str.dispalert ('يوجد اختلاف في رقم الرصاص و ليس لك صلاحية للفسح','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE ;
 END IF ;
 END ;
 END LOOP;
 END ;
 END IF ;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_ELEMENT_TO_DEL(P_ELEMENT VARCHAR2) IS
 TOTAL_LIST_COUNT NUMBER(2);
 LOOP_INDEX_VAR NUMBER(2) := 1;
 LIST_ELEMENT VARCHAR2(50);
 LIST_ELEMENT_VALUE VARCHAR2(50);
 LIST_VALUE_TO_ADD VARCHAR2(50);
 ELEMENT_MATCH VARCHAR2(5) := 'FALSE';
BEGIN

 TOTAL_LIST_COUNT := GET_LIST_ELEMENT_COUNT('DGT_TYPE');
 LOOP
 LIST_ELEMENT := GET_LIST_ELEMENT_VALUE('DGT_TYPE',LOOP_INDEX_VAR);
 LOOP_INDEX_VAR := LOOP_INDEX_VAR + 1;

 IF P_ELEMENT = LIST_ELEMENT THEN
 ELEMENT_MATCH := 'TRUE';
 END IF;

 EXIT WHEN LIST_ELEMENT = P_ELEMENT OR LOOP_INDEX_VAR = TOTAL_LIST_COUNT;
 END LOOP;


 IF ELEMENT_MATCH = 'TRUE' THEN
 DELETE_LIST_ELEMENT('DGT_TYPE', P_ELEMENT);
 END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CAN_CLR_SITEM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CAN_CLR_SITEM RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 V_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 V_DGT_SUM NUMBER;
 V_SDI_WT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR IS NOT NULL AND
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR IS NOT NULL AND
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT IS NOT NULL AND
 :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_ISN
 INTO V_DCLTN_ISN
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DispALERT('هذا الإذن غير موجود','ERROR');
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END;

 IF V_DCLTN_ISN <> :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN OR V_DCLTN_ISN IS NULL THEN
 STR.DispALERT('هذا الإذن غير مربوط على البيان','ERROR');
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT
 AND DGT_TYPE = 2
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_CNT := 0;
 END;

 IF NVL(V_CNT, 0) <> 0 THEN
 STR.DispALERT('هذا الإذن مفسوح من قبل','ERROR');
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT DLVRD_WT
 INTO V_SDI_WT
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT
 AND PRCSD_ITEM_SEQ = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DispALERT('هذا الصنف غير موجود','ERROR');
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END;

 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(CLRD_WT)
 INTO V_DGT_SUM
 FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_NBR = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR
 AND SEA_DLVY_DT = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT
 AND SEA_ITEM_SEQ = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_ITEM_SEQ
 AND DGT_TYPE IN (3, 5, 6)
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 V_DGT_SUM := 0;
 END;
 V_DGT_SUM := NVL(V_DGT_SUM, 0);

 IF V_DGT_SUM >= V_SDI_WT THEN
 STR.DispALERT('هذا الصنف مفسوح من قبل','ERROR');
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;

 RETURN(TRUE);
 ELSE
 RETURN(FALSE);
 END IF;
END;

FUNCTION CAN_CLR_ADLVY RETURN BOOLEAN IS

 ;

 END;

 IF V_DCLTN_ISN <> :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN OR V_DCLTN_ISN IS NULL THEN

 END IF;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_VHTR_LOV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CALL_VHTR_LOV IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'CALL_VHTR_LOV';
 RET NUMBER;
 RCOUNT NUMBER;
 CURSOR C(P_PORT NUMBER, P_SEQ NUMBER, P_DT DATE) IS SELECT PORT_CD, TRAN_SEQ, TRANS_DATE_H, TRAN_DRCTN,
 VHCL_TRAN_TYPE, PSNGR_CARG, PLATE_CTRY_CD
 FROM VHCL_TRANSACTIONS VHTR
 WHERE VHTR.PORT_CD = P_PORT
 AND VHTR.TRANS_DATE_H = P_DT
 AND VHTR.TRAN_SEQ = P_SEQ
 ;
 C_REC C%ROWTYPE;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000) := NULL;
 V_RET VARCHAR(100);
 V_CHK NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(TRAN_SEQ)
 INTO RCOUNT
 FROM VHCL_TRANSACTIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND PSNGR_CARG = 2
 AND TRAN_DRCTN = 0
 AND VHCL_TRAN_TYPE IN (5, 15)
 ;

 IF RCOUNT <= 0 THEN
 Str.DispAlert('لا تحتوي القائمة على بيانات', 'ERROR');
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, ' قائمة حركة السيارات');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER,6.4);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PSNGR_CARG', TEXT_PARAMETER,2);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DCRTN', TEXT_PARAMETER,0);
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_TRANS_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER,); 5, 15 ???
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'ROW_COUNT', TEXT_PARAMETER, 10);

 CALL_FORM('LOV_VHCL_TRANS.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.TRAN_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 OPEN C(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :GLOBAL.TRAN_SEQ, :GLOBAL.TRANS_DATE_H);
 FETCH C INTO C_REC;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ - لا يوجد قيد حركة لهذه اللوحة. يجب تسجيل حركة دخول', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 V_CHK := IS_VHTR_OK(C_REC.PORT_CD, C_REC.TRAN_SEQ, C_REC.TRANS_DATE_H, C_REC.TRAN_DRCTN,
 C_REC.VHCL_TRAN_TYPE, C_REC.PSNGR_CARG, C_REC.PLATE_CTRY_CD, V_MSG);
 IF V_CHK = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 IF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_MSG := V_MSG || CHR(13) || 'هل تريد الاستمرار؟';
 V_RET := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(V_MSG, 'WARNING', 1);
 IF V_RET <> ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 :VHCL_TRANS_NBR := :GLOBAL.TRAN_SEQ;
 :VHCL_TRANS_DATE := :GLOBAL.TRANS_DATE_H;
 :PLATE_NO := :GLOBAL.PLATE_NO;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PLATE_NO', ITEM_IS_VALID, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 END IF;

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_LOV_SEA_DLVY_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CALL_LOV_SEA_DLVY_ITEMS IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_SEA_DLVY_ITEMS';
BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DO_NBR', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DO_ISS_DT', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.SEA_DLVY_DT);

-- Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 7);
-- Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'ROW_COUNT', TEXT_PARAMETER, 5);
-- Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'البيانات الجمركية المرتبطة بالبوليصة');


 CALL_FORM('LOV_SEA_DLVY_ITEMS.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.SDI_SEL IS NOT NULL THEN
 CREATE_ITEMS(:GLOBAL.SDI_SEL);
 END IF;

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
END;

 END IF;
 --
 IF :GLOBAL.COL_HIDE_10 IS NOT NULL THEN

 END IF;
 --
 FOR i IN 1 .. 10 LOOP
 ERASE('GLOBAL.COL_'||i);
 ERASE('GLOBAL.COL_HIDE_'||i);
 IF i < 6 THEN

 ERASE('GLOBAL.COL_CHK_'||i);
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ALERT_WAIVER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\
 --/\------------ --------nihad khalil fagem ------ ----------------------/\
 --/\---------------------------------- 23/10/2007---------------------------------------------/\
 --/\------- for show flash alert for count of waiver on declaration ---------------/\
 --/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\

 PROCEDURE ALERT_WAIVER(V_CNTNR_PORT_CD IN NUMBER,V_DCLTN_ISN IN NUMBER )
 IS
 CURSOR OWNER_NAME IS
 ---------------------------------------ATTRIBUTES---------------------------------
 SELECT COUNT(declarations.dcltn_isn) AS count_waivers
 ,wvr_types.item_type_name AS waiver_type_name
 ,declarations.dcltn_isn AS dcltn_isn
 FROM waivers, wvr_items, wvr_types, declarations
 WHERE (waivers.wvr_port_cd = wvr_items.wvr_port_cd )
 AND (waivers.wvr_seq_nbr = wvr_items.wvr_seq_nbr )
 AND (waivers.issued_dt = wvr_items.issued_dt )
 AND (wvr_types.item_type_cd = wvr_items.item_type_cd)
 AND (declarations.port_cd = waivers.wvr_port_cd )
 AND (declarations.dcltn_isn = waivers.dcltn_isn )
 ----------------------------PARAMETER ------------------------
 AND declarations.port_cd =V_CNTNR_PORT_CD
 AND declarations.dcltn_isn =V_DCLTN_ISN
 ---------------------------------------------------------------
 GROUP BY wvr_types.item_type_name,declarations.dcltn_isn;
 ----------------------------VARIABLE---------------------------
 V_TXT_DTL VARCHAR2(6000) := NULL;
 V_TXT_DTL_ALL VARCHAR2(6000) := NULL;
 V_TXT_HEDR VARCHAR2(200);
 V_FLASH_ALERT VARCHAR2(200);
 COUNTER NUMBER:=0;
 found BOOLEAN:=FALSE;

 BEGIN


 V_TXT_HEDR := ' تعهدات البيان: ';

 FOR I IN OWNER_NAME LOOP

 COUNTER := COUNTER +1 ;

 V_TXT_DTL := COUNTER ||'-'|| I.waiver_type_name ||' عدد:'||I.count_waivers || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 V_TXT_DTL_ALL :=V_TXT_DTL_ALL || V_TXT_DTL;


 IF (LENGTH(V_TXT_DTL_ALL) > 5950) THEN
 V_TXT_DTL_ALL := V_TXT_DTL_ALL ||'.....' || CHR(10) ||CHR(13);
 EXIT;
 END IF;

 found:=TRUE;
 END LOOP;


 IF found= TRUE THEN
 V_FLASH_ALERT := INTRFACE.FLASH_ALERT(CHR(1000)||V_TXT_HEDR || CHR(10) ||CHR(13)||V_TXT_DTL_ALL,'INFORMATION',2, 'رسالة توضيحية',
 7.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1400, 'r100g0b0',10);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJ_TABS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE adj_tabs
IS
 v_cur_rec NUMBER;
 b_clr_data BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
 v_cur_rec := GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY ('DCLTN_GATE_TRANS', current_record);

 IF GET_RECORD_PROPERTY (v_cur_rec, 'DCLTN_GATE_TRANS', status) IN
 ('INSERT', 'CHANGED')
 AND :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_dt IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 b_clr_data := TRUE;
 ELSE
 b_clr_data := FALSE;
 END IF;

 IF :dcltn_gate_trans.dgt_type = 1 OR :dcltn_gate_trans.dgt_type IS NULL
 THEN
 HIDE_VIEW ('CG$TAB_1');
 adj_adlvy_tab_ctrls (FALSE, b_clr_data);
 adj_sdlvy_tab_ctrls (FALSE, b_clr_data);
 adj_sitem_tab_ctrls (FALSE, b_clr_data);
 ELSIF :dcltn_gate_trans.dgt_type = 2
 THEN
 IF :parameter.p_port_type = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_AIR')
 THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.air_partial_clear = 1
 THEN
 adj_adlvy_tab_ctrls (TRUE, FALSE);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY ('CG$TAB_PAGE_1', visible, property_true);
 adj_sdlvy_tab_ctrls (FALSE, b_clr_data);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY ('CG$TAB_PAGE_2', visible, property_false);
 adj_sitem_tab_ctrls (FALSE, b_clr_data);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY ('CG$TAB_PAGE_3', visible, property_false);
 SHOW_VIEW ('CG$TAB_1');
 ELSE
 adj_adlvy_tab_ctrls (TRUE, FALSE);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY ('CG$TAB_PAGE_1', visible, property_true);
 adj_sdlvy_tab_ctrls (FALSE, b_clr_data);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY ('CG$TAB_PAGE_2', visible, property_false);
 END IF;
 ELSIF :parameter.p_port_type IN
 (consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_SEA'),
 consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_DRY')
 )
 THEN
 adj_sdlvy_tab_ctrls (TRUE, FALSE);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY ('CG$TAB_PAGE_2', visible, property_true);
 adj_adlvy_tab_ctrls (FALSE, b_clr_data);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY ('CG$TAB_PAGE_1', visible, property_false);
 END IF;

 adj_sitem_tab_ctrls (FALSE, b_clr_data);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY ('CG$TAB_PAGE_3', visible, property_false);
 SHOW_VIEW ('CG$TAB_1');
 ELSIF :dcltn_gate_trans.dgt_type IN (3, 5, 6)
 THEN
 IF :parameter.p_port_type = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_AIR')
 AND :GLOBAL.air_partial_clear = 1
 THEN
 adj_adlvy_tab_ctrls (TRUE, FALSE);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY ('CG$TAB_PAGE_1', visible, property_true);
 adj_sdlvy_tab_ctrls (FALSE, b_clr_data);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY ('CG$TAB_PAGE_2', visible, property_false);
 adj_sitem_tab_ctrls (FALSE, b_clr_data);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY ('CG$TAB_PAGE_3', visible, property_false);
 SHOW_VIEW ('CG$TAB_1');
 ELSE
 adj_sdlvy_tab_ctrls (TRUE, FALSE);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY ('CG$TAB_PAGE_2', visible, property_true);
 adj_sitem_tab_ctrls (TRUE, FALSE);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY ('CG$TAB_PAGE_3', visible, property_true);
 adj_adlvy_tab_ctrls (FALSE, b_clr_data);
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY ('CG$TAB_PAGE_1', visible, property_false);
 SHOW_VIEW ('CG$TAB_1');
 END IF;
 END IF;

 adj_shrtge_flds;
END;

PROCEDURE ADJ_GATE_DATA IS
BEGIN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = DCLTN.PT_SEA THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA'),CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_DRY')) THEN
--&&& END
 :PARAMETER.P_GATE_NBR := GET_GATE_NBR;
 IF :PARAMETER.P_GATE_NBR IS NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن الحصول على رقم البوابة', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT GATE_NAME
 INTO :PARAMETER.P_GATE_NAME
 FROM PORT_GATES
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND GATE_NBR = :PARAMETER.P_GATE_NBR
 AND REC_STATUS = 1
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_GATE_NAME := NULL;
 END;

 IF :PARAMETER.P_GATE_NAME IS NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('رقم البوابة غير معرف أو غير فعال', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 :PARAMETER.P_GATE_NBR := NULL;
 :PARAMETER.P_GATE_NAME := NULL;
 END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE DECLTN_LOV IS

 RET NUMBER;

 BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN

 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.DCLTN_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN;
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_NBR;
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_DT;

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END;

SELECT L_SDO.DO_NBR DO_NBR /* CG$FK */
 ,L_SDO.DO_ISS_DT DO_ISS_DT
 ,L_IMP.ARBC_IMPR_NAME L_IMP_ARBC_IMPR_NAME
 ,L_DCLTN.DCLTN_NBR L_DCLTN_DCLTN_NBR
 ,L_DCLTN.DCLTN_DT L_DCLTN_DCLTN_DT
 ,L_DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_STA_DESC L_DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC
 ,L_DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD L_DCLTN_DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 ,L_DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD L_DCLTN_DCLTN_STA_CD
 ,L_DCLTN.LIC_TYPE L_DCLTN_LIC_TYPE
 ,L_DCLTN.LIC_NBR L_DCLTN_LIC_NBR
 ,L_DCLTN.IMPR_NBR L_DCLTN_IMPR_NBR
 ,L_SDO.DCLTN_ISN L_SDO_DCLTN_ISN
 ,L_SDO.PORT_CD PORT_CD
 ,L_SDO.SHPG_AGNT_NBR SHPG_AGNT_NBR
FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS L_SDO
 ,DECLARATIONS L_DCLTN
 ,IMPORTERS L_IMP
 ,DCLTN_STATUS L_DCLTN_ST
WHERE L_DCLTN.PORT_CD (+) = L_SDO.PORT_CD
AND L_DCLTN.DCLTN_ISN (+) = L_SDO.DCLTN_ISN
AND L_IMP.PORT_CD (+) = L_DCLTN.PORT_CD
AND L_IMP.IMPR_NBR (+) = L_DCLTN.AGENT_NBR
AND L_DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_STA_CD (+) = L_DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD
AND L_DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_TYPE_CD (+) = L_DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD

RecordGroup.Name: CGFK$VBI_L_VB_BL_NBR
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT L_VB.BL_SEQ BL_SEQ /* CG$FK */
 ,L_VB.BL_NBR L_VB_BL_NBR
 ,L_CTRY.CRTY_ARBC_NAME L_CTRY_CRTY_ARBC_NAME
 ,L_FP.PORT_ARBC_NAME L_FP_PORT_ARBC_NAME
 ,L_VB.DLVRY_PORT_CD L_VB_DLVRY_PORT_CD
 ,L_VB.PORT_CD PORT_CD3
 ,L_VB.OWNER_NBR L_VB_OWNER_NBR
 ,L_VB.CTRY_CD L_VB_CTRY_CD
 ,L_VB.MFST_TYPE MFST_TYPE3
 ,L_VB.FRGN_PORT_CD L_VB_FRGN_PORT_CD
 ,L_VB.MFST_NBR MFST_NBR3
 ,L_VB.FRGN_PORT_TYPE_CD L_VB_FRGN_PORT_TYPE_CD
 ,L_VB.MFST_DT MFST_DT3
 ,L_VB.SHPG_AGNT_NBR L_VB_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 ,L_VB.DCLTN_ISN L_VB_DCLTN_ISN
 ,L_VB.BUYER_NBR L_VB_BUYER_NBR
FROM VSSL_BLS L_VB
 ,FORIEGN_PORTS L_FP
 ,COUNTRIES L_CTRY
WHERE L_FP.PORT_CD = L_VB.FRGN_PORT_CD
AND L_FP.CTRY_CD = L_VB.CTRY_CD
AND L_FP.PORT_TYPE_CD = L_VB.FRGN_PORT_TYPE_CD
AND L_CTRY.CTRY_CD = L_FP.CTRY_CD
AND L_VB.PORT_CD = :VBI.PORT_CD3
AND L_VB.MFST_TYPE = :VBI.MFST_TYPE3
AND L_VB.MFST_NBR = :VBI.MFST_NBR3
AND L_VB.MFST_DT = :VBI.MFST_DT3

 ,L_CNTT.CNTNR_TYPE L_CNTT_CNTNR_TYPE

RecordGroup.Name: CGFK$DCLTN_GATE_TRANS_ADLVY_NB
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT AIR_DLVY.PORT_CD PORT_CD /* CG$FK */
 ,AIR_DLVY.DLVY_NBR ADLVY_NBR
 ,AIR_DLVY.BILL_NBR ADLVY_BILL_NBR
 ,AIR_DLVY.MFST_NBR ADLVY_MFST_NBR
 ,L_BLD.ARVD_QTY ADLVY_ARVD_QTY
 ,AIR_DLVY.DLVY_DT ADLVY_DT
 ,AIR_DLVY.SHPMT_TYPE ADLVY_SHPMT_TYPE
 ,AIR_DLVY.CARR_PREFIX ADLVY_CARR_PREFIX
 ,AIR_DLVY.BILL_DT ADLVY_BILL_DT
 ,AIR_DLVY.MFST_YEAR ADLVY_MFST_YEAR
 ,AIR_DLVY.MFST_TYPE ADLVY_MFST_TYPE
 ,L_BLD.ARVD_WT ADLVY_ARVD_WT
 ,L_BILL.OWNER_NAME ADLVY_OWNER_NAME
 ,L_BILL.IMPR_NAME ADLVY_IMPR_NAME
 ,AIR_DLVY.RMDR_QTY ADLVY_RMDR_QTY
 ,AIR_DLVY.STMT_ISN DLVY_STMT_ISN
FROM AIR_DLVY_ORDERS AIR_DLVY
 ,BILL_DTLS L_BLD
 ,BILLS L_BILL
WHERE (L_BLD.MFST_YEAR = AIR_DLVY.MFST_YEAR OR
 (L_BLD.MFST_YEAR IS NULL AND
 AIR_DLVY.MFST_YEAR IS NULL ))
AND (L_BLD.MFST_TYPE = AIR_DLVY.MFST_TYPE OR
 (L_BLD.MFST_TYPE IS NULL AND
 AIR_DLVY.MFST_TYPE IS NULL ))
AND L_BLD.SHPMT_TYPE = AIR_DLVY.SHPMT_TYPE
AND (L_BLD.BILL_NBR = AIR_DLVY.BILL_NBR OR
 (L_BLD.BILL_NBR IS NULL AND
 AIR_DLVY.BILL_NBR IS NULL ))
AND L_BLD.PORT_CD = AIR_DLVY.PORT_CD
AND (L_BLD.CARR_PREFIX = AIR_DLVY.CARR_PREFIX OR
 (L_BLD.CARR_PREFIX IS NULL AND
 AIR_DLVY.CARR_PREFIX IS NULL ))
AND (L_BLD.MFST_NBR = AIR_DLVY.MFST_NBR OR
 (L_BLD.MFST_NBR IS NULL AND
 AIR_DLVY.MFST_NBR IS NULL ))
AND (L_BLD.BILL_DT = AIR_DLVY.BILL_DT OR
 (L_BLD.BILL_DT IS NULL AND
 AIR_DLVY.BILL_DT IS NULL ))
AND L_BILL.CARR_PREFIX = L_BLD.CARR_PREFIX
AND L_BILL.BILL_NBR = L_BLD.BILL_NBR
AND L_BILL.BILL_DT = L_BLD.BILL_DT
AND L_BILL.PORT_CD = L_BLD.PORT_CD
AND AIR_DLVY.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD

RecordGroup.Name: CGFK$DCLTN_GATE_TRANS_SEA_DLVY
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT SEA_DLVY.PORT_CD PORT_CD /* CG$FK */
 ,SEA_DLVY.DO_NBR SEA_DLVY_NBR
 ,SEA_DLVY.DO_ISS_DT SEA_DLVY_DT
 ,SEA_DLVY.SHPG_AGNT_NBR SEA_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 ,L_SHAG.AGNT_ARBC_NAME SEA_SHPG_AGNT_ARBC_NAME
 ,SEA_DLVY.DO_STA_CD SEA_DLVY_DO_STA_CD
 ,SEA_DLVY.OWNER_NBR SEA_DLVY_OWNER_NBR
 ,L_BO.OWNER_NAME SEA_DLVY_OWNER_NAME
 ,SEA_DLVY.MFST_PORT_CD SEA_DLVY_MFST_PORT_CD
 ,L_SDP.PORT_NAME SEA_DLVY_MFST_PORT_NAME
 ,SEA_DLVY.MFST_NBR SEA_DLVY_MFST_NBR
 ,SEA_DLVY.MFST_DT SEA_DLVY_MFST_DT
 ,SEA_DLVY.MFST_TYPE SEA_DLVY_MFST_TYPE
 ,L_VM.VSSL_ARBC_NAME SEA_DLVY_VSSL_ARBC_NAME
 ,SEA_DLVY.VYG_MFST_NBR TRAIN_DLVY_VYG_MFST_NBR
 ,SEA_DLVY.VYG_MFST_DT TRAIN_DLVY_VYG_MFST_DT
FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS SEA_DLVY
 ,VSSL_MFSTS L_VM
 ,SD_PORTS L_SDP
 ,BL_OWNERS L_BO
 ,SHPG_AGNTS L_SHAG
WHERE (L_VM.MFST_TYPE = SEA_DLVY.MFST_TYPE OR
 (L_VM.MFST_TYPE IS NULL AND
 SEA_DLVY.MFST_TYPE IS NULL ))
AND (L_VM.PORT_CD = SEA_DLVY.MFST_PORT_CD OR
 (L_VM.PORT_CD IS NULL AND
 SEA_DLVY.MFST_PORT_CD IS NULL ))
AND (L_VM.MFST_NBR = SEA_DLVY.MFST_NBR OR
 (L_VM.MFST_NBR IS NULL AND
 SEA_DLVY.MFST_NBR IS NULL ))
AND (L_VM.MFST_DT = SEA_DLVY.MFST_DT OR
 (L_VM.MFST_DT IS NULL AND
 SEA_DLVY.MFST_DT IS NULL ))
AND L_SDP.PORT_CD = L_VM.PORT_CD
AND (L_BO.OWNER_NBR = SEA_DLVY.OWNER_NBR OR
 (L_BO.OWNER_NBR IS NULL AND
 SEA_DLVY.OWNER_NBR IS NULL ))
AND (L_BO.MFST_TYPE = SEA_DLVY.MFST_TYPE OR
 (L_BO.MFST_TYPE IS NULL AND
 SEA_DLVY.MFST_TYPE IS NULL ))
AND (L_BO.PORT_CD = SEA_DLVY.MFST_PORT_CD OR
 (L_BO.PORT_CD IS NULL AND
 SEA_DLVY.MFST_PORT_CD IS NULL ))
AND (L_BO.MFST_NBR = SEA_DLVY.MFST_NBR OR
 (L_BO.MFST_NBR IS NULL AND
 SEA_DLVY.MFST_NBR IS NULL ))
AND (L_BO.MFST_DT = SEA_DLVY.MFST_DT OR
 (L_BO.MFST_DT IS NULL AND
 SEA_DLVY.MFST_DT IS NULL ))
AND L_SHAG.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SEA_DLVY.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
AND SEA_DLVY.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD

RecordGroup.Name: CGFK$DCLTN_GATE_TRANS_PLATE_NO
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT VHTR.PLATE_NO PLATE_NO /* CG$FK */
 ,VHTR.TRAN_SEQ VHCL_TRANS_NBR
 ,VHTR.TRANS_DATE_H VHCL_TRANS_DATE
 ,VHTR.PORT_CD PORT_CD
FROM VHCL_TRANSACTIONS VHTR
WHERE VHTR.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_GATE_TRANS.PORT_CD
ORDER BY VHTR.TRANS_DATE_H DESC
 ,VHTR.TRAN_SEQ DESC

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-FORM-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 cust_clk Timer;
 SYSTEM_DATE VARCHAR2(20);
 SDATE1 DATE;
 V_FUN_ITEM_REC TMPLT.CUR_Fun_Items%ROWTYPE;
 x number := 0.0;
-- y number := 5.25;
 y number := 5.17;
 RET PLS_INTEGER;
 WND PLS_INTEGER;
 ENAB VARCHAR2(100);

begin
 SET_WINDOW_PROPERTY(FORMS_MDI_WINDOW,WINDOW_STATE,MAXIMIZE);
 SET_WINDOW_PROPERTY('CGSO$WINDOW_1',WINDOW_STATE,MAXIMIZE);

 WND := WIN_API_UTILITY.GET_ACTIVE_WINDOW();
 RET := SEC_DLL.IsWndCaptionDisplayed(WND);
 IF RET = 1 THEN
 TOGGEL_WND;
 END IF;

 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_Y_POS := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VIEWPORT_Y_POS );
 TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_VIEW_Y_POS := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VIEWPORT_Y_POS_ON_CANVAS );
 TMPLT.HEIGHT := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', HEIGHT);


 TMPLT.LOAD_FUNCTIONS(:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID, :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID);
 TMPLT.ENB_DIS_FUN_BUT;


 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('TOOLBAR', visible, property_true);
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('TOOLBAR', display_position, x,y);
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY ('TITLE', visible, property_true);

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXIT1',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('RE_ENTER_QUERY',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('LAST_REC',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('FIRST_REC',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PAGE_UP',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PAGE_DOWN',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXECUTE',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 :GLOBAL.EXIT := 0;

 IF CHECK_TIMEOUT = TRUE THEN
 DECLARE
 hWind PLS_INTEGER;
 CheckTimer TIMER;
 BEGIN
 hWind := get_window_property(FORMS_MDI_WINDOW,WINDOW_HANDLE);
 Win_API_Session.Timeout_Start_Timer(hWind);
 CheckTimer := Create_Timer('CheckTimeout',120000,repeat);
 END;
 END IF;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF CHECK_EDI_ROLE_ID(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID) = TRUE THEN
IF CHECK_EDI_MSG_TIMER = TRUE THEN
 DECLARE
 TIMER_ID TIMER;
 V_VAR_VALUE VARCHAR2(200);
 V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN VARCHAR2(200);
 BEGIN
 V_VAR_VALUE := GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'EDI_MSG_TIMER',30);
 V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN := GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'MSG_DISPLAY_PERIOD',30);

 IF (V_VAR_VALUE IS NOT NULL AND V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN IS NOT NULL) AND
 (V_VAR_VALUE > 0 AND V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN > 0) THEN

 TIMER_ID := Find_Timer('EDI_MSG');
 IF Id_Null(TIMER_ID) THEN
 TIMER_ID := CREATE_TIMER('EDI_MSG',V_VAR_VALUE, REPEAT);
 ELSE
 Set_Timer(TIMER_ID,1, REPEAT);
 END IF;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
 DECLARE
 errnum NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 errtxt VARCHAR2(2000) := ERROR_TEXT;
 errtyp VARCHAR2(2000) := ERROR_TYPE;
 alert_is alert;
 alert_button number;
 MsgTxt VARCHAR2(2000);
 TIMER_ID TIMER;
 BEGIN
 IF errtyp = 'FRM' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ش';
 ELSIF errtyp = 'ORA' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ق';
 END IF;

 IF DBMS_ERROR_CODE = ERR_DB.GET_DB_ERR_CD THEN
 MsgTxt := ERR_DB.GET_LAST_ERROR;
 ELSE
 MsgTxt := errtyp||'-'||TO_CHAR(errnum)||': '||errtxt;
 END IF;
 alert_is := find_alert('CFG_ERROR');

 if (not id_null(alert_is)) then
 set_alert_property(alert_is, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, MsgTxt );
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_is);
 else
 Message(MsgTxt);
 end if;
 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER('ON_ERROR_TIMER');
 IF NOT ID_NULL(TIMER_ID) THEN
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 END IF;

 TIMER_ID := CREATE_TIMER('ON_ERROR_TIMER', 1, REPEAT);
 END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-TIMER-EXPIRED
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 THE_TIMER VARCHAR2(40) := GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(TIMER_NAME);
 TIMER_ID TIMER;
 v_inactive_time NUMBER;
 V_msg_count NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 IF THE_TIMER = 'CHECKTIMEOUT' THEN
 v_inactive_time := Win_API_Session.Timeout_get_inactive_time;
 IF v_inactive_time >= 600 then
 Win_API_Session.Timeout_Delete_Timer;
 :GLOBAL.G_TIME_OUT := 1;
 BELL;
 EXIT_FORM (NO_VALIDATE);
 ELSIF v_inactive_time >= 360 then
 BELL;
 END IF;
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'ON_ERROR_TIMER' THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM IS NOT NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('' , 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 END IF;
 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER(THE_TIMER);
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'ON_MESSAGE_TIMER' THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM IS NOT NULL THEN
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('' , 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 END IF;

 TIMER_ID := FIND_TIMER(THE_TIMER);
 DELETE_TIMER(TIMER_ID);
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'EDI_MSG' THEN
 for_edi_msg(V_msg_count);
 IF V_msg_count > 0 THEN
 BELL;BELL;BELL;BELL;
 :EDI_MSG.EDI_MSG_TXT := 'توجد رسائل بعدد '|| V_msg_count ||' مطلوب اتخاذ اجراءات عليها';
 TURN_MSG;
 end if;
 ELSIF THE_TIMER = 'RETURN_EDI_MSG' THEN
 RETURN_MSG;
 END IF;
 WHEN_TIMER_EXPIRED_MSG;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-MENU
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$TOGGLE_QUERY_MODE */
/* This changes the mode of block synchronization so that if it is */
/* currently ON, then it is changed to OFF, and vice-versa. */
/* It also queries the dependent blocks as appropriate for the */
/* new mode. */
BEGIN
 CGBS$TOGGLE( :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRFRM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGGN$KEY_CLRFRM */
/* Perform the key's standard functionality */
BEGIN
 clear_form;
 IF :SYSTEM.FORM_STATUS = 'CHANGED' THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

/* CGCF$PERFORM_STARTUP */
/* execute the when-new-form-instance code that was created by forms generator */
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 CG$WHEN_NEW_FORM_INSTANCE;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-TAB-PAGE-CHANGED
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGLT$NEW_TAB_PAGE */
/* Show related canvases for this tab */
BEGIN
 IF( :SYSTEM.TAB_NEW_PAGE IN ( 'CG$M_TAB_1_PAGE_1', 'CG$M_TAB_1_PAGE_2' ) ) THEN
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE := TRUE;
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.CGLT$TAB_CHANGED;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: POST-DATABASE-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE


V_RET NUMBER;
V_SEVERITY NUMBER;
V_ERR_MSG VARCHAR2(500);
V_USER_NOTES VARCHAR2(500);
V_DCLTN_STA_CD NUMBER;

BEGIN

 IF :CLR_TYPE.CLR_DCLTN = 2 THEN
 IF :SEARCH_CNTNR IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_RET := AGT.VALIDATE_AGT(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD, :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID,
 NULL, NULL , NULL, NULL,
 :SEARCH_CNTNR, NULL, :PARAMETER.P_GATE_NBR,
 V_SEVERITY , V_ERR_MSG , V_USER_NOTES , 'F') ;
 IF V_RET = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_ERR_MSG ,'ERROR');
 ELSE
 V_RET := AGT.CLEAR_AGT(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD, NULL, NULL, :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID,
 NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
 :SEARCH_CNTNR ,NULL, :PARAMETER.P_GATE_NBR , V_ERR_MSG , 'F') ;
 IF V_RET = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_ERR_MSG ,'ERROR');
 ELSE
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');

 BEGIN
 -- --
 -- --
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_CD INTO V_DCLTN_STA_CD
 FROM declarations
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :L_SDO_DCLTN_ISN;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
 V_DCLTN_STA_CD :=0;
 END;
 IF V_DCLTN_STA_CD <> 9 THEN
 STR.DISPARBMSG(1,170,'INFORMATION');
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC
 INTO :L_DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC
 FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = 1
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = V_DCLTN_STA_CD
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;
 STR.DISPALERT('تم فسح البيان','INFORMATION');
 UPDATE_BARCODE ;
 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 END IF;
END;

BEGIN
 IF :GLOBAL.air_partial_clear = 1
 AND :parameter.p_port_type = consts.get_const_val ('DCLTN.PT_AIR')
 AND :dcltn_gate_trans.dgt_type IN (3, 5, 6)
 THEN
 UPDATE_AIR_DCLTN;
 END IF;
END;
